name: Alakazam
flavor_text: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5000.

name: Blastoise
flavor_text: A brutal Pokémon with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high-speed tackles.

name: Chansey
flavor_text: A rare and elusive Pokémon that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to catch it.

name: Charizard
flavor_text: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to unintentionally cause forest fires.

name: Clefairy
flavor_text: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.

name: Gyarados
flavor_text: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

name: Hitmonchan
flavor_text: While seeming to do nothing, it fires punches in lightning-fast volleys that are impossible to see.

name: Machamp
flavor_text: Using its amazing muscles, it throws powerful punches that can knock its victim clear over the horizon.

name: Magneton
flavor_text: Formed by several Magnemites linked together. It frequently appears when sunspots flare up.

name: Mewtwo
flavor_text: A scientist created this Pokémon after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

name: Nidoking
flavor_text: Uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break its prey's bones.

name: Ninetales
flavor_text: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

name: Poliwrath
flavor_text: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breaststroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.

name: Raichu
flavor_text: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

name: Venusaur
flavor_text: This plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

name: Zapdos
flavor_text: A legendary bird Pokémon said to appear from clouds while wielding enormous lightning bolts.

name: Beedrill
flavor_text: Flies at high speed and attacks using the large, venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.

name: Dragonair
flavor_text: A mystical Pokémon that exudes a gentle aura. Has the ability to change climate conditions.

name: Dugtrio
flavor_text: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

name: Electabuzz
flavor_text: Normally found near power plants, it can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.

name: Electrode
flavor_text: It stores electrical energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

name: Pidgeotto
flavor_text: Very protective of its sprawling territory, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

name: Arcanine
flavor_text: A Pokémon that has been long admired for its beauty. It runs gracefully, as if on wings.

name: Charmeleon
flavor_text: When it swings its burning tail, it raises the temperature to unbearably high levels.

name: Dewgong
flavor_text: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.

name: Dratini
flavor_text: Long considered a mythical Pokémon until recently, when a small colony was found living underwater.

name: Farfetch'd
flavor_text: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. This sprig is used much like a metal sword.

name: Growlithe
flavor_text: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.

name: Haunter
flavor_text: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from another dimension.

name: Ivysaur
flavor_text: When the bulb on its back grows large, the Pokémon seems to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

name: Jynx
flavor_text: Merely by meditating, the Pokémon launches a powerful psychic energy attack.

name: Kadabra
flavor_text: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches even to those just nearby.

name: Kakuna
flavor_text: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.

name: Machoke
flavor_text: Its muscular body is so powerful that it must wear a power-save belt to help regulate its motions.

name: Magikarp
flavor_text: In the distant past, it was stronger than its horribly weak descendants that exist today.

name: Magmar
flavor_text: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.

name: Nidorino
flavor_text: An aggressive Pokémon that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

name: Poliwhirl
flavor_text: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.

name: Porygon
flavor_text: A Pokémon that consists entirely of programming code. Capable of moving freely in cyberspace.

name: Raticate
flavor_text: It uses its whiskers to maintain its balance. It seems to slow down if they are cut off.

name: Seel
flavor_text: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. This horn is used for bashing through thick ice.

name: Wartortle
flavor_text: Often hides in water to stalk unweary prey. When swimming quickly, it moves its ears to maintain balance.

name: Abra
flavor_text: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and teleport to safety.

name: Bulbasaur
flavor_text: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. Thus, a plant sprouted and now grows with this Pokémon.

name: Caterpie
flavor_text: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

name: Charmander
flavor_text: Obviously prefers hot places. If it gets caught in the rain, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

name: Diglett
flavor_text: Lives about three feet underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.

name: Doduo
flavor_text: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.

name: Drowzee
flavor_text: Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.

name: Gastly
flavor_text: Almost invisible, this gaseous Pokémon cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.

name: Koffing
flavor_text: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.

name: Machop
flavor_text: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.

name: Magnemite
flavor_text: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses attacks like Thunder Wave.

name: Metapod
flavor_text: It is vulnerable to attack because its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.

name: Nidoran ♂
flavor_text: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger, more powerful of its horns secretes venom.

name: Onix
flavor_text: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, though colored black.

name: Pidgey
flavor_text: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

name: Pikachu
flavor_text: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can cause lightning storms.

name: Poliwag
flavor_text: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming over trying to stand.

name: Ponyta
flavor_text: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything flat in moments.

name: Rattata
flavor_text: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

name: Sandshrew
flavor_text: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.

name: Squirtle
flavor_text: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. It powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.

name: Starmie
flavor_text: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value this core as a gem.

name: Staryu
flavor_text: An enigmatic Pokémon that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.

name: Tangela
flavor_text: Its whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to seaweed. These vines shake as it walks.

name: Voltorb
flavor_text: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Monster Ball, it has zapped many people.

name: Vulpix
flavor_text: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. Its tail splits from the tip as it grows older.

name: Weedle
flavor_text: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp, venomous stinger on its head.

name: Clefairy Doll
rules: Play Clefairy Doll as if it were a Basic Pokémon. While in play, Clefairy Doll counts as a Pokémon (instead of a Trainer card). Clefairy Doll has no attacks, can't retreat, and can't be Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned. If Clefairy Doll is Knocked Out, it doesn't count as a Knocked Out Pokémon. At any time during your turn before your attack, you may discard Clefairy Doll.

name: Computer Search
rules: Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to search your deck for any card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

name: Devolution Spray
rules: Choose 1 of your own Pokémon in play and a Stage of Evolution. Discard all Evolution cards of that Stage or higher attached to that Pokémon. That Pokémon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or anything else that might be the result of an attack (just as if you had evolved it).

name: Impostor Professor Oak
rules: Your opponent shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck, then draws 7 cards.

name: Item Finder
rules: Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand.

name: Lass
rules: You and your opponent show each other your hands, then shuffle all the Trainer cards from your hands into your decks.

name: Pokémon Breeder
rules: Put a Stage 2 Evolution card from your hand on the matching Basic Pokémon. You can only play this card when you would be allowed to evolve that Pokémon anyway.

name: Pokémon Trader
rules: Trade 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards in your hand for 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards from your deck. Show both cards to your opponent. Shuffle your deck afterward.

name: Scoop Up
rules: Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play and return its Basic Pokémon card to your hand. (Discard all cards attached to that card.)

name: Super Energy Removal
rules: Discard 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokémon in order to choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and up to 2 Energy cards attached to it. Discard those Energy cards.

name: Defender
rules: Attach Defender to 1 of your Pokémon. At the end of your opponent's next turn, discard Defender. Damage done to that Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

name: Energy Retrieval
rules: Trade 1 of the other cards in your hand for up to 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile.

name: Full Heal
rules: Your Active Pokémon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.

name: Maintenance
rules: Shuffle 2 of the other cards from your hand into your deck in order to draw a card.

name: PlusPower
rules: Attach PlusPower to your Active Pokémon. At the end of your turn, discard PlusPower. If this Pokémon's attack does damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), the attack does 10 more damage to the Defending Pokémon.

name: Pokémon Center
rules: Remove all damage counters from all of your own Pokémon with damage counters on them, then discard all Energy cards attached to those Pokémon.

name: Pokémon Flute
rules: Choose 1 Basic Pokémon card from your opponent's discard pile and put it onto his or her Bench. (You can't play Pokémon Flute if your opponent's Bench is full.)

name: Pokédex
rules: Look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck and rearrange them as you like.

name: Professor Oak
rules: Discard your hand, then draw 7 cards.

name: Revive
rules: Put 1 Basic Pokémon card from your discard pile onto your Bench. Put damage counters on that Pokémon equal to half its HP (rounded down to the nearest 10). (You can't play Revive if your Bench is full.)

name: Super Potion
rules: Discard 1 Energy card attached to your own Pokémon in order to remove up to 4 damage counters from that Pokémon.

name: Bill
rules: Draw 2 cards.

name: Energy Removal
rules: Choose 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and discard it.

name: Gust of Wind
rules: Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with his or her Active Pokémon.

name: Potion
rules: Remove up to 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon.

name: Switch
rules: Switch 1 of your own Benched Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.

name: Double Colorless Energy
rules:
Provides ColorlessColorless energy.
Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.

name: Nidoqueen

name: Pidgeot
flavor_text: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.

name: Pinsir
flavor_text: If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing its victim around and toss it hard.

name: Scyther
flavor_text: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one of it.

name: Snorlax
flavor_text: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.

name: Vaporeon
flavor_text: Lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin that is often mistaken for a mermaid's.

name: Venomoth
flavor_text: The dust-like scales covering its wings are color coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.

name: Victreebel
flavor_text: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

flavor_text: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.

name: Gloom
flavor_text: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool; it is a nectar that is used to attract prey.

name: Lickitung
flavor_text: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon's. It leaves a stinging sensation when it licks enemies.

name: Marowak
flavor_text: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to K.O. targets.

name: Nidorina
flavor_text: The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.

name: Parasect
flavor_text: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.

name: Persian
flavor_text: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

name: Primeape
flavor_text: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until its quarry is caught.

name: Rapidash
flavor_text: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

name: Rhydon
flavor_text: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3600 degrees.

name: Seaking
flavor_text: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming powerfully up rivers and creeks.

name: Tauros
flavor_text: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

name: Weepinbell
flavor_text: It spits out poisonpowder to immobilize the enemy, and then finishes the enemy with a spray of acid.

name: Bellsprout
flavor_text: A carnivorous Pokémon that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.

name: Cubone
flavor_text: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this Pokémon's real face.

name: Eevee
flavor_text: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from elemental stones.

name: Exeggcute
flavor_text: Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.

name: Goldeen
flavor_text: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname "Water Queen."

name: Jigglypuff
flavor_text: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

name: Mankey
flavor_text: Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment, then thrashing away the next.

name: Meowth
flavor_text: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

name: Nidoran ♀
flavor_text: Although small, its venomous barbs make this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

name: Oddish
flavor_text: During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.

name: Paras
flavor_text: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by drawing nutrients from the bug host.

name: Pikachu
flavor_text: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

name: Rhyhorn
flavor_text: Its massive bones are 1,000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.

name: Spearow
flavor_text: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speeds to stay airborne.

name: Venonat
flavor_text: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.

name: Pikachu

name: Psyduck

name: Moltres

name: Articuno

name: Marill
flavor_text: The tip of its tail, which contains oil that is lighter than water, lets it swim without drowning.

name: Togepi
flavor_text: Still only a hatchling, it uses poison to chase off its enemies when threatened.

name: Entei

flavor_text: A ferocious prehistoric Pokémon that goes for the enemy's throat with its serrated saw-like fangs.

name: Articuno
flavor_text: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

name: Ditto
flavor_text: Capable of copying an enemy's genetic code to instantly transform itself into a duplicate of the enemy.

name: Dragonite
flavor_text: An extremely rarely seen marine Pokémon. Its intelligence is said to match that of humans.

name: Gengar
flavor_text: Under a full moon, this Pokémon likes to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.

name: Haunter
flavor_text: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from another dimension.

name: Hitmonlee
flavor_text: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.

name: Hypno
flavor_text: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of psi moves such as Hypnosis and Confusion.

name: Kabutops
flavor_text: Its sleek shape is perfect for swimming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids.

name: Lapras
flavor_text: A Pokémon that has been overhunted almost to extinction. It can ferry people across water.

name: Magneton
flavor_text: Formed by several Magnemites linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

name: Moltres
flavor_text: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.

name: Muk
flavor_text: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

name: Raichu
flavor_text: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high voltage power.

name: Zapdos
flavor_text: A legendary thunderbird Pokémon whose anger is said to cause storms. Some say it has lived above the clouds for thousands of years.

name: Arbok
flavor_text: It is rumored that the ferocious warning markings on its belly differ from area to area.

name: Cloyster
flavor_text: When attacked, it launches its horns in quick volleys. Its innards have never been seen.

name: Gastly
flavor_text: A mysterious Pokémon. Some say it is a lifeform from another dimension, while other believe it is formed from smog.

name: Golbat
flavor_text: Once it strikes, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.

name: Golduck
flavor_text: Often seen swimming elegantly by lake shores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster, Kappa.

name: Golem
flavor_text: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.

name: Graveler
flavor_text: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.

name: Kingler
flavor_text: The large pincer has 10,000 horsepower of crushing power. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.

name: Magmar
flavor_text: Found at the mouths of volcanoes and extremely hard to spot. There are very few instances of capturing this Pokémon.

name: Omastar
flavor_text: A prehistoric Pokémon that died out when its heavy shell made it impossible for it to catch prey.

name: Sandslash
flavor_text: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.

name: Seadra
flavor_text: Capable of swimming backward by rapidly flapping its wing-like pectoral fins and stout tail.

name: Slowbro
flavor_text: The Shellder that is latched onto Slowpoke's tail is said to feed on the host's left-over scraps.

name: Tentacruel
flavor_text: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.

name: Weezing
flavor_text: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, two Koffings can fuse into a Weezing over many years.

name: Ekans
flavor_text: Moves silently and stealthily. Eats the eggs of birds such as Pidgey and Spearow whole.

name: Geodude
flavor_text: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.

name: Grimer
flavor_text: Appears in filthy areas. Thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.

name: Horsea
flavor_text: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.

name: Kabuto
flavor_text: A Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil found in what was once the ocean floor eons ago.

name: Krabby
flavor_text: Its pincers are not only powerful weapons, they are used for balance when walking sideways.

name: Omanyte
flavor_text: Although long extinct, in rare cases, it can be genetically resurrected from fossils.

name: Psyduck
flavor_text: While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily Pokémon will use psychokinetic powers.

name: Shellder
flavor_text: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.

name: Slowpoke
flavor_text: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes 5 seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

name: Tentacool
flavor_text: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by its stinging acid.

name: Zubat
flavor_text: Forms colonies in perpetually dark places. Uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.

name: Mr. Fuji
rules: Choose a Pokémon on your Bench. Shuffle it and any cards attached to it into your deck.

name: Energy Search
rules: Search your deck for a basic Energy card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

name: Gambler
rules: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Flip a coin. If heads, draw 8 cards. If tails, draw 1 card.

name: Recycle
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, put a card in your discard pile on top of your deck.

name: Mysterious Fossil
rules: Play Mysterious Fossil as if it were a Basic Pokémon. While in play, Mysterious Fossil counts as a Pokémon (instead of a Trainer card). Mysterious Fossil has no attacks, can't retreat, and can't be Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned. If Mysterious Fossil is Knocked Out, it doesn't count as a Knocked Out Pokémon. (Discard it anyway.) At any time during your turn before your attack, you may discard Mysterious Fossil from play.

name: Alakazam
flavor_text: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5000.

name: Blastoise
flavor_text: A brutal Pokémon with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high-speed tackles.

name: Chansey
flavor_text: A rare and elusive Pokémon that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to catch it.

name: Charizard
flavor_text: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to unintentionally cause forest fires.

name: Clefable
flavor_text: A timid Fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.

name: Clefairy
flavor_text: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.

name: Gyarados
flavor_text: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

name: Hitmonchan
flavor_text: While seeming to do nothing, it fires punches in lightning-fast volleys that are impossible to see.

name: Magneton
flavor_text: Formed by several Magnemites linked together. It frequently appears when sunspots flare up.

name: Mewtwo
flavor_text: A scientist created this Pokémon after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

name: Nidoking
flavor_text: Uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break its prey's bones.

name: Nidoqueen
flavor_text: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.

name: Ninetales
flavor_text: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

name: Pidgeot
flavor_text: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.

name: Poliwrath
flavor_text: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breaststroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.

name: Raichu
flavor_text: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

name: Scyther
flavor_text: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one of it.

name: Venusaur
flavor_text: This plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

name: Wigglytuff
flavor_text: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.

name: Zapdos
flavor_text: A legendary bird Pokémon said to appear from clouds while wielding enormous lightning bolts.

name: Beedrill
flavor_text: Flies at high speed and attacks using the large, venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.

name: Dragonair
flavor_text: A mystical Pokémon that exudes a gentle aura. Has the ability to change climate conditions.

name: Dugtrio
flavor_text: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

name: Electabuzz
flavor_text: Normally found near power plants, it can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.

name: Electrode
flavor_text: It stores electrical energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

name: Kangaskhan
flavor_text: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is three years old.

name: Mr. Mime
flavor_text: If interrupted while miming, it will slap around the enemy with its broad hands.

name: Pidgeotto
flavor_text: Very protective of its sprawling territory, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

name: Pinsir
flavor_text: If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing its victim around and toss it hard.

name: Snorlax
flavor_text: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.

name: Venomoth
flavor_text: The dust-like scales covering its wings are color coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.

name: Victreebel
flavor_text: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

name: Arcanine
flavor_text: A Pokémon that has been long admired for its beauty. It runs gracefully, as if on wings.

name: Butterfree
flavor_text: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

name: Charmeleon
flavor_text: When it swings its burning tail, it raises the temperature to unbearably high levels.

name: Dewgong
flavor_text: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.

name: Dodrio
flavor_text: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake.

name: Dratini
flavor_text: Long considered a mythical Pokémon until recently, when a small colony was found living underwater.

name: Exeggutor
flavor_text: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an Exeggcute.

name: Farfetch'd
flavor_text: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. This sprig is used much like a metal sword.

name: Fearow
flavor_text: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.

name: Growlithe
flavor_text: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.

name: Haunter
flavor_text: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from another dimension.

name: Ivysaur
flavor_text: When the bulb on its back grows large, the Pokémon seems to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

name: Jynx
flavor_text: Merely by meditating, the Pokémon launches a powerful psychic energy attack.

name: Kadabra
flavor_text: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches even to those just nearby.

name: Kakuna
flavor_text: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.

name: Lickitung
flavor_text: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon's. It leaves a stinging sensation when it licks enemies.

name: Machoke
flavor_text: Its muscular body is so powerful that it must wear a power-save belt to help regulate its motions.

name: Magikarp
flavor_text: In the distant past, it was stronger than its horribly weak descendants that exist today.

name: Magmar
flavor_text: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.

name: Marowak
flavor_text: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to K.O. targets.

name: Nidorina
flavor_text: The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.

name: Nidorino
flavor_text: An aggressive Pokémon that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

name: Parasect
flavor_text: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.

name: Persian
flavor_text: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

name: Poliwhirl
flavor_text: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.

name: Raticate
flavor_text: It uses its whiskers to maintain its balance. It seems to slow down if they are cut off.

name: Rhydon
flavor_text: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3600 degrees.

name: Seaking
flavor_text: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming powerfully up rivers and creeks.

name: Seel
flavor_text: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. This horn is used for bashing through thick ice.

name: Tauros
flavor_text: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

name: Wartortle
flavor_text: Often hides in water to stalk unweary prey. When swimming quickly, it moves its ears to maintain balance.

name: Weepinbell
flavor_text: It spits out poisonpowder to immobilize the enemy, and then finishes the enemy with a spray of acid.

name: Abra
flavor_text: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and teleport to safety.

name: Bellsprout
flavor_text: A carnivorous Pokémon that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.

name: Bulbasaur
flavor_text: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. Thus, a plant sprouted and now grows with this Pokémon.

name: Caterpie
flavor_text: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

name: Charmander
flavor_text: Obviously prefers hot places. If it gets caught in the rain, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

name: Cubone
flavor_text: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this Pokémon's real face.

name: Diglett
flavor_text: Lives about three feet underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.

name: Doduo
flavor_text: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.

name: Drowzee
flavor_text: Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.

name: Exeggcute
flavor_text: Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.

name: Gastly
flavor_text: Almost invisible, this gaseous Pokémon cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.

name: Goldeen
flavor_text: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname "Water Queen."

name: Jigglypuff
flavor_text: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

name: Machop
flavor_text: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.

name: Magnemite
flavor_text: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses attacks like Thunder Wave.

name: Meowth
flavor_text: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

name: Metapod
flavor_text: It is vulnerable to attack because its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.

name: Nidoran ♀
flavor_text: Although small, its venomous barbs make this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

name: Nidoran ♂
flavor_text: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger, more powerful of its horns secretes venom.

name: Onix
flavor_text: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, though colored black.

name: Paras
flavor_text: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by drawing nutrients from the bug host.

name: Pidgey
flavor_text: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

name: Pikachu
flavor_text: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can cause lightning storms.

name: Poliwag
flavor_text: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming over trying to stand.

name: Rattata
flavor_text: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

name: Rhyhorn
flavor_text: Its massive bones are 1,000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.

name: Sandshrew
flavor_text: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.

name: Spearow
flavor_text: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speeds to stay airborne.

name: Squirtle
flavor_text: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. It powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.

name: Starmie
flavor_text: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value this core as a gem.

name: Staryu
flavor_text: An enigmatic Pokémon that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.

name: Tangela
flavor_text: Its whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to seaweed. These vines shake as it walks.

name: Venonat
flavor_text: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.

name: Voltorb
flavor_text: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

name: Vulpix
flavor_text: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. Its tail splits from the tip as it grows older.

name: Weedle
flavor_text: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp, venomous stinger on its head.

name: Computer Search
rules: Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to search your deck for any card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

name: Imposter Professor Oak
rules: Your opponent shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck, then draws 7 cards.

name: Item Finder
rules: Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand.

name: Lass
rules: You and your opponent show each other your hands, then shuffle all the Trainer cards from your hands into your decks.

name: Pokémon Breeder
rules: Put a Stage 2 Evolution card from your hand on the matching Basic Pokémon. You can only play this card when you would be allowed to evolve that Pokémon anyway.

name: Pokémon Trader
rules: Trade 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards in your hand for 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards from your deck. Show both cards to your opponent. Shuffle your deck afterward.

name: Scoop Up
rules: Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play and return its Basic Pokémon card to your hand. (Discard all cards attached to that card.)

name: Super Energy Removal
rules: Discard 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your own Pokémon in order to choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and up to 2 Energy cards attached to it. Discard those Energy cards.

name: Defender
rules: Attach Defender to 1 of your Pokémon. At the end of your opponent's next turn, discard Defender. Damage done to that Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

name: Energy Retrieval
rules: Trade 1 of the other cards in your hand for up to 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile.

name: Full Heal
rules: Your Active Pokémon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.

name: Maintenance
rules: Shuffle 2 of the other cards from your hand into your deck in order to draw a card.

name: PlusPower
rules: Attach PlusPower to your Active Pokémon. At the end of your turn, discard PlusPower. If this Pokémon's attack does damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), the attack does 10 more damage to the Defending Pokémon.

name: Pokémon Center
rules: Remove all damage counters from all of your own Pokémon with damage counters on them, then discard all Energy cards attached to those Pokémon.

name: Pokédex
rules: Look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck and rearrange them as you like.

name: Professor Oak
rules: Discard your hand, then draw 7 cards.

name: Super Potion
rules: Discard 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your own Pokémon in order to remove up to 4 damage counters from that Pokémon.

name: Bill
rules: Draw 2 cards.

name: Energy Removal
rules: Choose 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and discard it.

name: Gust of Wind
rules: Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with his or her Active Pokémon.

name: Poké Ball
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, you may search your deck for any Basic Pokémon or Evolution card. Show that card to your opponent, then put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

name: Potion
rules: Remove up to 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon.

name: Switch
rules: Switch 1 of your Benched Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.

name: Double Colorless Energy
rules: Provides Colorless Colorless energy. Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.

name: Dark Alakazam
flavor_text: Almost as if it were being controlled by something else, it never changes expressions, even in the middle of battle.

name: Dark Arbok
flavor_text: Freezes its prey with its stare. If you should encounter one, remember not to look into its eyes.

name: Dark Blastoise
flavor_text: An aggressive Pokémon that tackles anything it sees.

name: Dark Charizard
flavor_text: Seemingly possessed, it spews fire like a volcano, trying to burn all it sees.

name: Dark Dragonite
flavor_text: Sometimes called "The God of Destruction." Its wings are able to support it in spite of its massive weight.

name: Dark Dugtrio
flavor_text: Digs large sinkholes in the ground and tries to trap its enemies in them.

name: Dark Golbat
flavor_text: Sneaks up silently on its prey and attacks it from behind, sometimes killing it with one bite.

name: Dark Gyarados
flavor_text: Normally found only in the deep ocean, it has recently been seen in shallow waters as well.

name: Dark Hypno
flavor_text: Carries a pendulum with it always. Sometimes appears near less-traveled roads and schools at dusk.

name: Dark Machamp
flavor_text: It is almost impossible to defend against a Machamp's four powerful arms.

name: Dark Magneton
flavor_text: The number of incidents of hackers using Magnetons to damage computer systems is steadily increasing.

name: Dark Slowbro
flavor_text: It loves nothing better than to be left alone, and so sometimes ends up being manipulated by unscrupulous people.

name: Dark Vileplume
flavor_text: Perhaps because of their strong-smelling pollen, other Pokémon do not approach areas where Vileplumes live.

name: Dark Weezing
flavor_text: Researchers have observed these Pokémon reproducing in industrial waste sites.

name: Here Comes Team Rocket!
rules: Each player plays with his or her Prize cards face up for the rest of the game.

name: Rocket's Sneak Attack
rules: Look at your opponent's hand. If he or she has any Trainer cards, choose 1 of them. Your opponent shuffles that card into his or her deck.

name: Rainbow Energy
rules: Attach Rainbow Energy to 1 of your Pokémon. While in play, Rainbow Energy counts as every type of basic Energy but only provides 1 Energy at a time. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card when not in play.) When you attach this card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon, it does 10 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.)
