name: Dark Weezing
flavor_text: Researchers have observed these Pokémon reproducing in industrial waste sites.

name: Dark Charmeleon
flavor_text: Its tail is incredibly strong, able to lift up to 5 adult men.

name: Dark Dragonair
flavor_text: As is fitting for a legendary Pokémon, it has many strange powers, including the ability to make rain or snow fall.

name: Dark Electrode
flavor_text: Some researchers hypothesize that Electrode may actually be a form of energy instead of having an actual body.

name: Dark Flareon
flavor_text: A Pokémon with a hot temper that can't be controlled once it's angered. Capable of breathing flames hotter than 3000°.

name: Dark Gloom
flavor_text: Its pollen has such a strong smell that it even confuses itself at times.

name: Dark Golduck
flavor_text: When Psyducks evolve, their headaches disappear and they find themselves in possession of formidable mental powers.

name: Dark Jolteon
flavor_text: A dangerous Pokémon when angered. It likes to playfully shock people with the electricity it stores within its body.

name: Dark Kadabra
flavor_text: Some people say that Kadabras are responsible for many of the mysterious events reported in the news.

name: Dark Machoke
flavor_text: While normally peaceful and friendly, the number of incidents involving cruel Machokes is rising.

name: Dark Muk
flavor_text: Muks appear suddenly, spreading sludge everywhere. Whenever one appears in a city, panic ensues.

name: Dark Persian
flavor_text: Popular with women because of its beautiful fur. The leader of the Rockets keeps one as a pet.

name: Dark Primeape
flavor_text: Although Primeapes have always been mean, lately they seem to be becoming even more vicious and frenzied.

name: Dark Rapidash
flavor_text: A wild, uncontrollable Pokémon. When running, it looks like a comet streaking through the sky.

name: Dark Vaporeon
flavor_text: A Pokémon capable of controlling water, so it is capable of creating giant whirlpools.

name: Dark Wartortle
flavor_text: A Pokémon with a negative attitude, it hides in its shell whenever it's in a bad mood—which is often.

name: Magikarp
flavor_text: Recent research has revealed the presence of dragon DNA in this species of Pokémon.

name: Porygon
flavor_text: More and more people play the slots every day, trying to win a Porygon.

name: Abra
flavor_text: It teleports itself away from danger, making it difficult to capture.

name: Charmander
flavor_text: Many people find it cute and try to hold it, only to be burned by its tail.

name: Dark Raticate
flavor_text: A Raticate's front teeth are incredibly powerful; it can destroy a two-story house with them in 5 minutes.

name: Diglett
flavor_text: It follows Onixes in their tunnels, looking for scraps of food they have left behind.

name: Dratini
flavor_text: The capture of the first Dratini inspired the search for other legendary Pokémon.

name: Drowzee
flavor_text: Not popular with girls because of its attitude. Can often be heard muttering to itself in a low voice.

name: Eevee
flavor_text: A rare and unique Pokémon about which little is known, as few have been captured.

name: Ekans
flavor_text: A carnivore that swallows its prey whole. Pidgeys and Spearows are its favorite food.

name: Grimer
flavor_text: It has recently been found that Grimers are formed in waste-processing plants, and can move into towns via sewers.

name: Koffing
flavor_text: First discovered in a weapons factory, this Pokémon can now be found almost anywhere.

name: Machop
flavor_text: It's said that not even pro wrestlers can take down a Machop.

name: Magnemite
flavor_text: It is said that enough Magnemites and Magnetons gather in one place, they can create a powerful magnetic barrier.

name: Mankey
flavor_text: Normally friendly, it quickly becomes angry if it doesn't get what it wants.

name: Meowth
flavor_text: A popular Pokémon that earns money for its owner with its "Pay Day" ability.

name: Oddish
flavor_text: It wanders around at night sowing its seeds to create more Oddishes.

name: Ponyta
flavor_text: A gentle grass-eater, it will allow riders on its back. However, anyone attempting to do so must be careful not to get burned.

name: Psyduck
flavor_text: It is often seen holding its head in its paws, as if it were suffering from a headache.

name: Rattata
flavor_text: Loves to eat walnuts, chestnuts, cheese, and milk.

name: Slowpoke
flavor_text: Although it knows how to fish, no other intelligent behavior has been detected in it.

name: Squirtle
flavor_text: Cute Pokémon that charms people with its innocent eyes. Loves swimming all day long.

name: Voltorb
flavor_text: Usually seen only in power plants, it is sometimes seen in towns, apparently using the power lines to travel.

name: Zubat
flavor_text: Lives in dark caves. Can occasionally be seen at night, when it flies in search of food.

name: Here Comes Team Rocket!
rules: Each player plays with his or her Prize cards face up for the rest of the game.

name: Rocket's Sneak Attack
rules: Look at your opponent's hand. If he or she has any Trainer cards, choose 1 of them. Your opponent shuffles that card into his or her deck.

name: The Boss's Way
rules: Search your deck for an Evolution card with Dark in its name. Show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

name: Challenge!
rules: Ask your opponent if he or she accepts your challenge. If your opponent declines (or if both Benches are full), draw 2 cards. If your opponent accepts, each of you searches your decks for any number of Basic Pokémon cards and puts them face down onto your Benches. (A player can't do this if his or her Bench is full.) When you both have finished, shuffle your decks and turn those cards face up.

name: Digger
rules: Flip a coin. If tails, do 10 damage to your Active Pokémon. If heads, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, your opponent does 10 damage to his or her Active Pokémon. If heads, you flip a coin. Keep doing this until a player gets tails.

name: Imposter Oak's Revenge
rules: Discard a card from your hand in order to play this card. Your opponent shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck, then draws 4 cards.

name: Nightly Garbage Run
rules: Choose up to 3 Basic Pokémon cards, Evolution cards, and/or basic Energy cards from your discard pile. Show them to your opponent and shuffle them into your deck.

name: Goop Gas Attack
rules: All Pokémon Powers stop working until the end of your opponent's next turn.

name: Sleep!
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

name: Rainbow Energy
rules: Attach Rainbow Energy to 1 of your Pokémon. While in play, Rainbow Energy counts as every type of basic Energy but only provides 1 Energy at a time. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card when not in play.) When you attach this card from your hand to 1 of your Pokémon, it does 10 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.)

name: Full Heal Energy
rules: If you play this card from your hand, the Pokémon you attach it to is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned. | Full Heal Energy provides Colorless energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

name: Potion Energy
rules: If you play this card from your hand, remove 1 damage counter from the Pokémon you attach it to, if it has any. | Potion Energy provides Colorless energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

name: Dark Raichu
flavor_text: Stores up electricity in its body, then suddenly releases it to surprise and shock everyone.

name: Brock
rules: Remove 1 damage counter from each of your Pokémon that has any damage counters on it.

name: Erika
rules: You may draw up to 3 cards, then your opponent may draw up to 3 cards.

name: Lt. Surge
rules: You can play this card only if you have at least 1 Basic Pokémon card in your hand. Put a Basic Pokémon card from your hand into play as your Active Pokémon. Put your old Active Pokémon onto your Bench. (You can't play this card if your Bench is full.)

name: Misty
rules: Discard 2 of the other cards in your hand in order to play this card. If this turn's attack does damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), and if the attacking Pokémon has Misty in its name, the attack does 20 more damage to the Defending Pokémon.

name: The Rocket's Trap
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, choose up to 3 cards at random from your opponent's hand (don't look at them). Your opponent shuffles those cards into his or her deck.

name: Blaine's Quiz #1
rules: Put a Basic Pokémon or Evolution card from your hand face down in front of you and tell your opponent its name. Your opponent guesses the length of that Pokémon. Flip the card over. If your opponent guessed right, he or she draws 2 cards. If your opponent guessed wrong, you draw 2 cards. Either way, return the card to your hand.

name: Brock
rules: Remove 1 damage counter from each of your Pokémon that has any damage counters on it.

name: Charity
rules: Attach Charity to your Active Pokémon. Unless that Pokémon gets Knocked Out, return Charity to your hand at the end of your turn. If that Pokémon attacks and does damage to the Defending Pokémon, you may reduce that damage by any amount (rounded to the nearest 10).

name: Erika
rules: You may draw up to 3 cards, then your opponent may draw up to 3 cards.

name: Lt. Surge
rules: You can play this card only if you have at least 1 Basic Pokémon card in your hand. Put a Basic Pokémon card from your hand into play as your Active Pokémon. Put your old Active Pokémon onto your Bench. (You can't play this card if your Bench is full.)

name: Misty
rules: Discard 2 of the other cards in your hand in order to play this card. If this turn's attack does damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), and if the attacking Pokémon has Misty in its name, the attack does 20 more damage to the Defending Pokémon.

name: No Removal Gym
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. | A player must discard 2 cards from his or her hand in order to play an Energy Removal or Super Energy Removal card.

name: The Rocket's Training Gym
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. | Each player pays Colorless more to retreat his or her Active Pokémon.

name: Blaine's Last Resort
rules: You can't play this card if you have any cards in your hand other than Blaine's Last Resort. Show your hand to your opponent, then draw 5 cards.

name: Brock's Training Method
rules: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon or Evolution card with Brock in its name. Show that card to your opponent, then put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

name: Celadon City Gym
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. | During each player's turn, that player may choose to discard an Energy card attached to 1 of his or her Pokémon with Erika in its name. If that player does so, that Pokémon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned.

name: Cerulean City Gym
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. | Each player pays Colorless less to retreat his or her Pokémon if it has Misty in its name.

name: Erika's Maids
rules: Trade 2 of the other cards in your hand for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and/or Evolution cards with Erika in their names from your deck. Show those cards to your opponent, then put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

name: Erika's Perfume
rules: Look at your opponent's hand. If he or she has any Basic Pokémon cards there, you may put any number of them onto your opponent's Bench (as long as there's room).

name: Good Manners
rules: In order to play this card, you can't have any Basic Pokémon cards in your hand. Show your hand to your opponent, then search your deck for a Basic Pokémon card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

name: Lt. Surge's Treaty
rules: Your opponent chooses 1 of the following: everyone chooses 1 of his or her own Prizes and put it into his or her hand, or you draw a card.

name: Minion of Team Rocket
rules: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and return it and all cards attached to it to his or her hand. If 1 or both of them are tails, your turn ends immediately (you can't attack this turn).

name: Misty's Wrath
rules: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. Choose 2 of those cards and put them into your hand. Discard the rest.

name: Pewter City Gym
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. | Don't apply Resistance to any attacks made by Pokémon with Brock in their names.

name: Recall
rules: For your attack this turn, your Active Pokémon can use any attack from its Basic Pokémon card or any Evolution card attached to it. (You still have to pay for that attack's Energy cost.)

name: Sabrina's ESP
rules: Attach Sabrina's ESP to 1 of your Pokémon with Sabrina in its name. At the end of your turn, discard Sabrina's ESP. If that Pokémon uses and attack that involves flipping coins, Sabrina's ESP lets you re-flip those coins once. If you do, re-flip all the coins.

name: Secret Mission
rules: Look at your opponent's hand. Then, you may discard as many other cards as you want from your hand and draw that many cards.

name: Tickling Machine
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent sets aside all the cards in his or her hand face down. Nobody may look at those cards. At the end of your opponent's next turn, your opponent puts those cards back into his or her hand. If tails, your turn ends immediately (you can't attack this turn).

name: Vermilion City Gym
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. | Whenever a player attacks with a Pokémon with Lt. Surge in its name, he or she may flip a coin. If heads, and if that Pokémon's attack does damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), that attack does 10 more damage to the Defending Pokémon. If tails, the attacking Pokémon does 10 damage to itself in addition to whatever its attack usually does.

name: Blaine's Gamble
rules: Discard any number of other cards from your hand, then flip a coin. If heads, draw twice that many cards.

name: Energy Flow
rules: For each of your Pokémon, you may return any number of Energy cards attached to it to your hand.

name: Misty's Duel
rules: You and your opponent play a game of Rock-Paper-Scissors. The winner shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck and draws a new hand of 5 cards. (If you don't know how to play Rock-Paper-Scissors, flip a coin to decide who's the winner.)

name: Narrow Gym
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. | No player may have more than 4 Pokémon on his or her Bench. When this card is played, if a player has 5 Pokémon on his or her Bench, that player chooses 1 of them and returns it and all cards attached to it to his or her hand. (If both players have to return a Pokémon, your opponent returns a Pokémon first.)

name: Sabrina's Gaze
rules: Each player shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck and draws a new hand of the same number of cards.

name: Trash Exchange
rules: Count the number of cards in your discard pile and shuffle them into your deck. Then discard that many cards from the top of your deck.

name: Blaine
rules: During this turn, instead of attaching your free Energy card, you may instead attach 2 Fire Energy cards to 1 of your Pokémon with Blaine in its name. (Playing additional copies of this card this turn has no effect.)

name: Giovanni
rules: Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play with Giovanni in its name. For the rest of your turn, you may evolve that Pokémon even if you just played or evolved it this turn or if this is your first turn. This effect also applies to the Pokémon it evolves into.

name: Koga
rules: If an attack from a Pokémon with Koga in its name does damage to a Defending Pokémon this turn, that Pokémon is then Poisoned.

name: Sabrina
rules: Take all Energy cards attached to 1 of your Pokémon with Sabrina in its name and attach them to another 1 of your Pokémon with Sabrina in its name.

name: Blaine
rules: During this turn, instead of attaching your free Energy card, you may instead attach 2 Fire Energy cards to 1 of your Pokémon with Blaine in its name. (Playing additional copies of this card this turn has no effect.)

name: Brock's Protection
rules: Attach Brock's Protection to 1 of your Pokémon with Brock in its name. Energy cards attached to that Pokémon can't be removed by your opponent's attacks or Trainer cards. (This doesn't stop the rest of the attack or Trainer card from working normally.)

name: Chaos Gym
rules: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. | Whenever a player plays a Trainer card other than a Stadium card, he or she flips a coin. If heads, that player plays that card normally. If tails, the player can't play that card. If the card isn't put into play, the player's opponent may use that card instead, if he or she does everything required in order to play that card (like discarding cards). Either way, the card goes to its owner's discard pile.

name: Erika's Kindness
rules: Remove 2 damage counters from each Pokémon (yours and your opponent's) with any damage counters on it. If a Pokémon has just 1 damage counter, remove it.

name: Giovanni
rules: Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play with Giovanni in its name. For the rest of your turn, you may evolve that Pokémon even if you just played or evolved it this turn or if this is your first turn. This effect also applies to the Pokémon it evolves into.

name: Giovanni's Last Resort
rules: Remove all damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon with Giovanni in its name. Then discard your hand.

name: Koga
rules: If an attack from a Pokémon with Koga in its name does damage to a Defending Pokémon this turn, that Pokémon is then Poisoned.

name: Lt. Surge's Secret Plan
rules: Put 1 card from your hand face down onto your Bench. (You can't play this card if your Bench is full.) Treat that card as a Basic Pokémon as long as it's face down. Flip the card if either player needs to know what it is in order to use an attack, a Pokémon Power, or a Trainer card. Flip the card if it ever uses an attack or Pokémon Power, evolves, retreats, is damaged by an attack, or is otherwise affected by an attack. At any time during your turn, you may flip the card over. When you flip that card over, if it isn't a Basic Pokémon, discard it and all cards attached to it.

name: Misty's Wish
rules: Look at 1 of your Prize cards. Then, ask your opponent if you may switch that card with 1 of the cards in your hand. If your opponent accepts and if you have any other cards in your hand, switch those cards. If your opponent declines, return the Prize card face down and draw a card.

name: Resistance Gym
rules: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. | Each Pokémon's Resistance is reduced by 20. (If a Pokémon's Resistance is -30, it becomes -10.)

name: Sabrina
rules: Take all Energy cards attached to 1 of your Pokémon with Sabrina in its name and attach them to another 1 of your Pokémon with Sabrina in its name.

name: Blaine's Quiz #2
rules: Put a card from your hand face down in front of you. Your opponent guesses whether it is an Energy card, a Trainer card, or a Pokémon (Basic or Evolution) card. Flip the card over. If your opponent guessed right, he or she draws 2 cards. If your opponent guessed wrong, you draw 2 cards. Either way, return the card to your hand.

name: Blaine's Quiz #3
rules: Put a Basic or Evolution card from your hand face down in front of you and tell your opponent the name of an attack of that card. Your opponent guesses the name of that card. Flip the card over. If your opponent guessed right, he or she draws 3 cards. If your opponent guessed wrong, you draw 3 cards. Either way, return the card to your hand.

name: Cinnabar City Gym
rules: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. | Ignore Weakness when a Water Pokémon does damage to a Pokémon with Blaine in its name.

name: Fuchsia City Gym
rules: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. | Once during each player's turn (before attacking), that player may flip a coin. If heads, that player may shuffle 1 of his or her Pokémon in play with Koga in its name and any cards attached to it into his or her deck.

name: Koga's Ninja Trick
rules: Attach Koga's Ninja Trick to your Active Pokémon with Koga in its name. If this Pokémon goes to your Bench, discard this card. When your opponent attacks, you may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon (before damage or other effects of attacks).

name: Master Ball
rules: Look at 7 cards from the top of your deck. You may choose a Basic Pokémon or Evolution card from those cards, show it to your opponent, then put it into your hand. Shuffle the rest into your deck.

name: Max Revive
rules: Discard 2 Energy cards from your hand in order to put 1 Basic Pokémon from your discard pile onto your Bench. (You can't play Max Revive if your Bench is full.)

name: Misty's Tears
rules: Discard 1 of the other cards in your hand in order to search your deck for up to 2 Water Energy cards. Show those cards to your opponent, then put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

name: Rocket's Minefield Gym
rules: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. | Whenever a player puts a Basic Pokémon onto his or her Bench from his or her hand, he or she flips a coin. If tails, put damage counters on that Pokémon.

name: Rocket's Secret Experiment
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for any card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. If tails, you can't play Trainer cards until the end of your next turn.

name: Sabrina's Psychic Control
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, choose a Trainer card in your opponent's discard pile that isn't put in play (like PlusPower or Mysterious Fossil). You may use that card as if it were in your hand, if you do everything required in order to play that card (like discarding cards). The card stays in your opponent's discard pile.

name: Saffron City Gym
rules: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. | As often as each player like during his or her turn (before attacking), that player may return 1 basic Energy card attached to 1 of his or her Pokémon with Sabrina in its name to his or her hand.

name: Viridian City Gym
rules: This card stays in play after being played. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. | Whenever a Pokémon with Giovanni in its name evolves, its owner removes 2 damage counters from that Pokémon (or 1 if it only has 1).

name: Fervor
rules: Show the top 3 cards of your deck to all players. Put any Fire Energy cards there into your hand and discard the rest.

name: Transparent Walls
rules: Until the end of your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from attacks done to your Benched Pokémon. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.)

name: Warp Point
rules: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with his or her Active Pokémon, then, if you have any Benched Pokémon, you switch 1 of them with your Active Pokémon.

name: Ampharos
flavor_text: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

name: Azumarill
flavor_text: By keeping still and listening intently, it can tell what is in even wild, fast-moving rivers.

name: Bellossom
flavor_text: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.

name: Feraligatr
flavor_text: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

name: Feraligatr
flavor_text: It is hard for it to support its own weight out of water, so it gets down on all fours. But it moves fast.

name: Heracross
flavor_text: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies' bellies, then lifts and throws them.

name: Jumpluff
flavor_text: Once it catches the wind, it deftly controls its cotton-puff spores to float, even around the world.

name: Kingdra
flavor_text: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.

name: Lugia
flavor_text: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea, because its powers are too strong.

name: Meganium
flavor_text: Meganium's breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

name: Meganium
flavor_text: The aroma that rises from its petals contains a substance that calms aggressive feelings.

name: Pichu
rules: If this Baby Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and your opponent tries to attack, your opponent flips a coin (before doing anything required in order to use that attack). If tails, your opponent's turn ends without an attack.
flavor_text: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.

name: Skarmory
flavor_text: Its sturdy wings look heavy, but they are actually hollow and light, allowing it to fly freely in the sky.

name: Slowking
flavor_text: When its head was bitten, toxins entered Slowpoke's head and unlocked an extraordinary power.

name: Steelix
flavor_text: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.

name: Togetic
flavor_text: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

name: Typhlosion
flavor_text: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.

name: Typhlosion
flavor_text: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

name: Metal Energy
rules:
Damage done to the Pokémon Metal Energy is attached to is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance). If the Pokémon Metal Energy is attached to isn't Metal, whenever it damages a Pokémon, reduce that damage by 10 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
Metal Energy provides Metal Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

name: Cleffa
rules: If this Baby Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and your opponent tries to attack, your opponent flips a coin (before doing anything required in order to use that attack). If tails, your opponent's turn ends without an attack.
flavor_text: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

name: Donphan
flavor_text: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its tackle is strong enough to knock down a house.

name: Elekid
rules: If this Baby Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and your opponent tries to attack, your opponent flips a coin (before doing anything required in order to use that attack). If tails, your opponent's turn ends without an attack.
flavor_text: It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it charges up only a little bit.

name: Magby
rules: If this Baby Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and your opponent tries to attack, your opponent flips a coin (before doing anything required in order to use that attack). If tails, your opponent's turn ends without an attack.
flavor_text: Each and every time it inhales and exhales, hot embers dribble out of its mouth and nostrils.

name: Murkrow
flavor_text: It is said that when chased, it lures its attacker onto dark mountain trails where the foe will get lost.

name: Sneasel
flavor_text: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

name: Aipom
flavor_text: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.

name: Ariados
flavor_text: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It's hard to tell which end is which.

name: Bayleef
flavor_text: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.

name: Bayleef
flavor_text: The scent of spices comes from around its neck. Somehow, sniffing it makes you want to fight.

name: Clefairy
flavor_text: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.

name: Croconaw
flavor_text: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

name: Croconaw
flavor_text: It opens its huge jaws wide when attacking. If it loses any fangs while biting, they grow back in.

name: Electabuzz
flavor_text: Electricity runs across the surface of its body. In darkness, its entire body glows a whitish-blue.

name: Flaaffy
flavor_text: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.

name: Furret
flavor_text: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.

name: Gloom
flavor_text: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

name: Granbull
flavor_text: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If attacked, it flails about to fend off its attacker.

name: Lanturn
flavor_text: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.

name: Ledian
flavor_text: When the stars flicker in the night sky, Ledian flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.

name: Magmar
flavor_text: It dislikes cold places, so it blows scorching flames to make the environment suitable for itself.

name: Miltank
flavor_text: Its milk is packed with nutrition, making it the ultimate beverage for the sick or weary.

name: Noctowl
flavor_text: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.

name: Phanpy
flavor_text: It swings its long snout around playfully, but, because it is so strong, that can be dangerous.

name: Piloswine
flavor_text: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.

name: Quagsire
flavor_text: Due to its relaxed and carefree attitude, it often bumps its head on boulders and boat hulls as it swims.

name: Quilava
flavor_text: This Pokémon is fully covered by nonflammable fur. It can withstand any kind of fire attack.

name: Quilava
flavor_text: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.

name: Seadra
flavor_text: An examination of its cells revealed the presence of a gene not found in Horsea. It became a hot topic.

name: Skiploom
flavor_text: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluctuates up and down.

name: Sunflora
flavor_text: It converts sunlight into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.

name: Togepi
flavor_text: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping Togepi stand up.

name: Xatu
flavor_text: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

name: Chikorita
flavor_text: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up the sun's rays.

name: Chikorita
flavor_text: Its pleasantly aromatic leaf has the ability to check the humidity and temperature.

name: Chinchou
flavor_text: It shoots positive and negative electricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.

name: Cyndaquil
flavor_text: It usually stays hunched over. If it is angry or surprised, it shoots flames out of its back.

name: Cyndaquil
flavor_text: It is timid and always curls itself up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.

name: Girafarig
flavor_text: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent and bite.

name: Gligar
flavor_text: It flies straight at its target's face, then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

name: Hoothoot
flavor_text: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast that the movement can rarely be seen.

name: Hoppip
flavor_text: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. They do enjoy gentle breezes, though.

name: Horsea
flavor_text: If attacked by a larger enemy, it quickly swims to safety by adeptly controlling its dorsal fin.

name: Ledyba
flavor_text: It is very timid. It's afraid to move if alone, but it's active if in a group.

name: Mantine
flavor_text: Swimming freely in open seas, it may fly out of the water and over the waves if it builds up enough speed.

name: Mareep
flavor_text: If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.

name: Marill
flavor_text: The end of its tail serves as a buoy that keeps it from drowning, even in a vicious current.

name: Natu
flavor_text: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

name: Oddish
flavor_text: Awakened by moonlight, it roams actively at night. In the day it stays quietly underground.

name: Onix
flavor_text: It twists and squirms through the ground. The thunderous roar of its tunneling echoes a long way.

name: Pikachu
flavor_text: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

name: Sentret
flavor_text: A very cautious Pokémon, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.

name: Shuckle
flavor_text: The Berries it stores in its vaselike shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.

name: Slowpoke
flavor_text: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.

name: Snubbull
flavor_text: Although it looks frightening, it is actually kind and affectionate. It is very popular.

name: Spinarak
flavor_text: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.

name: Stantler
flavor_text: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

name: Sudowoodo
flavor_text: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears to be closer to a rock than a plant.

name: Sunkern
flavor_text: It may drop out of the sky suddenly. If attacked by a Spearow, it violently shakes its leaves.

name: Swinub
flavor_text: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

name: Totodile
flavor_text: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

name: Totodile
flavor_text: Its well-developed jaws are powerful and capable of crushing anything. Even its trainer must be careful.

name: Wooper
flavor_text: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It leaves the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

name: Arcade Game
rules: Shuffle your deck, then reveal the top 3 cards of it. If at least 2 of those cards share the same name, put all the ones with that name into your hand and shuffle the rest into your deck. If none of them do, shuffle all 3 into your deck.

name: Ecogym
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. | Whenever an attack, Pokémon Power, or Trainer card discards another player's non-Colorless Energy card from a Pokémon, return that Energy card to its owner's hand. (Energy cards that are discarded when that Pokémon is Knocked Out don't count.)

name: Energy Charge
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, shuffle up to 2 Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.

name: Focus Band
rules: Attach Focus Band to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. | If the Pokémon Focus Band is attached to would be Knocked Out by your opponent's attack, flip a coin. If heads, that Pokémon is not Knocked Out and its remaining HP become 10 instead. Then, discard Focus Band.

name: Mary
rules: Draw 2 cards. Then, shuffle 2 cards from your hand into your deck.

name: PokéGear
rules: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. If any of them are Trainer cards, you may show 1 of them to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. You can't play any more Trainer cards this turn.

name: Super Energy Retrieval
rules: Trade 2 of the other cards in your hand for 4 basic Energy cards from your discard pile. If you have fewer than 4 basic Energy cards there, take all of them.

name: Time Capsule
rules: Your opponent may choose 5 Basic Pokémon, Evolution, and/or basic Energy cards in his or her discard pile. (If your opponent doesn't have that many, he or she chooses all or none of them.) If your opponent chooses any cards, he or she shuffles them into his or her deck. Either way, you may do the same, and you can't play any more Trainer cards this turn.

name: Bill's Teleporter
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, draw 4 cards.

name: Card-Flip Game
rules: Choose 1 of your opponent's face-down Prizes. Guess whether it is an Energy card, a Trainer card, or a Pokémon (Basic or Evolution) card. Flip the card face up (and leave it face up). If you guessed right, draw 2 cards.

name: Gold Berry
rules: Attach Gold Berry to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. | At any time between turns, if there are at least 4 damage counters on the Pokémon Gold Berry is attached to, you may remove 4 of them and discard Gold Berry. At the start of each turn, if there are at least 4 damage counters on the Pokémon Gold Berry is attached to, remove 4 of them and discard Gold Berry.

name: Miracle Berry
rules: Attach Miracle Berry to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. | At any time between turns, if the Pokémon Miracle Berry is attached to is Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned, you may remove all those effects from that Pokémon and discard Miracle Berry. At the start of each turn, if the Pokémon Miracle Berry is attached to is Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned, remove all of those effects from that Pokémon and discard Miracle Berry.

name: New Pokédex
rules: Shuffle your deck. Then, look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck and rearrange them as you like.

name: Professor Elm
rules: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 7 cards. You can't play any more Trainer cards this turn.

name: Sprout Tower
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. | All damage done by Colorless Pokémon's attacks is reduced by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

name: Super Scoop Up
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, return 1 of your Pokémon and all cards attached to it to your hand.

name: Berry
rules: Attach Berry to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. | At any time between turns, if there are at least 2 damage counters on the Pokémon Berry is attached to, you may remove 2 of them and discard Berry. At the start of each turn, if there are at least 2 damage counters on the Pokémon Berry is attached to, remove 2 of them and discard Berry.

name: Double Gust
rules: If you have any Benched Pokémon, your opponent chooses 1 of them and switches it with your Active Pokémon. Then, if your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 1 of them and switch it with his or her Active Pokémon.

name: Moo-Moo Milk
rules: Choose 1 of your Pokémon. Flip 2 coins. Remove 2 damage counters times the number of heads from that Pokémon. If the Pokémon has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

name: Pokémon March
rules: Your opponent may search his or her deck for 1 Basic Pokémon card and put it onto his or her Bench. Then, you may search your deck for 1 Basic Pokémon card and put it onto your Bench. Then, each player shuffles his or her deck. (A player can't do any of this if his or her Bench is full.)

name: Super Rod
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, put an Evolution card from your discard pile, if any, into your hand. If tails, put a Basic Pokémon card from your discard pile, if any, into your hand.

name: Darkness Energy
rules:
If the Pokémon Darkness Energy is attached to damages the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), the attack does 10 more damage to the Defending Pokémon. At the end of every turn, put 1 damage counter on the Pokémon Darkness Energy is attached to, unless it's Darkness or has Dark in its name.
Darkness Energy provides Darkness Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

name: Recycle Energy
rules: Recycle Energy provides Colorless Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.) | If this card is put into your discard pile from play, return it to your hand.

rules: Search your deck for a card with Unown in its name and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. (You can't play this card if your Bench is full.)

rules: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, search your deck for a Basic Energy card. Show that card to your opponent, then put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

name: Mew
flavor_text: This Pokémon's body is covered by fine hairs that can be seen only under a microscope.

name: Pidgeot
flavor_text: This Pokémon searches for food while flying at Mach 2. Its large claws make fearsome weapons.

name: Onix
flavor_text: This Pokémon burrows through the earth at high speed, looking for food. The tunnels it digs are used by Diglett as nests.

name: Togepi
flavor_text: This Pokémon is still immature. When threatened, it releases poison from its head and tries to drive its enemies away.

name: Ivysaur

name: Raticate
flavor_text: This Pokémon sometimes hunts for food in rivers, swimming using the small webs between the toes on its rear legs.

name: Ledyba

name: Jigglypuff
flavor_text: After lulling its enemies with its large eyes, this Pokémon sings them to sleep with a relaxing melody.

name: Butterfree
flavor_text: The poison scales on its wings are waterproof, allowing this Pokémon to be active even on rainy days.

name: Tentacruel
flavor_text: This Pokémon attacks its prey with its eighty toxin-producing tentacles.

name: Marill
flavor_text: This Pokémon's fur repels water like a duck's feathers, allowing it to stay dry and fluffy even in water.

name: Lapras

name: Exeggutor

name: Slowking
flavor_text: Its nonchalant reaction to everything somehow gives this Pokémon an imposing presence.

name: Wartortle
flavor_text: When attacked, this Pokémon withdraws into its shell, although it can't quite pull in all of its long tail.

name: Lickitung
flavor_text: This Pokémon uses its six-foot tongue as if it were a hand. The origin of its anaesthetic properties is still a mystery.

name: Vileplume
flavor_text: This Pokémon makes a loud jangling noise when it shakes its petals to spread poison powder.

name: Primeape

name: Ampharos

name: Entei

name: Ho-oh

name: Kingdra

name: Lugia

name: Raikou

flavor_text: Its brightly lit tail can be seen for miles in the dark, even by ships on the sea.

name: Dark Crobat
flavor_text: Although the wings it has evolved on its feet allow it to fly at high speeds, they unfortunately make it difficult to perch.

name: Dark Donphan
flavor_text: The larger its tusks, the higher its status in the herd.

name: Dark Espeon
flavor_text: The tips of its split tail quiver whenever it uses its psychic abilities to read its opponent's next move.

name: Dark Feraligatr
flavor_text: Its powerful muscles allow it to move at a speed that belies its bulk.

name: Dark Gengar
flavor_text: It absorbs the heat in the air around it. If you suddenly feel cold, it's because a Gengar has appeared.

name: Dark Houndoom
flavor_text: The flame it breathes is actually a volatile poison it produces internally that ignites when exposed to air.

name: Dark Porygon2
flavor_text: Advances in technology have allowed it to evolve. It occasionally displays behavior not found in its programming.

name: Dark Scizor
flavor_text: Nothing can withstand the pressure of the vise-like grip of this Pokémon's steel claws.

name: Dark Typhlosion
flavor_text: When it's in combat, the air around it shimmers and warps from the intense heat it produces.

name: Dark Tyranitar
flavor_text: Its power is such that not even mountains can stand in its way.

name: Light Arcanine
flavor_text: This legendary Chinese Pokémon is easily recognized by its large flowing mane.

name: Light Azumarill
flavor_text: It curls up its long ears when swimming to prevent water from entering them.

name: Light Dragonite
flavor_text: It is said to fly constantly over the sea, looking for people in need of aid.

name: Light Togetic
flavor_text: It becomes depressed if it is not near kind-hearted people. Is is able to float in the air without moving its wings.

name: Miracle Energy
rules:
You can't have more than 1 Miracle Energy in your deck. Attach Miracle Energy to 1 of your Shining or Light Pokémon. At the end of your turn, discard Miracle Energy.
While in play, Miracle Energy counts as every type of Energy but provides only 2 Energy at a time.

name: Dark Ariados
flavor_text: Wherever it goes, it spins a thread that always leads back to its web.

name: Dark Magcargo
flavor_text: The shell on its back comes off easily, exposing the flames running through its body.

name: Dark Omastar
flavor_text: Nothing can escape once wrapped in its tentacles, which it uses for self-defense as well as to catch food.

name: Dark Slowking
flavor_text: Each time it yawns, the Shellder on its head releases an enzyme that makes it grow even smarter.

name: Dark Ursaring
flavor_text: Its keen nose can pick out any scent, even that of food buried deep underground.

name: Light Dragonair
flavor_text: The aura it projects from its body has an effect on the surrounding climate and weather.

name: Light Lanturn
flavor_text: This Pokémon has evolved its dorsal fin to emit light, which attracts the fish it feeds on.

name: Light Ledian
flavor_text: The number of spots on its back increase or decrease depending on the number of stars visible in the night sky.

name: Light Machamp
flavor_text: It uses its four arms in combat to unleash a ceaseless flurry of punches.

name: Light Piloswine
flavor_text: Its legs are short, but its hooves are wide and flat, allowing it to easily walk over snow.

flavor_text: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

name: Chansey
flavor_text: It holds its egg carefully when moving so as not to break it. Still, it is fast enough to disappear in the blink of an eye.

name: Dark Croconaw
flavor_text: It has 49 teeth in its mouth that are constantly replacing themselves. Pull one out, and a new one grows in.

name: Dark Exeggutor
flavor_text: If one of its heads falls off, it turns into an Exeggcute, which begins to look for other Exeggcutes using a special form of telepathy.

name: Dark Flaaffy
flavor_text: As a result of storing massive amounts of electricity there, it can no longer grow wool on certain areas of its body.

name: Dark Forretress
flavor_text: It stays motionless in trees, driving away with flying armored shards from its hard shell any who come close.

name: Dark Haunter
flavor_text: It silently hunts its prey in dark rooms.

name: Dark Omanyte
flavor_text: This ancient Pokémon possessed 10 tentacles, which it used to swim through the ocean.

name: Dark Pupitar
flavor_text: It is encased within a hard shell, yet retains a great deal of mobility—a dangerous combination.

name: Dark Quilava
flavor_text: If it turns its back to an opponent, it is a sign that it is getting ready to attack.

name: Dark Wigglytuff
flavor_text: This Pokémon has soft, fine hair. When angered, it increases in size and has been known to charge those it considers a threat.

name: Heracross
flavor_text: It is normally peaceful, but will attack any who get between it and honey, its favorite food.

name: Hitmonlee
flavor_text: It has a perfect sense of balance and can lash out with powerful kicks from any position.

name: Houndour
flavor_text: When night falls, the air fills with the eerie cries of this Pokémon as it stakes out its territory.

name: Jigglypuff
flavor_text: If puffs its body up like a balloon and sings a lullaby that makes all who hear it fall into a deep sleep.

name: Light Dewgong
flavor_text: It has an aerodynamic shape that allows it to swim at great speeds. The colder the water gets, the more active it becomes.

name: Light Flareon
flavor_text: It creates its flames by swallowing air into a special pouch within its body, then heating it to over 3000 degrees.

name: Light Golduck
flavor_text: The faster it swims, the brighter the glow on its forehead becomes.

name: Light Jolteon
flavor_text: It can collect the ambient electrical energy in its cells and expel it in massive bursts.

name: Light Machoke
flavor_text: This Pokémon never gets tired, no matter what it does or how hard it works.

name: Light Ninetales
flavor_text: It is said that each of its nine tails contains a different magical power.

name: Light Slowbro
flavor_text: If the Shellder attached to its tail becomes separated, this Pokémon reverts to a normal Slowpoke.

name: Light Vaporeon
flavor_text: If its fins being to vibrate, it is a sign that it will begin raining soon.

name: Light Venomoth
flavor_text: It defends itself by flapping its wings at high speed, spreading poisonous powder throughout the air.

name: Light Wigglytuff
flavor_text: If two of them brush against each other, they will not be able to separate themselves, as they enjoy touching each other's soft fur too much.

name: Scyther
flavor_text: It moves so fast as to be invisible to the naked eye. Even when standing still, its camouflage prevents it from being seen.

name: Togepi
flavor_text: Its shell is said to contain happiness itself, which it will share with those who are kind to it.

name: Unown [C]
rules: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names.
flavor_text: It is believed that the variety of types of this Pokémon were created by evolutionary adaptation, as each possesses a different ability.

name: Cyndaquil
flavor_text: It is very meek and constantly crouches in a defensive posture. When threatened, it protects itself with the flame on its back.

name: Dark Octillery
flavor_text: It likes to sleep in rock caves and will even steal other Octillery's nests.

name: Dratini
flavor_text: Large from birth, this Pokémon increases in size throughout its life by regularly shedding its skin.

name: Exeggcute
flavor_text: Its shell is very durable, allowing it to survive even if the shell becomes cracked.

name: Gastly
flavor_text: Its gas-like body allows it to enter almost anywhere, but it is vulnerable to high winds.

name: Girafarig
flavor_text: Its tail has a brain of its own, which can respond to stimuli such as scents. Many unsuspecting people have been bitten by it.

name: Gligar
flavor_text: It spends its days hanging from cliffs, swooping down on any prey it spots from its high vantage point.

name: Growlithe
flavor_text: It fears nothing, not even opponents larger than itself.

name: Hitmonchan
flavor_text: Its punches are blindingly fast, but it can only fight for three minutes before tiring and needing to rest.

name: Larvitar
flavor_text: It is born deep within the ground and has to burrow its way out.

name: Ledyba
flavor_text: Sensitive to cold, Ledyba gather in groups to share warmth when the temperature drops.

name: Light Sunflora
flavor_text: Although it is extremely active during the day, it stops moving entirely as soon as the sun sets.

name: Machop
flavor_text: When bored, this super-strong Pokémon trains by lifting rocks.

name: Mantine
flavor_text: This Pokémon is perfectly adapted to its ocean home. It can gather up enough speed to burst above the water like a whale.

name: Mareep
flavor_text: Its soft wool coat captures air, allowing it to remain cool during the summer and warm in the winter.

name: Phanpy
flavor_text: It hits people with its nose as a sign of affection but doesn't know its own strength and so sometimes knocks people off their feet.

name: Pineco
flavor_text: It waits suspended from tree branches for insects to fly into its mouth, often not moving for hours at a time.

name: Porygon
flavor_text: This Pokémon was created by human computer engineering. Its program is only capable of simple action and reaction.

name: Psyduck
flavor_text: Although possessed of great mental powers, it doesn't know how to use them.

name: Remoraid
flavor_text: It can shoot a burst of water from its mouth to propel itself backward at high speeds, allowing it to flee from surprised enemies.

name: Seel
flavor_text: Although clumsy on land, it moves easily through the arctic waters it calls home.

name: Slugma
flavor_text: This Pokémon is often seen crawling around in volcanic regions.

name: Sunkern
flavor_text: It is very small and powerless. If attacked, the best it can do is flap its leaves in an attempt to frighten away its enemies.

name: Swinub
flavor_text: It moves with its sensitive nose pressed to the ground, always searching for food.

name: Totodile
flavor_text: Its highly developed jaws are powerful enough to crush anything. Even experienced adult trainers must handle it with great caution.

name: Venonat
flavor_text: It possesses a type of radar, which it can use to find the insects it eats for food, even in pitch darkness.

name: Vulpix
flavor_text: As it grows older, its white tail changes colors and splits into six different tails. Its body radiates a faint warmth.

name: Broken Ground Gym
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. | Each player pays Colorless more to retreat a Baby Pokémon or Basic Pokémon.

name: EXP.ALL
rules: Attach EXP.ALL to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. | During your opponent's turn, if your Active Pokémon would be Knocked Out by your opponent's attack, you may take 1 of the basic Energy cards attached to your Active Pokémon and attach it to the Pokémon with EXP.ALL attached to it. If you do, discard EXP.ALL.

name: Impostor Professor Oak's Invention
rules: Look at your opponent's Prize cards. You may have your opponent shuffle them into his or her deck. If you do, your opponent takes that many cards from the top of his or her deck and sets them aside as his or her new Prize cards (without looking at them).

name: Radio Tower
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. | Once during each player's turn (before attacking), that player may look at the top 2 cards of his or her deck and put them back in the same order.

name: Thought Wave Machine
rules: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, return an Energy card attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon to your opponent's hand. If the Pokémon has fewer attached Energy cards than that, return all of them to your opponent's hand. Your turn is over now (you don't get to attack).

name: Counterattack Claws
rules: Attach Counterattack Claws to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. | During your opponent's turn, if the Pokémon Counterattack Claws is attached to is your Active Pokémon and an opponent's attack damages it (even if it is Knocked Out), flip a coin. If heads, put 2 damage counters on the Defending Pokémon. Then, discard Counterattack Claws.

name: Energy Amplifier
rules: Choose an Energy card in your hand, show it to your opponent, and shuffle it into your deck. Then flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for up to 3 basic Energy cards. Show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

name: Energy Stadium
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. | Once during each player's turn (before attacking), that player may flip a coin. If heads, that player puts a basic Energy card from his or her discard pile into his or her hand.

name: Lucky Stadium
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. | Once during each player's turn (before attacking), that player may flip a coin. If heads, that player draws a card.

name: Magnifier
rules: Attach Magnifier to 1 of your Pokémon. At the end of your turn, discard Magnifier. If the Pokémon Magnifier is attached to attacks, don't apply Resistance for that attack.

name: Pokémon Personality Test
rules: Put an Evolution card from your hand face down in front of you. Your opponent guesses whether it is a Pokémon card with Light in its name, a Pokémon card with Dark in its name, or neither one. Flip the card over. If your opponent guessed right, he or she draws 3 cards. If your opponent guessed wrong, you draw 3 cards. Either way, return the card to your hand.

name: Team Rocket's Evil Deeds
rules: Look at your opponent's hand and choose a card there. Your opponent shuffles that card into his or her deck. Then, your opponent may draw up to 2 cards.

name: Heal Powder
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, your Active Pokémon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, or Poisoned and remove 2 damage counters from it. If your Active Pokémon has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

name: Mail from Bill
rules: You can't play this card if you have 5 or more cards in your hand (including this one). Draw cards until you have exactly 4 cards in your hand.

name: Shining Celebi
rules: You can't have more than 1 Shining Celebi in your deck.
flavor_text: It is worshipped as a god of the forest. It appears only in undisturbed old-growth forests.

name: Shining Charizard
rules: You can't have more than 1 Shining Charizard in your deck.
flavor_text: The flames it breathes are so hot that they can melt anything.

name: Shining Kabutops
rules: You can't have more than 1 Shining Kabutops in your deck.
flavor_text: This ancient Pokémon uses its razor-sharp claws to cut open its prey and gain access to its blood.

name: Shining Mewtwo
rules: You can't have more than 1 Shining Mewtwo in your deck.
flavor_text: It uses its highly developed psychic powers to defeat its enemies before they even have time to think.

name: Shining Noctowl
rules: You can't have more than 1 Shining Noctowl in your deck.
flavor_text: It speeds up its thought processes by turning its head around 180 degrees.

name: Shining Raichu
rules: You can't have more than 1 Shining Raichu in your deck.
flavor_text: If the electricity in its cheeks runs out, it sticks its tail straight up and uses it to collect energy from the air.

name: Shining Steelix
rules: You can't have more than 1 Shining Steelix in your deck.
flavor_text: If an Onix lives 100 years or more, its skin hardens, eventually becoming even harder than a diamond.

name: Shining Tyranitar
rules: You can't have more than 1 Shining Tyranitar in your deck.
flavor_text: It is so powerful, it can knock down a mountain with hust one arm.

name: Alakazam
flavor_text: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5000.

name: Articuno
flavor_text: A legendary bird Pokémon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

name: Charizard
flavor_text: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to unintentionally cause forest fires.

name: Dark Blastoise
flavor_text: An aggressive Pokémon that tackles anything it sees.

name: Dark Dragonite
flavor_text: Sometimes called "The God of Destruction." Its wings are able to support it in spite of its massive weight.

name: Dark Persian
flavor_text: Popular with women because of its beautiful fur. The leader of the Rockets keeps one as a pet.

name: Dark Raichu
flavor_text: Stores up electricity in its body, then suddenly releases it to surprise and shock everyone.

name: Dark Slowbro
flavor_text: It loves nothing better than to be left alone, and so sometimes ends up being manipulated by unscrupulous people.

name: Dark Vaporeon
flavor_text: A Pokémon capable of controlling water, so it is capable of creating giant whirlpools.

name: Flareon
flavor_text: When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature could soar to over 1600 degrees.

name: Gengar
flavor_text: Under a full moon, this Pokémon like to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.

name: Gyarados
flavor_text: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

name: Hitmonlee
flavor_text: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.

name: Jolteon
flavor_text: It accumulates negative ions from the atmosphere to blast out 10,000-volt lightning bolts.

name: Machamp
flavor_text: Using its amazing muscles, it throws powerful punches that can knock its victim clear over the horizon.

name: Muk
flavor_text: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

name: Ninetales
flavor_text: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

name: Venusaur
flavor_text: This plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

name: Zapdos
flavor_text: A legendary bird Pokémon said to appear from clouds while wielding enormous lightning bolts.

name: Beedrill
flavor_text: Flies at high speed and attacks using the large, venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.

name: Butterfree
flavor_text: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

name: Electrode
flavor_text: It stores electrical energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

name: Exeggutor
flavor_text: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an Exeggcute.

name: Golem
flavor_text: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.

name: Hypno
flavor_text: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of psi moves such as Hypnosis and Confusion.

name: Jynx
flavor_text: Merely by meditating, the Pokémon launches a powerful psychic energy attack.

name: Kabutops
flavor_text: Its sleek shape is perfect for swimming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids.

name: Magneton
flavor_text: Formed by several Magnemites linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

name: Mewtwo
flavor_text: A scientist created this Pokémon after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

name: Moltres
flavor_text: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.

name: Nidoking
flavor_text: Uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break its prey's bones.

name: Nidoqueen
flavor_text: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.

name: Pidgeot
flavor_text: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.

name: Pidgeotto
flavor_text: Very protective of its sprawling territory, this Pokémon will fiercely peck at any intruder.

name: Rhydon
flavor_text: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3600 degrees.

name: Arcanine
flavor_text: A Pokémon that has been long admired for its beauty. It runs gracefully, as if on wings.

name: Charmeleon
flavor_text: When it swings its burning tail, it raises the temperature to unbearably high levels.

name: Dark Dragonair
flavor_text: As is fitting for a legendary Pokémon, it has many strange powers, including the ability to make rain or snow fall.

name: Dark Wartortle
flavor_text: A Pokémon with a negative attitude, it hides in its shell whenever it's in a bad mood—which is often.

name: Dewgong
flavor_text: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.

name: Dodrio
flavor_text: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake.

name: Fearow
flavor_text: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.

name: Golduck
flavor_text: Often seen swimming elegantly by lake shores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster, Kappa.

name: Graveler
flavor_text: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.

name: Growlithe
flavor_text: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.

name: Haunter
flavor_text: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from another dimension.

name: Ivysaur
flavor_text: When the bulb on its back grows large, the Pokémon seems to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

name: Kabuto
flavor_text: A Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil found in what was once the ocean floor eons ago.

name: Kadabra
flavor_text: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches even to those just nearby.

name: Kakuna
flavor_text: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself from predators.

name: Machoke
flavor_text: Its muscular body is so powerful that it must wear a power-save belt to help regulate its motions.

name: Magikarp
flavor_text: In the distant past, it was stronger than its horribly weak descendants that exist today.

name: Meowth
flavor_text: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

name: Metapod
flavor_text: It is vulnerable to attack because its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.

name: Nidorina
flavor_text: The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.

name: Nidorino
flavor_text: An aggressive Pokémon that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

name: Omanyte
flavor_text: Although long extinct, in rare cases, it can be genetically resurrected from fossils.

name: Omastar
flavor_text: A prehistoric Pokémon that died out when its heavy shell made it impossible for it to catch prey.

name: Primeape
flavor_text: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until its quarry is caught.

name: Rapidash
flavor_text: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hope of racing it.

name: Raticate
flavor_text: It uses its whiskers to maintain its balance. It seems to slow down if they are cut off.

name: Sandslash
flavor_text: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.

name: Seadra
flavor_text: Capable of swimming backward by rapidly flapping its wing-like pectoral fins and stout tail.

name: Snorlax
flavor_text: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.

name: Tauros
flavor_text: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

name: Tentacruel
flavor_text: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, the are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.

name: Abra
flavor_text: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and teleport to safety.

name: Bulbasaur
flavor_text: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. Thus, a plant sprouted and now grows with this Pokémon.

name: Caterpie
flavor_text: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

name: Charmander
flavor_text: Obviously prefers hot places. If it gets caught in the rain, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

name: Doduo
flavor_text: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.

name: Dratini
flavor_text: Long considered a mythical Pokémon until recently, when a small colony was found living underwater.

name: Drowzee
flavor_text: Not popular with girls because of its attitude. Can often be heard muttering to itself in a low voice.

name: Eevee
flavor_text: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from elemental stones.

name: Exeggcute
flavor_text: Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.

name: Gastly
flavor_text: A mysterious Pokémon. Some say it is a lifeform from another dimension, while others believe it is formed from smog.

name: Geodude
flavor_text: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.

name: Grimer
flavor_text: Appears in filthy areas. Thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.

name: Machop
flavor_text: It's said that not even pro wrestlers can take down a Machop.

name: Magnemite
flavor_text: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses attacks like Thunder Wave.

name: Mankey
flavor_text: Normally friendly, it quickly becomes angry if it doesn't get what it wants.

name: Nidoran ♀
flavor_text: Although small, its venomous barbs make this Pokémon dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

name: Nidoran ♂
flavor_text: Stiffens its ears to sense danger. The larger, more powerful of its horns secretes venom.

name: Onix
flavor_text: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, though colored black.

name: Pidgey
flavor_text: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

name: Pikachu
flavor_text: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

name: Ponyta
flavor_text: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything flat in moments.

name: Psyduck
flavor_text: It is often seen holding its head in its paws, as if it were suffering from a headache.

name: Rattata
flavor_text: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

name: Rhyhorn
flavor_text: Its massive bones are 1,000 times harder than human bones. It can easily knock a trailer flying.

name: Sandshrew
flavor_text: Burrow deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.

name: Seel

name: Electivire

name: Empoleon

name: Infernape

name: Lucario

name: Luxray

name: Manaphy

name: Mismagius
flavor_text: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.

name: Palkia

name: Rhyperior
flavor_text: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. Geodude are shot at rare times.

name: Roserade
flavor_text: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.

name: Shiftry
flavor_text: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.

name: Skuntank
flavor_text: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.

name: Staraptor
flavor_text: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.

name: Torterra
flavor_text: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

name: Azumarill
flavor_text: It lives in rivers and lakes. In water, its coloring and patterns trick the vision of foes.

name: Beautifly
flavor_text: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey's fluids.

name: Bibarel
flavor_text: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

name: Carnivine
flavor_text: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

name: Clefable
flavor_text: Rarely seen by people, it is said to be drawn by the full moon to play at deserted lakes.

name: Drapion
flavor_text: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

name: Drifblim
flavor_text: It's drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.

name: Dustox
flavor_text: A nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.

name: Floatzel
flavor_text: It floats using its well-developed floatation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

name: Gengar
flavor_text: It hides in shadows. It is said that if Gengar is hiding, it cools that area by nearly 10 degrees F.

name: Heracross
flavor_text: It gathers in forests to search for tree sap, its favorite food. It's strong enough to hurl foes.

name: Hippowdon
flavor_text: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.

name: Lopunny
flavor_text: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.

name: Machamp
flavor_text: It punches with its four arms at blinding speed. It can launch 1,000 punches in two seconds.

name: Medicham
flavor_text: Through yoga training, it has honed its sixth sense. Its movements are elegant.

name: Munchlax
flavor_text: It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.

name: Noctowl
flavor_text: Its eyes are special. They can pick out objects as long as there is the tiniest amount of light.

name: Pachirisu
flavor_text: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

name: Purugly
flavor_text: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon's nest and claims it as its own.

name: Snorlax
flavor_text: Its stomach can digest any kind of food, even if it happens to be moldy or rotten.

name: Steelix
flavor_text: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

name: Vespiquen
flavor_text: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by COMBEE.

name: Weavile
flavor_text: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

name: Wobbuffet
flavor_text: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. It is said to be proof the tail hides a secret.

name: Wynaut
flavor_text: It grows strong by pushing up against others en masse. It loves eating sweet fruit.

name: Budew
flavor_text: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.

name: Cascoon
flavor_text: It is hot inside its cocoon. All the cells in its body create the energy for it to evolve.

name: Cherrim
flavor_text: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.

name: Drifloon
flavor_text: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

name: Dusclops
flavor_text: Its body is hollow. It is said that those who look into its body are sucked into the void.

name: Elekid
flavor_text: It generates electricity by whirling its arms. However, it can't store the energy it makes.

name: Grotle
flavor_text: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.

name: Haunter
flavor_text: It can slip through any obstacle. It lurks inside walls to keep an eye on its foes.

name: Hippopotas
flavor_text: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.

name: Luxio
flavor_text: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.

name: Machoke
flavor_text: MACHOKE's boundless power is very dangerous, so it wears a belt that suppresses its energy.

name: Magneton
flavor_text: It is actually three MAGNEMITE linked by magnetism. A group can set off a magnetic storm.

name: Mantyke
flavor_text: A friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.

name: Monferno
flavor_text: To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.

name: Nuzleaf
flavor_text: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.

name: Prinplup
flavor_text: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.

name: Rapidash
flavor_text: It gallops at nearly 150 mph. With its mane blazing ferociously, it races as if it were an arrow.

name: Rhydon
flavor_text: Its brain developed after it stood up on its hind legs. Its drill horn bores tunnels through solid rock.

name: Riolu
flavor_text: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

name: Seaking
flavor_text: It makes its nest by hollowing out boulders in streams with its horn. It defends its eggs with its life.

name: Silcoon
flavor_text: It anchors itself by wrapping twigs with the silk from its body. It motionlessly awaits evolution.

name: Staravia
flavor_text: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.

name: Unown [A]

name: Unown [B]

name: Bidoof
flavor_text: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

name: Bonsly
flavor_text: It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body's fluid levels by eliminating excess.

name: Buizel
flavor_text: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.

name: Buneary
flavor_text: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.

name: Chimchar

name: Clefairy
flavor_text: Thought to live with others on quiet mountains, it is popular for its adorable nature.

name: Cleffa
flavor_text: Its silhouette is like a star. It is believed to arrive riding on shooting stars.

name: Combee
flavor_text: A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to VESPIQUEN.

name: Duskull
flavor_text: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.

name: Electabuzz
flavor_text: Half of all blackouts occur when this Pokémon appears at power plants and eats electricity.

name: Gastly
flavor_text: This Pokémon's body is 95% made up of gases, which are blown away by strong gusts of wind.

name: Glameow
flavor_text: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness if very popular among some.

name: Goldeen

name: Mime Jr.

name: Misdreavus

name: Piplup
