flavor_text: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.

name: Celebi
flavor_text: It has the power to travel across time, but is is said to appear only in peaceful times.

name: Feraligatr
flavor_text: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

name: Garchomp
flavor_text: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.

name: Honchkrow
flavor_text: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous MURKROW in tow.

name: Lumineon
flavor_text: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.

name: Magmortar
flavor_text: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

name: Meganium
flavor_text: Its breath has the fantastic ability to revive dead plants and flowers.

name: Mesprit
flavor_text: Known as "The Being of Emotion." It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

name: Raichu
flavor_text: It turns aggressive if it has too much electricity in its body. It discharges power through its tail.

name: Typhlosion
flavor_text: It attacks using blasts of fire. It creates heat shimmers with intense fire to hide itself.

name: Tyranitar
flavor_text: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.

name: Uxie
flavor_text: Known as "The Being of Knowledge." It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

name: Abomasnow
flavor_text: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.

name: Ariados
flavor_text: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.

name: Bastiodon
flavor_text: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.

name: Chimecho
flavor_text: To knock foes flying, it makes the air shudder with its cries. It converses using seven cries.

name: Crobat
flavor_text: Having four wings enables it to fly faster and more quietly. It turns active when the night comes.

name: Exeggutor
flavor_text: It is called "The Walking Jungle." If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an EXEGGCUTE.

name: Glalie
flavor_text: To protect itself, it clads its body in an armor of ice, made by freezing moisture in the air.

name: Gyarados
flavor_text: Once it appears, its rage never settles until it has razed the fields and mountains around it.

name: Kricketune
flavor_text: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.

name: Manectric
flavor_text: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

name: Mantine
flavor_text: When the waves are calm, one may encounter a swarm of Mantine swimming as if they are in flight.

name: Mr. Mime
flavor_text: It is a pantomime expert that can create invisible but solid walls using miming gestures.

name: Nidoqueen
flavor_text: Its entire body is armored with hard scales. It will protect the young in its burrow with its life.

name: Ninetales
flavor_text: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.

name: Rampardos
flavor_text: Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.

name: Slaking
flavor_text: The world's laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.

name: Sudowoodo
flavor_text: Despite appearing to be a tree, its body is closer to rocks and stones. It is very weak to water.

name: Toxicroak
flavor_text: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

name: Unown [I]
flavor_text: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

name: Ursaring
flavor_text: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.

name: Walrein
flavor_text: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.

name: Whiscash
flavor_text: It is very territorial. It repels foes by setting of tremors that extend over a three-mile radius.

name: Bayleef
flavor_text: The buds that ring its neck give off a spicy aroma that perks people up.

name: Chingling
flavor_text: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.

name: Cranidos
flavor_text: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.

name: Croconaw
flavor_text: Once it bites down, it won't let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.

name: Dewgong
flavor_text: In snow, the pure white coat covering its body obscures it from predators.

name: Dodrio
flavor_text: When DODUO evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. It runs at nearly 40 mph.

name: Dunsparce
flavor_text: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

name: Gabite
flavor_text: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scale will heal even incurable illnesses.

name: Girafarig
flavor_text: Its tail also has a small brain. It bites to repel any foe trying to sneak up on it from behind.

name: Golbat
flavor_text: It loves the blood of humans and Pokémon. It flies around at night in search of neck veins.

name: Graveler
flavor_text: GRAVELER make their homes on sheer cliff faces by gouging out numerous horizontal holes.

name: Happiny
flavor_text: It loves round white things. It carries and egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.

name: Lairon
flavor_text: For food, it digs up iron ore. It smashes its steely body against others to fight over territory.

name: Magmar
flavor_text: Born in the spout of a volcano, its body is covered by flames that shimmer like the sun.

name: Masquerain
flavor_text: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.

name: Nidorina
flavor_text: When it senses danger, it raises all the barbs on its body. These barbs grow slower than NIDORINO's.

name: Octillery
flavor_text: It lives in the gaps of boulders and in holes on the seafloor. Its suction cups grip prey tightly.

name: Parasect
flavor_text: A mushroom grown larger than the host's body controls PARASECT. It scatters poisonous spores.

name: Pupitar
flavor_text: Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.

name: Quilava
flavor_text: It intimidates foes with the heat of its flames. The fire burn more strongly when it readies to fight.

name: Sandslash
flavor_text: It curls up, then rolls into foes with its back. Its sharp spines inflict severe damage.

name: Sealeo
flavor_text: It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so, it learns textures and odors.

name: Shieldon
flavor_text: A Pokémon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.

name: Tropius
flavor_text: Because it continually ate only its favorite fruit, the fruit started growing around its neck.

name: Unown [E]
flavor_text: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

name: Unown [M]
flavor_text: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

name: Unown [T]
flavor_text: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

name: Vigoroth
flavor_text: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still even for a moment.

name: Abra
flavor_text: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. Even when awake, it teleports itself while remaining seated.

name: Aipom
flavor_text: It uses its tail to pluck fruits that are out of reach. Its tail is more adept than its real hands.

name: Aron
flavor_text: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

name: Barboach
flavor_text: It coats its entire body with a slimy fluid so it can squirm and slip away if grabbed.

name: Bidoof
rules: Wacan Berry: Any damage done to Bidoof by attacks from Lightning Pokémon is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

name: Bronzor
flavor_text: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

name: Buizel
rules: Chesto Berry: If Buizel is Asleep, remove the Special Condition Asleep from Buizel at the end of each player's turn.

name: Chansey
flavor_text: It is said to deliver happiness. Being compassionate, it shares its eggs with injured people.

name: Chikorita
flavor_text: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

name: Croagunk
flavor_text: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

name: Cyndaquil
flavor_text: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

name: Doduo
flavor_text: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

name: Electrike
flavor_text: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

name: Exeggcute
flavor_text: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.

name: Finneon
flavor_text: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.

name: Geodude
flavor_text: Many live on mountain trails and remain half buried while keeping an eye on climbers.

name: Gible
flavor_text: It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.

name: Kricketot
flavor_text: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.

name: Larvitar
flavor_text: A Pokémon that eats soil. Once it has eaten a large mountain, it goes to sleep so it can grow.

name: Magby
flavor_text: Its body temperature is around 1,100 degrees F. It is healthy if it is breathing yellow flames.

name: Magikarp
flavor_text: It is said to be the world's weakest Pokémon. No one knows why it has managed to survive.

name: Murkrow
flavor_text: It is believed that seeing this Pokémon at night will bring about ominous occurrences.

name: Nidoran ♀
flavor_text: While it does not prefer to fight, even one drop of the poison it secretes from barbs can be fatal.

name: Paras
flavor_text: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host PARAS.

name: Pichu
flavor_text: The electric pouches on its cheeks are still small. They cannot store much electricity yet.

name: Pikachu
flavor_text: It lives in forests with others. It stores electricity in the pouches on its cheeks.

name: Remoraid
flavor_text: It squirts water forcefully from its mouth to shoot down flying prey.

name: Sandshrew
flavor_text: To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.

name: Seel
flavor_text: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.

name: Shinx
rules: Rawst Berry: If Shinx is Burned, remove the Special Condition Burned from Shinx at the end of each player's turn.

name: Slakoth
flavor_text: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.

name: Snorunt
flavor_text: In the snow country, certain folklore says a house will prosper if a SNORUNT lives there.

name: Snover
flavor_text: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.

name: Spheal
flavor_text: It rolls across ice floes to reach shore because its body is poorly shaped for swimming.

name: Spinarak
flavor_text: It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but strong silk. It waits motionlessly for prey to arrive.

name: Surskit
flavor_text: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.

name: Teddiursa
flavor_text: It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them all the time. Every sets of paws tastes unique.

name: Totodile
flavor_text: It has the habit of biting anything with its developed jaws. Even its Trainer need to be careful.

name: Vulpix
flavor_text: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.

name: Zubat
flavor_text: Even though it has no eyes, it can sense obstacles using ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.

name: Bebe's Search
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card. | Choose a card from your hand and put it on top of your deck. Search your deck for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. (If this is the only card in your hand, you can't play this card.)

name: Dusk Ball
rules: Look at the 7 cards from the bottom of your deck. Choose 1 Pokémon you find there, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Put the remaining cards back on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward.

name: Fossil Excavator
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card. | Search your deck or discard pile for a Trainer card that has Fossil in its name or a Stage 1 or Stage 2 Evolution card that evolves from a Fossil. Show it to your opponent and put it into your hand. If you searched your deck, shuffle your deck afterward.

name: Lake Boundary
rules: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card. | Apply Weakness for each Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's) as ×2 instead.

name: Night Maintenance
rules: Search your discard pile for up to 3 in any combination of Pokémon and basic Energy cards. Show them to your opponent and shuffle them into your deck.

name: Quick Ball
rules: Reveal cards from your deck until you reveal a Pokémon. Show that Pokémon to your opponent and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other revealed cards back into your deck. (If you don't reveal a Pokémon, shuffle all the revealed cards back into your deck.)

name: Team Galactic's Wager
rules: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card. | Each player shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck, and you and your opponent play "Rock-Paper-Scissors." The player who wins draws up to 6 cards. The player who loses draws up to 3 cards. (You draw your cards first.)

name: Armor Fossil
rules: Play Armor Fossil as if it were a Colorless Basic Pokémon. (Armor Fossil counts as a Trainer card as well, but if Armor Fossil is Knocked Out, this counts as a Knocked Out Pokémon.) Armor Fossil can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat. At any time during your turn before your attack, you may discard Armor Fossil from play. (This doesn't count as a Knocked Out Pokémon.)

name: Skull Fossil
rules: Play Skull Fossil as if it were a Colorless Basic Pokémon. (Skull Fossil counts as a Trainer card as well, but if Skull Fossil is Knocked Out, this counts as a Knocked Out Pokémon.) Skull Fossil can't be affected by any Special Conditions and can't retreat. At any time during your turn before your attack, you may discard Skull Fossil from play. (This doesn't count as a Knocked Out Pokémon.)

name: Multi Energy
rules: Attach Multi Energy to 1 of your Pokémon. While in play, Multi Energy provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time. (Has no effect other than providing Energy.) Multi Energy provides Colorless Energy when attached to a Pokémon that already has Special Energy cards attached to it.

name: Darkness Energy
rules: If the Pokémon Darkness Energy is attached to attacks, the attack does 10 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). Ignore this effect if the Pokémon that Darkness Energy is attached to isn't Darkness. Darkness Energy provides Darkness Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

name: Metal Energy
rules: Damage done by attacks to the Pokémon that Metal Energy is attached to is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance). Ignore this effect if the Pokémon that Metal Energy is attached to isn't Metal. Metal Energy provides Metal Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)

name: Electivire LV.X
rules: Put this card onto your Active Electivire. Electivire LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

name: Lucario LV.X
rules: Put this card onto your Active Lucario. Lucario LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

name: Magmortar LV.X
rules: Put this card onto your Active Magmortar. Magmortar LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

name: Time-Space Distortion
rules: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, search your discard pile for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand.

name: Bastiodon
flavor_text: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.

name: Lucario
flavor_text: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

name: Manaphy
flavor_text: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

name: Pachirisu
flavor_text: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

name: Rampardos
flavor_text: Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.

name: Drifloon
flavor_text: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

name: Gible
rules: Oran Berry: Remove 1 damage counter from Gible at the end of your turn.

name: Riolu
flavor_text: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

name: Pikachu
rules: Oran Berry: Remove 1 damage counter from Pikachu at the end of your turn.

name: Staravia
flavor_text: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.

name: Bidoof
flavor_text: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

name: Buneary
flavor_text: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling is rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.

name: Cherubi
flavor_text: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.

name: Chimchar
flavor_text: It agilely scales cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

name: Piplup
flavor_text: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

name: Starly
flavor_text: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

name: Turtwig
flavor_text: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

name: Ampharos
flavor_text: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail's light.

name: Blastoise
flavor_text: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

name: Charizard
flavor_text: It is said that CHARIZARD's fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.

name: Entei
flavor_text: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

name: Flygon
flavor_text: It whips up sandstorms with powerful flaps of its wings. It is known as "The Desert Spirit."

name: Gallade
flavor_text: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.

name: Gardevoir
flavor_text: It will try to guard its trusted Trainer with its life. It has the ability to see the future.

name: Gastrodon East Sea
flavor_text: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.

name: Gastrodon West Sea
flavor_text: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.

name: Ho-Oh
flavor_text: Its feathers are in seven colors. It is said that anyone seeing it is promised eternal happiness.

name: Jumpluff
flavor_text: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.

name: Lickilicky
flavor_text: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting to close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

name: Ludicolo
flavor_text: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can't help breaking out into a dance.

name: Lugia
flavor_text: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.

name: Mew
flavor_text: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe MEW to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

name: Raikou
flavor_text: It is said to have fallen with lightning. It can fire thunderbolts from the rain clouds on its back.

name: Roserade
flavor_text: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.

name: Salamence
flavor_text: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changes, and wings grew out.

name: Suicune
flavor_text: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.

name: Venusaur
flavor_text: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.

name: Absol
flavor_text: It senses disasters coming and appears before people only to warn them of impending danger.

name: Arcanine
flavor_text: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.

name: Banette
flavor_text: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.

name: Dugtrio
flavor_text: Its three heads moves alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.

name: Electivire
flavor_text: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

name: Electrode
flavor_text: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

name: Furret
flavor_text: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.

name: Golduck
flavor_text: A Pokémon that lives in lakes. It swims faster than any human swimming champion.

name: Golem
flavor_text: It sheds its hide once a year. Its boulderlike body is so tough, even dynamite can't harm it.

name: Jynx
flavor_text: It cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.

name: Magmortar
flavor_text: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

name: Minun
flavor_text: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

name: Mothim
flavor_text: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by COMBEE.

name: Nidoking
flavor_text: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.

name: Pidgeot
flavor_text: By flapping its wings with all its might, PIDGEOT can make a gust of wind capable of bending tall trees.

name: Plusle
flavor_text: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

name: Sharpedo
flavor_text: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as "The Bully of the Sea."

name: Sunflora
flavor_text: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.

name: Unown [S]
flavor_text: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

name: Weavile
flavor_text: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

name: Wormadam Plant Cloak
flavor_text: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

name: Wormadam Sandy Cloak
flavor_text: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

name: Wormadam Trash Cloak
flavor_text: When BURMY evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

name: Xatu
flavor_text: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun's movement all day.

name: Breloom
flavor_text: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

name: Charmeleon
flavor_text: In the rocky mountains where CHARMELEON live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.

name: Cloyster
flavor_text: It fights by keeping its shell tightly shut for protection and by shooting spikes to repel foes.

name: Donphan
flavor_text: It attacks by curling up, then rolling into its foe. It can blow apart a house in one hit.

name: Farfetch'd
flavor_text: It can't live without the stalk it holds. That's why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.

name: Flaaffy
flavor_text: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

name: Ivysaur
flavor_text: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower's coming bloom.

name: Kecleon
flavor_text: It can freely change its body's color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn't change, however.

name: Kirlia
flavor_text: It is highly perceptive of its Trainer's feelings. It dances when it is feeling happy.

name: Lombre
flavor_text: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.

name: Miltank
flavor_text: It is said that kids who drink MILTANK's milk grow up to become hearty, healthy adults.

name: Muk
flavor_text: A toxic fluids seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.

name: Nidorino
flavor_text: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes poison upon impact.

name: Pidgeotto
flavor_text: It flies over its wide territory in search of prey, downing it with its highly developed claws.

name: Pinsir
flavor_text: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can't tear, it tosses far.

name: Quagsire
flavor_text: It has a sluggish nature. It lies at the river's bottom, waiting for prey to stray into its mouth.

name: Raticate
flavor_text: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder walls.

name: Roselia
flavor_text: ROSELIA raised on clean drinking water are known to grow vividly colored flowers.

name: Sableye
flavor_text: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

name: Shelgon
flavor_text: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.

name: Skiploom
flavor_text: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.

name: Smeargle
flavor_text: It marks its territory by using its tail like a paintbrush. There are more than 5,000 different marks.

name: Smoochum
flavor_text: It tests everything by touching with its lips, which remember what it likes and dislikes.

name: Unown [K]
flavor_text: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

name: Unown [N]
flavor_text: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

flavor_text: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

name: Unown [X]
flavor_text: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

name: Unown [Z]
flavor_text: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.

name: Venomoth
flavor_text: It flutters its wings to scatter dustlike scales. The scales leach toxins if they contact skin.

name: Vibrava
flavor_text: It violently shudders its wings, generating ultrasonic waves to induce headaches in people.

name: Wartortle
flavor_text: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.

name: Bagon
flavor_text: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.

name: Chatot

name: Drifloon

name: Pikachu

name: Stunky

name: Lucario

name: Luxray
flavor_text: When its eyes gleam gold, it can spot hiding prey–even those taking shelter behind a wall.

name: Probopass

name: Yanmega
flavor_text: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.

name: Cherrim
flavor_text: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.

name: Carnivine
flavor_text: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

name: Luxio

name: Chimchar
flavor_text: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

name: Croagunk
flavor_text: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

name: Happiny
flavor_text: It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.

name: Piplup
flavor_text: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

name: Riolu
flavor_text: Its body is lithe yet powerful. It can crest three mountains and cross two canyons in one night.

name: Turtwig
flavor_text: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

name: Magnezone
flavor_text: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.

name: Dusknoir
flavor_text: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.

name: Steelix
flavor_text: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

name: Dusclops
flavor_text: Its body is hollow. It is said that those who look into its body are sucked into the void.

name: Dusclops

name: Electrode
flavor_text: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

name: Farfetch'd
flavor_text: It can't live without the stalk it holds. That's why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.

name: Grovyle
flavor_text: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

name: Haunter
flavor_text: It can slip through any obstacle. It lurks inside walls to keep an eye on its foes.

name: Machoke
flavor_text: Machoke's boundless power is very dangerous, so it wears a belt that suppresses its energy.

name: Magneton
flavor_text: It is actually three Magnemite linked by magnetism. A group can set off a magnetic storm.

name: Magneton
flavor_text: It is actually three Magnemite linked by magnetism. A group can set off a magnetic storm.

name: Pichu
flavor_text: The electric pouches on its cheeks are still small. They cannot store much electricity yet.

name: Piloswine
flavor_text: Its shaggy coat makes it unable to see. It checks surroundings with its sensitive nose instead.

name: Pupitar
flavor_text: Its body is hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.

name: Scyther
flavor_text: It is nearly impossible to parry its attacking scythes. Its movements are like a ninja's.

name: Shelgon
flavor_text: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.

name: Skarmory
flavor_text: Despite being clad entirely in iron-hard armor, it flies at speeds over 180 mph.

name: Staravia
flavor_text: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.

name: Bagon
flavor_text: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.

name: Bidoof
flavor_text: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

name: Bronzor
flavor_text: Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

name: Cherubi
flavor_text: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.

name: Combee
rules: Honey: Once during your turn, when you put Combee from your hand onto your Bench, you may search your discard pile for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench.

name: Drifloon
flavor_text: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

name: Duskull
flavor_text: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.

name: Duskull
flavor_text: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.

name: Finneon
flavor_text: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.

name: Gastly
flavor_text: This Pokémon's body is 95% made up of gases, which are blown away by strong gusts of wind.

name: Larvitar
flavor_text: A Pokémon that eats soil. Once it has eaten a large mountain, it goes to sleep so it can grow.

name: Machop
flavor_text: It hefts a Graveler repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.

name: Magikarp
flavor_text: It is said to be the world's weakest Pokémon. No one knows why it has managed to survive.

name: Magnemite

name: Misdreavus
flavor_text: It loves to sneak up on people late at night, then startle them with its shrieklike cry.

name: Onix
flavor_text: When it travels underground, it causes rumbling and tremors. It can move at 50 mph.

name: Pikachu
flavor_text: It lives in forests with others. It stores electricity in the pouches on its cheeks.

name: Ponyta
flavor_text: About an hour after birth, its fiery mane and tail grow out, giving it an impressive appearance.

name: Roselia
flavor_text: Roselia raised on clean drinking water are known to grow vividly colored flowers.

name: Skorupi
flavor_text: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

name: Snover
flavor_text: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.

name: Starly
flavor_text: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

name: Stunky
flavor_text: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

name: Swinub
flavor_text: It loves eating mushrooms that grow under dead grass. It also finds hot springs while foraging.

name: Tangela
flavor_text: It is shrouded by blue vines. No one has seen the face hidden behind this growth of vines.

name: Treecko
flavor_text: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.

name: Voltorb

name: Charmander
flavor_text: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

name: Charmeleon
flavor_text: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

name: Charizard
flavor_text: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

name: Dialga
flavor_text: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

name: Dialga

name: Shaymin
flavor_text: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.

name: Shaymin
flavor_text: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.

name: Slaking
flavor_text: The world's laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.

name: Beautifly
flavor_text: Despite its looks, it is aggressive. It jabs with its long, thin mouth if disturbed while collecting pollen.

name: Dialga
flavor_text: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that time flows when Dialga's heart beats.

name: Empoleon
flavor_text: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.

name: Giratina
flavor_text: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.

name: Giratina
flavor_text: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.

name: Golduck
flavor_text: It is seen swimming dynamically and elegantly using its well-developed limbs and flippers.

name: Infernape
flavor_text: It uses unique fighting moves with fires on its hands and feet. It will take on any opponent.

name: Kricketune
flavor_text: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.

name: Lickilicky
flavor_text: The long tongue is always soggy with slobber. The saliva contains a solvent that causes numbness.

name: Luvdisc
flavor_text: It lives in warm seas. It is said that a couple finding this Pokémon will be blessed with eternal love.

name: Ninetales
flavor_text: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.

name: Palkia
flavor_text: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that space becomes more stable with PALKIA's every breath.

name: Shaymin
flavor_text: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.

name: Torterra
flavor_text: Some Pokémon are born on a TORTERRA's back and spend their entire life there.

name: Cacturne
flavor_text: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day's desert heat.

name: Cascoon
flavor_text: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.

name: Combusken
flavor_text: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.

name: Cranidos
flavor_text: A lifelong jungle dweller from 100 million years ago, it would snap obstructing trees with head butts.

name: Flaaffy
flavor_text: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

name: Grotle
flavor_text: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.

name: Kirlia
flavor_text: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

name: Lombre
flavor_text: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.

name: Lucario
flavor_text: A well-trained one can sense auras to identify and take in the feelings of creatures over half a mile away.

name: Mismagius
flavor_text: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.

name: Monferno
flavor_text: It skillfully control the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.

name: Octillery
flavor_text: It loves to lurk inside holes in rocks. It sometimes sprays ink on prey by sticking out only its mouth.

name: Prinplup
flavor_text: Because every PRINPLUP considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.

name: Probopass
flavor_text: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.

name: Shieldon
flavor_text: It is outstandingly armored. As a result, it can eat grass and berries without having to fight.

name: Silcoon
flavor_text: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.

name: Vigoroth
flavor_text: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still even for a moment.

name: Wartortle
flavor_text: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.

name: Cacnea
flavor_text: By storing water in its body, this desert dweller can survive 30 days without water.

name: Carnivine
flavor_text: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

name: Chansey
flavor_text: A kindly Pokémon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

name: Chimchar
flavor_text: It is very agile. Before going to sleep, it extinguishes the flame on its tail to prevent fires.

name: Combee
flavor_text: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please VESPIQUEN.

name: Diglett
flavor_text: A Pokémon that lives underground. Because of its dark habitat, it is repelled by bright sunlight.

name: Dunsparce
flavor_text: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

name: Electrike
flavor_text: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

name: Grimer
flavor_text: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon's X-rays. It appears among filth.

name: Happiny
flavor_text: It likes to carry around a small rock. It may wander around others' feet and cause them to stumble.

name: Kricketot
flavor_text: Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles, its stiff antennae clack with a xylophone-like sound.

name: Lapras
flavor_text: It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back. It understands human speech.

name: Lickitung
flavor_text: When it extends its over-six-foot-long tongue, its tail quivers. There is a possibility they are connected.

name: Lotad
flavor_text: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry to Pokémon that can't swim.

name: Mareep
flavor_text: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

name: Misdreavus
flavor_text: A Pokémon that startles people in the middle of the night. It gathers fear as its energy.

name: Nosepass
flavor_text: When endangered, it may protect itself by raising its magnetism and drawing iron objects to its body.

name: Piplup
flavor_text: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

name: Poochyena
flavor_text: A Pokémon with persistent nature, it chases its prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

name: Psyduck
flavor_text: Overwhelmed by enigmatic abilities, it suffers a constant headache. It sometimes uses mysterious powers.

name: Ralts
flavor_text: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

name: Remoraid
flavor_text: It forcefully squirts water. The water jet never misses prey even if the REMORAID is deep in the sea.

name: Riolu
flavor_text: It has the peculiar power of being able to see emotions such as joy and rage in the form of waves.

name: Shuppet
flavor_text: It loves vengeful emotions and hangs in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.

name: Skitty
flavor_text: It can't stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.

name: Slakoth
flavor_text: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.

name: Squirtle
flavor_text: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

name: Swablu
flavor_text: It can't relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.

name: Tauros
flavor_text: Once it takes aim at its foe, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.

name: Torchic
flavor_text: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.

name: Torkoal
flavor_text: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

name: Turtwig
flavor_text: The shell on its back is made of soil. On a very healthy TURTWIG, the shell should feel moist.

name: Vulpix
flavor_text: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.

name: Wurmple
flavor_text: Often targeted by bird Pokémon, it desperately resists by releasing poison from its tail spikes.

name: Electabuzz

name: Hitmonchan
flavor_text: The spirit of a pro boxer has infused this POKéMON. It throws punches that are faster than a bullet train.

name: Scyther
flavor_text: It tears and shreds prey with its wickedly sharp scythes. It very rarely spreads its wings to fly.

name: Garchomp
flavor_text: It flies at speeds equal to a jet fighter plane. It never allows its prey to escape.

name: Manaphy
flavor_text: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

name: Raichu
flavor_text: It can loose 100,000-volt bursts of electricity, instantly downing foes several times its size.

name: Regigigas
flavor_text: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

name: Rotom
flavor_text: Its electric-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.

name: Buizel
flavor_text: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.

name: Croagunk
flavor_text: Inflating its poison sacs, it makes an eerie blubbering sound for intimidation.

name: Gabite
flavor_text: It habitually digs up and hoards gems in its nest. Its loot is constantly targeted by thieves.

name: Lopunny
flavor_text: It is very conscious of its looks and never fails to groom its ears. It runs with sprightly jumps.

name: Pachirisu
flavor_text: It makes electricity with pouches in its cheeks and shoots charges from its tail. It live atop trees.

name: Pichu
flavor_text: It plays with others by touching tails and setting off sparks. This appears to be a test of courage.

name: Buneary
flavor_text: When it senses danger, it perks up its ears. On cold nights, it sleeps with its head tucked into its fur.

name: Chimchar
flavor_text: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can't extinguish the fire.

name: Gible
flavor_text: Its nests is small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.

name: Pikachu
flavor_text: If it looses crackling power from the electric pouches on its cheeks, it is being wary.

name: Piplup
flavor_text: It lives along shores in northern countries. A skilled swimmer, it dives for over 10 minutes to hunt.

name: Turtwig
flavor_text: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

name: Beedrill

name: Snorlax
flavor_text: It stops eating only to sleep. It doesn't feel full unless it eats nearly 900 pounds a day.

name: Walrein
flavor_text: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.

name: Lairon
flavor_text: For food, it digs up iron ore. It smashes its steely body against others to fight over territory.

name: Vibrava
flavor_text: It violently shudders its wings, generating ultrasonic waves to induce headaches in people.

name: Aron
flavor_text: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

name: Carvanha
flavor_text: They swarm any foes that invades their territory. Their sharp fangs can tear out boat hulls.

name: Eevee
flavor_text: Because its genetic makeup is irregular, it quickly changes its form due to a variety of causes.

name: Growlithe
flavor_text: A Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.

name: Hippopotas
flavor_text: It shuts its nostrils tight then travels through sand as if walking. They form colonies of around ten.

name: Kakuna
flavor_text: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

name: Kecleon
flavor_text: It can freely change its body's color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn't change, however.

name: Koffing
flavor_text: Lighter-than-air gases in its body keep it aloft. The gases not only smell, they are also explosive.

name: Munchlax
flavor_text: In its desperation to gulp down food, it forgets about the food it has hidden under its fur.

name: Munchlax
flavor_text: It hides food under its long body hair. However, it forgets it has hidden the food.

name: Nidoran ♀
flavor_text: While it does not prefer to fight, even one drop of the poison it secretes from barbs can be fatal.

name: Nidoran ♂
flavor_text: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.

name: Nidorina
flavor_text: When it senses danger, it raises all the barbs on its body. These barbs grow slower than NIDORINO's.

name: Nidorino
flavor_text: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes poison upon impact.

name: Nuzleaf
flavor_text: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.

name: Sealeo
flavor_text: It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so, it learns textures and odors.

name: Seedot
flavor_text: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

name: Shellos East Sea
flavor_text: Beware of pushing strongly on its squishy body, as it makes a mysterious purple fluid ooze out.

name: Shellos West Sea
flavor_text: Beware of pushing strongly on its squishy body, as it makes a mysterious purple fluid ooze out.

name: Spheal
flavor_text: It rolls across ice floes to reach shore because its body is poorly shaped for swimming.

name: Staryu
flavor_text: If its body is torn, it can grow back if the red core remains. The core flashes at midnight.

name: Trapinch
flavor_text: It makes a conical pit in desert sand and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

name: Weedle
flavor_text: It eats its weight in leaves every day. It fends off attackers with the needle on its head.

name: Pikachu
flavor_text: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.

name: Flying Pikachu
flavor_text: By learning how to fly, Pikachu overcame its weakness to Fighting Pokémon.

name: Surfing Pikachu
flavor_text: One summer, a group of Pikachu was found riding the waves at the local beach.

name: Metagross
flavor_text: Metang combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.

name: Milotic
flavor_text: Its lovely scales are described as rainbow colored. They change color depending on the viewing angle.

name: Relicanth
flavor_text: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.

name: Yanma
flavor_text: It can hover in one spot by flapping its wings at high speed. It flits about to guard its territory.

name: Rhyperior
flavor_text: It can launch a rock held in its hand like a missile by tightening then expanding muscles instantly.

name: Articuno
flavor_text: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

name: Camerupt
flavor_text: It has volcanoes on its back. If magma builds up in its body, it shudders, then erupts violently.

name: Chimecho
flavor_text: Its cries echo inside its hollow body to emerge as beautiful notes for startling and repelling foes.

name: Claydol
flavor_text: An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.

name: Dodrio
flavor_text: When Doduo evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. It runs at nearly 40 mph.

name: Honchkrow
flavor_text: If one utters a deep cry, many Murkrow gather quickly. For this, it is called "Summoner of Night."

name: Lunatone
flavor_text: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.

name: Medicham
flavor_text: It gains the ability to see the aura of its opponents by honing its mind through starvation.

name: Moltres
flavor_text: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.

name: Mr. Mime
flavor_text: It shapes an invisible wall in midair by minutely vibrating its fingertips to stop molecules in the air.

name: Parasect
flavor_text: A mushroom grown larger than the host's body controls Parasect. It scatters poisonous spores.

name: Primeape
flavor_text: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.

name: Sandslash
flavor_text: It curls up, then rolls into foes with its back. Its sharp spines inflict severe damage.

name: Seaking
flavor_text: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.

name: Shedinja
flavor_text: A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one's spirit.

name: Solrock
flavor_text: A new Pokémon species, rumored to be from the sun. It gives off light while spinning.

name: Spinda
flavor_text: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Its tottering step fouls the aim of foes.

name: Wailord
flavor_text: The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.

name: Zapdos
flavor_text: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

name: Arcanine
flavor_text: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.

name: Bibarel
flavor_text: A river dammed by Bibarel will never overflow its banks, which is appreciated by people nearby.

name: Breloom
flavor_text: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

name: Carnivine
flavor_text: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

name: Cherrim
flavor_text: If it senses strong sunlight, it opens its folded petals to absorb the sun's rays with its whole body.

name: Drifblim
flavor_text: At dusk, swarms of them are carried aloft on winds. When noticed, they suddenly vanish.

name: Floatzel
flavor_text: It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is known to rescue people and carry off prey.

name: Gabite
flavor_text: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.

name: Hippopotas
flavor_text: It shuts its nostrils tight then travels through sand as if walking. They form colonies of around ten.

name: Ivysaur
flavor_text: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower's coming bloom.

name: Lopunny
flavor_text: The ears appear to be delicate. If they are touched roughly, it kicks with its graceful legs.

name: Loudred
flavor_text: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.

name: Magmar
flavor_text: When it breathes deeply, heat waves form around its body, making it hard to see clearly.

name: Marshtomp
flavor_text: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.

name: Masquerain
flavor_text: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.

name: Metang
flavor_text: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won't be scratched if it collides with a jet.

name: Milotic
flavor_text: Its lovely scales are described as rainbow colored. They change color depending on the viewing angle.

name: Minun
flavor_text: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

name: Murkrow
flavor_text: If spotted, it will lure an unwary person into chasing it, then lose the pursuer on mountain trails.

name: Ninjask
flavor_text: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.

name: Numel
flavor_text: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.

name: Pinsir
flavor_text: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can't tear, it tosses far.

name: Plusle
flavor_text: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

name: Raichu
flavor_text: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

name: Relicanth
flavor_text: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.

name: Rhydon
flavor_text: Standing on its hind legs freed its forelegs and made it smarter. It is very forgetful, however.

name: Roserade
flavor_text: Each of its hands contains different toxins, but both hands can jab with near-fatal power.

name: Rotom
flavor_text: Its electric-like body can enter some kinds of machines and take control in order to make mischief.

name: Staravia
flavor_text: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.

name: Wailmer
flavor_text: On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. It spouts water from its nose.

name: Yanma
flavor_text: It can hover is one spot by flapping its wings at high speed. It flits about to guard its territory.

name: Baltoy
flavor_text: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.

name: Beldum
flavor_text: It converses with others by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.

name: Bidoof
flavor_text: A comparison revealed that Bidoof's front teeth grow at the same rate as Rattata's.

name: Buizel
flavor_text: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

name: Bulbasaur
flavor_text: For some time after its birth, it grows by gaining nourishment from the seed on its back.

name: Buneary
flavor_text: Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.

name: Chatot
flavor_text: Its tongue is just like a human's. As a result, it can cleverly mimic human speech.

name: Cherubi
flavor_text: The small ball is not only filled with nutrients, it is also tasty. Starly try to peck it off.

name: Chimchar
flavor_text: It is very agile. Before going to sleep, it extinguishes the flame on its tail to prevent fires.

name: Chingling
flavor_text: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound.

name: Combee
flavor_text: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please Vespiquen.

name: Corphish
flavor_text: Its hardy vitality enables it to adapt to any environment. Its pincers will never release prey.

name: Croagunk
flavor_text: It rarely fights fairly, but that is strictly to ensure survival. It is popular as a mascot.

name: Doduo
flavor_text: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

name: Drifloon
flavor_text: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a "Signpost for Wandering Spirits."

name: Feebas
flavor_text: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.

name: Geodude
flavor_text: At rest, it looks just like a rock. Carelessly stepping on it will make it swing its fists angrily.

name: Gible
flavor_text: It attacks using its huge mouth. While its attacks are powerful, it hurts itself out of clumsiness, too.

name: Goldeen
flavor_text: Though it appears very elegant when swimming with fins unfurled, it can jab powerfully with its horn.

name: Growlithe
flavor_text: A Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.

name: Kricketot
flavor_text: Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles, its stiff antennae clack with a xylophone-like sound.

name: Magikarp
flavor_text: A Magikarp living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. The move remains useless, though.

name: Magnemite
flavor_text: The faster the units at its sides rotate, the greater the magnetic force they generate.

name: Mankey
flavor_text: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.

name: Meditite
flavor_text: It always trains deep in mountains. It levitates when it heightens its spiritual power through meditation.

name: Meowth
flavor_text: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

name: Mime Jr.
flavor_text: It mimics the expressions and motions of those it sees to understand the feelings of others.

name: Mudkip
flavor_text: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

name: Nincada
flavor_text: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.

name: Pachirisu
flavor_text: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

name: Paras
flavor_text: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host Paras.

name: Pikachu
flavor_text: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

name: Piplup
flavor_text: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.

name: Rhyhorn
flavor_text: Its powerful tackles can destroy anything. However, it is too slow witted to help people work.

name: Roselia
flavor_text: The more healthy the Roselia, the more pleasant its flowers' aroma. Its scent deeply relaxes people.

name: Sandshrew
flavor_text: To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.

name: Seel
flavor_text: A Pokémon that lives on icebergs. It swims in the sea using the point on its head to break up ice.

name: Shinx
flavor_text: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

name: Shroomish
flavor_text: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.

name: Skorupi
flavor_text: As soon as the tail claws close, its needle tips secrete poison. It can survive a year without food.

name: Starly
flavor_text: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.

name: Surskit
flavor_text: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey with a sweet scent from the tip of its head.

name: Turtwig
flavor_text: The shell on its back is made of soil. On a very healthy Turtwig, the shell should feel moist.

name: Whismur
flavor_text: Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs. If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume as a jet plane.

name: Zubat
flavor_text: It checks its surroundings and location using reflections of the ultrasonic waves from its mouth.

name: Ho-Oh
flavor_text: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind when it flies.

name: Lugia
flavor_text: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea because its powers are too strong.

name: Pikachu
flavor_text: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

name: Wobbuffet
flavor_text: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

name: Hoothoot
flavor_text: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.

name: Noctowl
flavor_text: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

name: Latias
flavor_text: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.

name: Latios
flavor_text: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

name: Cleffa
flavor_text: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

name: Smoochum
flavor_text: Its lips are the most sensitive part of its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.

name: Lapras
flavor_text: It ferries people across the sea on its back. It may sing an enchanting cry if it is in a good mood.

name: Shuckle
flavor_text: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

name: Plusle
flavor_text: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.

name: Minun
flavor_text: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

name: Tropical Tidal Wave
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, discard all Trainer and Stadium cards your opponent has in play. If tails, discard all Trainer and Stadium cards you have in play.

name: Raikou
flavor_text: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.

name: Entei
flavor_text: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Unable to contain its sheer power, it races headlong around the land.

name: Suicune
flavor_text: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

name: Porygon
flavor_text: It is a manmade Pokémon. Since it doesn't breathe, people are eager to try it in any environment..

name: Porygon2
flavor_text: This upgraded version of Porygon is designed for space exploration. It can't fly, though.

name: Hitmonchan
flavor_text: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

name: Hitmonlee
flavor_text: If it starts kicking repeatedly, both legs will stretch even longer to strike a fleeing foe.

name: Jirachi
flavor_text: Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.

name: Magmortar
flavor_text: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit out of its arms. Its breath also sears and sizzles.

name: Manaphy
flavor_text: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

name: Mismagius
flavor_text: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

name: Octillery
flavor_text: It traps foes with the suction cups on its tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

name: Politoed
flavor_text: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

name: Shaymin
flavor_text: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

name: Sudowoodo
flavor_text: It disguises itself as a tree to avoid attack. It hates water, so it will disappear if it starts raining.

name: Torterra
flavor_text: Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground, a gigantic Torterra dwelled.

name: Xatu
flavor_text: In South America, it is said that its right eye sees the future and its left eye views the past.

name: Beedrill
flavor_text: It can take down any opponent with its powerful poison stingers. It sometimes attacks in swarms.

name: Blastoise
flavor_text: It deliberately makes itself heavy so it can withstand the recoil of the water jets it fires.

name: Crobat
flavor_text: The development of wings on its legs enables it to fly fast but also makes it tough to stop and rest.

name: Fearow
flavor_text: It shoots itself suddenly high into the sky, then plummets down in one fell swoop to strike its prey.

name: Floatzel
flavor_text: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

name: Kingdra
flavor_text: It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.

name: Lanturn
flavor_text: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.

name: Lucario
flavor_text: It's said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras, even foes it could not otherwise see.

name: Ninetales
flavor_text: Some legends claim that each of its nine tails has its own unique type of special mystical power.

name: Poliwrath
flavor_text: Although an energetic, skilled swimmer that uses all of its muscles, it lives on dry land.

name: Primeape
flavor_text: If approached while asleep, it may awaken and angrily give chase in a groggy state of semi-sleep.

name: Roserade
flavor_text: Its sweet aroma attracts prey. Then it spews poison. The more toxic it is, the sweeter its aroma.

name: Steelix
flavor_text: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.

name: Torkoal
flavor_text: You find abandoned coal mines full of them. They dig tirelessly in search of coal.

name: Tyranitar
flavor_text: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It has an insolent nature that makes it not care about others.

name: Ursaring
flavor_text: With its ability to distinguish any aroma, it unfailing finds all food buried deep underground.

name: Cherrim
flavor_text: During times of strong sunlight, its bud blooms, its petals open fully, and it becomes very active.

name: Dunsparce
flavor_text: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

name: Golbat
flavor_text: It can drink more than 10 ounces of blood at once. If it has too much, it gets heavy and flies clumsily.

name: Grotle
flavor_text: A Grotle that lives in the forest is said to have its own secret springwater.

name: Kakuna
flavor_text: Although it is a cocoon, it can move a little. It can extend its poison barb if it is attacked.

name: Metang
flavor_text: When two Beldum fuse together, a magnetic nervous system places their brains in union.

name: Minun
flavor_text: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

name: Numel
flavor_text: The flaming magma it stores in the hump on its back is the source of its tremendous power.

name: Plusle
flavor_text: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.

name: Poliwhirl
flavor_text: The skin on most of its body is moist. However, the skin on its belly spiral feels smooth.

name: Pupitar
flavor_text: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

name: Pupitar
flavor_text: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

name: Seadra
flavor_text: Its fin tips leak poison. Its fins and bones are highly valued as ingredients in herbal medicine.

name: Tauros
flavor_text: They fight each other by locking horns. The herd's protector takes pride in its battle-scarred horns.

name: Wartortle
flavor_text: It is a well-established symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.

name: Aipom
flavor_text: It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

name: Beldum
flavor_text: The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground's natural magnetism, letting it float.

name: Buizel
flavor_text: It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its face above water in order to watch for prey movement.

name: Carnivine
flavor_text: It walks around on its tentacles in search of a tree branch where it can dangle down and ambush prey.

name: Cherubi
flavor_text: It evolves by sucking the energy out of the small ball where it had been storing nutrients.

name: Chinchou
flavor_text: It shoots positive and negative electricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.

name: Horsea
flavor_text: Its big, developed fins move rapidly, allowing it to swim backward while still facing forward.

name: Larvitar
flavor_text: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.

name: Larvitar
flavor_text: It is born deep underground. It can't emerge until it has entirely consumed the soil around it.

name: Magmar
flavor_text: It dislikes cold places, so it blows scorching flames to make the environment suitable for itself.

name: Mankey
flavor_text: It is extremely ill-tempered. Groups of them will attack any handy target for no reason.

name: Misdreavus
flavor_text: It likes playing mischievous tricks such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.

name: Natu
flavor_text: It usually forages for food on the ground but may, on rare occasions, hop onto branches to peck at shoots.

name: Onix
flavor_text: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

name: Onix
flavor_text: It twists and squirms through the ground. The thunderous roar of its tunneling echoes a long way.

name: Poliwag
flavor_text: The direction of its belly spiral differs by area. The equator is thought to have an effect on this.

name: Remoraid
flavor_text: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.

name: Riolu
flavor_text: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

name: Roselia
flavor_text: Roselia that drink nutritionally rich springwater are said to reveal rare coloration when they bloom.

name: Spearow
flavor_text: It flaps its short wings to flush out insects from tall grass. It then plucks them with its stubby beak.

name: Squirtle
flavor_text: The shell is soft when it is born. It soon becomes so resilient, prodding fingers will bounce off it.

name: Stantler
flavor_text: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

name: Teddiursa
flavor_text: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

name: Tropius
flavor_text: The bunch of fruit around its neck ripens twice a year and is delicious. It's a highly favored tropical snack.

name: Turtwig
flavor_text: Photosynthesis occurs across its body under the sun. The shell on its back is actually hardened soil.

name: Vulpix
flavor_text: As it develops, its single white tail gains color and splits into six. It is quite warm and cuddly.

name: Weedle
flavor_text: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

name: Zubat
flavor_text: Capable of flying safely in dark places, it emits ultrasonic cries to check for any obstacles.

name: Bellossom
flavor_text: Bellossom gather at times and seem to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.

name: Espeon
flavor_text: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its enemy's actions.

name: Forretress
flavor_text: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside this shell is a total mystery.

name: Gliscor
flavor_text: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey… Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

name: Houndoom
flavor_text: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

name: Magcargo
flavor_text: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

name: Scizor
flavor_text: Its wings are not used for flying. They are flapped at high speed to adjust its body temperature.

name: Smeargle
flavor_text: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.

name: Togekiss
flavor_text: As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings.

name: Umbreon
flavor_text: When agitated, this Pokémon protects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.

name: Dodrio
flavor_text: It collects data and plans three times as wisely, but it may think too much and fall into a state of immobility.

name: Drifblim
flavor_text: It can generate and release gas within its body. That's how it can control the altitude of its drift.

name: Forretress
flavor_text: It remains immovably rooted to its tree. It scatters pieces of its hard shell to drive its enemies away.

name: Hariyama
flavor_text: It loves challenging others to tests of strength. It has the power to stop a train with a slap.

name: Honchkrow
flavor_text: It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.

name: Honchkrow
