name: Leafeon
flavor_text: When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of sunshine, you'll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.

name: Metagross
flavor_text: It folds its four legs when flying. Its four brains are said to be superior to a supercomputer.

name: Mismagius
flavor_text: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

name: Rotom
flavor_text: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

name: Skarmory
flavor_text: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.

name: Tropius
flavor_text: The bunch of fruit around its neck ripens twice a year and is delicious. It's a highly favored tropical snack.

name: Vespiquen
flavor_text: It raises grubs in the holes in its body. It secretes pheromones to control Combee.

name: Vileplume
flavor_text: It has the world's largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

name: Weavile
flavor_text: It lives in snowy regions. It carves patterns in trees with its claws as a signal to others.

name: Flareon
flavor_text: It stores some of the air it inhales in its internal flame pouch, which heats it to over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Gloom
flavor_text: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

name: Jolteon
flavor_text: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

name: Lairon
flavor_text: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

name: Metang
flavor_text: When two Beldum fuse together, a magnetic nervous system places their brains in union.

name: Muk
flavor_text: Its body is made of a powerful poison. Touching it accidentally will cause a fever that requires bed rest.

name: Pinsir
flavor_text: With its horns, it digs burrows to sleep in at night. In the morning, damp soil clings to its body.

name: Raichu
flavor_text: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.

name: Raticate
flavor_text: Its whiskers help it to maintain balance. Its fangs never stop growing, so it gnaws to pare them down.

name: Sableye
flavor_text: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

name: Scyther
flavor_text: When it moves, it leaves only a blur. If it hides in grass, its protective colors make it invisible.

name: Skuntank
flavor_text: It attacks by spraying a repugnant fluid from its tail, but the stench dulls after a few squirts.

name: Slowbro
flavor_text: Naturally dull to begin with, it lost its ability to feel pain due to Shellder's seeping poison.

name: Togetic
flavor_text: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.

name: Unown
flavor_text: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

name: Vaporeon
flavor_text: When Vaporeon's fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.

name: Aron
flavor_text: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.

name: Beldum
flavor_text: The magnetic force generated by its body repels the ground's natural magnetism, letting it float.

name: Combee
flavor_text: At night, Combee sleep in a group of about a thousand, packed closely together in a lump.

name: Doduo
flavor_text: By alternately raising and lowering its two heads, it balances itself to be more stable while running.

name: Drifloon
flavor_text: It is whispered that any child who mistakes Drifloon for a balloon and holds on to it could wind up missing.

name: Eevee
flavor_text: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

name: Eevee
flavor_text: Its irregularly configured DNA is affected by its surroundings. It evolves if its environment changes.

name: Gligar
flavor_text: It flies straight at its target's face then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

name: Grimer
flavor_text: Wherever Grimer has passed, so many germs are left behind that no plants will ever grow again.

name: Hitmonchan
flavor_text: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

name: Hitmonlee
flavor_text: If it starts kicking repeatedly, both legs will stretch even longer to strike a fleeing foe.

name: Houndour
flavor_text: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

name: Houndour
flavor_text: To corner prey, they check each other's location using barks that only they can understand.

name: Makuhita
flavor_text: It toughens up by slamming into thick trees over and over. It gains a sturdy body and dauntless spirit.

name: Mawile
flavor_text: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

name: Misdreavus
flavor_text: It loves to bite and yank people's hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

name: Murkrow
flavor_text: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

name: Murkrow
flavor_text: It is said that when chased, it lures its attacker onto dark mountain trails where the foe will get lost.

name: Oddish
flavor_text: Awakened by moonlight, it roams actively at night. In the day it stays quietly underground.

name: Pikachu
flavor_text: This intelligent Pokémon roasts hard berries with electricity to make them tender enough to eat.

name: Pineco
flavor_text: It hangs and waits for flying insect prey to come near. It does not move about much on its own.

name: Pineco
flavor_text: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

name: Rattata
flavor_text: Living wherever there is food available, it ceaselessly scavenges for edibles the entire day.

name: Scyther
flavor_text: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

name: Slowpoke
flavor_text: A sweet sap leaks from its tail's tip. Although not nutritious, the tail is pleasant to chew on.

name: Slugma
flavor_text: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

name: Sneasel
flavor_text: Vicious in nature, it drives Pidgey from their nests and scavenges any leftovers it can find.

name: Stunky
flavor_text: The foul fluid from its rear is so revolting that it can make people feel queasy up to a mile and a quarter away.

name: Togepi
flavor_text: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping Togepi stand up.

name: Aggron
flavor_text: You can tell its age by the length of its iron horns. It claims an entire mountain as its territory.

name: Altaria
flavor_text: It flies gracefully through the sky. Its melodic humming makes you feel like you're in a dream.

name: Celebi
flavor_text: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

name: Drapion
flavor_text: It attacks people and Pokémon that cross the desert. This has only furthered its bad reputation.

name: Mamoswine
flavor_text: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.

name: Nidoking
flavor_text: Its tail is thick and powerful. If it binds an enemy, it can render the victim helpless quite easily.

name: Porygon-Z
flavor_text: Its programming was modified to enable it to travel through alien dimensions. Seems there might have been an error…

name: Rapidash
flavor_text: At full gallop, its four hooves barely touch the ground because it moves so incredibly fast.

name: Solrock
flavor_text: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

name: Spiritomb
flavor_text: It was formed by uniting 108 spirits. It has been bound to the Odd Keystone to keep it from doing any mischief.

name: Venomoth
flavor_text: The powder on its wings is poisonous if it is dark in hue. If it is light in hue, it causes paralysis.

name: Victreebel
flavor_text: Acid that has dissolved many prey becomes sweeter, making it even more effective at attracting prey.

name: Ambipom
flavor_text: They live on large trees. They are said to communicate by connecting their tails to those of others.

name: Banette
flavor_text: This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.

name: Bronzong
flavor_text: Ancient people believed that petitioning Bronzong for rain was the way to make crops grow.

name: Carnivine
flavor_text: It walks around on its tentacles in search of a tree branch where it can dangle down and ambush prey.

name: Ditto
flavor_text: Its transformation ability is perfect. However, if made to laugh, it can't maintain its disguise.

name: Dragonite
flavor_text: This marine Pokémon has an impressive build that lets it freely fly over raging seas without trouble.

name: Dugtrio
flavor_text: Extremely powerful, they can dig through even the hardest ground to a depth of over 60 miles.

name: Electivire
flavor_text: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.

name: Elekid
flavor_text: Even in the most vicious storm, this Pokémon plays happily if thunder rumbles in the sky.

name: Golduck
flavor_text: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

name: Grumpig
flavor_text: It can perform odd dance steps to influence foes. Its style of dancing became hugely popular overseas.

name: Kricketune
flavor_text: By allowing its cry to resonate in the hollow of its belly, it produces a captivating sound.

name: Lunatone
flavor_text: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.

name: Machamp
flavor_text: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

name: Magmortar
flavor_text: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit out of its arms. Its breath also sears and sizzles.

name: Nidoqueen
flavor_text: It uses its scaly, rugged body to seal the entrance of its nest and protect its young from predators.

name: Pidgeot
flavor_text: It spreads its beautiful wings wide to frighten its enemies. It can fly at Mach 2 speed.

name: Sharpedo
flavor_text: It can swim at speeds of 75 mph by jetting seawater through its body. It is the bandit of the sea.

name: Wailord
flavor_text: It is the largest of all identified Pokémon. They jump as a pack to herd their prey.

name: Dragonair
flavor_text: Its crystalline orbs appear to give this Pokémon the power to freely control the weather.

name: Electabuzz
flavor_text: Its body constantly discharges electricity. Getting close to it will make your hair stand on end.

name: Electrode
flavor_text: It is dangerous. If it has too much electricity and has nothing to do, it amuses itself by exploding.

name: Haunter
flavor_text: Its tongue is made of gas. If licked, its victim starts shaking constantly until death eventually comes.

name: Kangaskhan
flavor_text: If it is safe, the young gets out of the belly pouch to play. The adult keeps a close eye on the youngster.

name: Lairon
flavor_text: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.

name: Lickilicky
flavor_text: It has space in its throat to store saliva. It can also roll up its tongue and store it in the same spot.

name: Luvdisc
flavor_text: Its heart-shaped body makes it popular. In some places, you would give a Luvdisc to someone you love.

name: Machoke
flavor_text: It always goes at its full power, but this very tough and durable Pokémon never gets tired.

name: Magby
flavor_text: It is found in volcanic craters. Its body temperature is over 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit, so don't underestimate it.

name: Magmar
flavor_text: The fiery surface of its body gives off a wavering, rippling glare that is similar to the sun.

name: Magneton
flavor_text: The Magnemite are united by a magnetism so powerful, it dries all moisture in its vicinity.

name: Marowak
flavor_text: It has been seen pounding boulders with the bone it carries in order to tap out messages to others.

name: Nidorina
flavor_text: It has a calm and caring nature. Because its horn grows slowly, it prefers not to fight.

name: Nidorino
flavor_text: Quick to anger, it stabs enemies with its horn to inject a powerful poison when it becomes agitated.

name: Pidgeotto
flavor_text: It renders its prey immobile using well-developed claws, then carries the prey more than 60 miles to its nest.

name: Piloswine
flavor_text: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.

name: Porygon2
flavor_text: Further research enhanced its abilities. Sometimes, it may exhibit motions that were not programmed.

name: Tentacruel
flavor_text: In battle, it extends all 80 of its tentacles to entrap its opponent inside a poisonous net.

name: Unown
flavor_text: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

name: Wailmer
flavor_text: It bounces playfully like a ball. The more seawater it swallows, the higher it bounces.

name: Weepinbell
flavor_text: Even though it is filled with acid, it does not melt because it also oozes a protective fluid.

name: Yanmega
flavor_text: The beat of its wings is so powerful that it accidentally dislodges full-grown trees when it takes off in flight.

name: Aipom
flavor_text: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.

name: Aron
flavor_text: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.

name: Bellsprout
flavor_text: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

name: Bronzor
flavor_text: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor's back contained a mysterious power.

name: Carvanha
flavor_text: They form packs to attack boats and rip out their hulls to sink them. They live in rivers in the jungle.

name: Cubone
flavor_text: If it is sad or lonely, the skull it wears shakes and emits a plaintive and mournful sound.

name: Diglett
flavor_text: If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.

name: Dratini
flavor_text: This Pokémon is full of life energy. It continually sheds its skin and grows steadily larger.

name: Gastly
flavor_text: Its body is made of gas. Despite lacking substance, it can envelop an opponent of any size and cause suffocation.

name: Illumise
flavor_text: Its fragrance attracts a swarm of Volbeat, so they draw over 200 patterns in the night sky.

name: Kricketot
flavor_text: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.

name: Lickitung
flavor_text: Its long tongue, slathered with a gooey saliva, sticks to anything, so it is very useful.

name: Machop
flavor_text: Always brimming with power, it passes time by lifting boulders. Doing so makes it even stronger.

name: Magnemite
flavor_text: The units at the sides of its body generate antigravity energy to keep it aloft in the air.

name: Nidoran ♀
flavor_text: Although not very combative, it will torment its foes with poison spikes if it is threatened in any way.

name: Nidoran ♂
flavor_text: It raises its big ears to check its surroundings. It will strike first if it senses any danger.

name: Pidgey
flavor_text: Common in grassy areas and forests, it is very docile and will chase off enemies by flapping up sand.

name: Ponyta
flavor_text: It is a weak runner immediately after birth. It gradually becomes faster by chasing after its parents.

name: Porygon
flavor_text: A manmade Pokémon that came about as a result of research. It is programmed with only basic motions.

name: Psyduck
flavor_text: It has mystical powers but doesn't recall that it has used them. That is why it always looks puzzled.

name: Shuppet
flavor_text: It uses its horn to feed on envy and malice, or so it's said. It's very active at night.

name: Skorupi
flavor_text: It burrows under the sand to lie in wait for prey. Its tail claws can inject its prey with a savage poison.

name: Spoink
flavor_text: It bounces around on its tail to keep its heart pumping. It carries a pearl from Clamperl on its head.

name: Swablu
flavor_text: Its wings bring cottony clouds to mind. It grooms with springwater and loves to sit on heads.

name: Swinub
flavor_text: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

name: Tentacool
flavor_text: It drifts aimlessly in waves. Very difficult to see in water, it may not be noticed until it stings.

name: Venonat
flavor_text: Poison oozes from all over its body. It catches and eats small bugs at night that are attracted by light.

name: Volbeat
flavor_text: It emits light from its tail to communicate. It loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.

name: Voltorb
flavor_text: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

name: Yanma
flavor_text: Its large eyes can scan 360 degrees. It looks in all directions to seek out insects as its prey.

flavor_text: With its acute hearing, it can pick up sounds from far away. It usually hides in quiet places.

name: Deoxys

name: Entei
flavor_text: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

name: Espeon
flavor_text: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its enemy's actions.

name: Groudon
flavor_text: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.

name: Forretress
flavor_text: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside this shell is a total mystery.

name: Ho-Oh
flavor_text: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world's skies continuously on its magnificent seven-colored wings.

name: Groudon
flavor_text: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.

name: Kyogre
flavor_text: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with Groudon.

name: Gyarados
flavor_text: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

name: Lugia
flavor_text: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

name: Hitmontop
flavor_text: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

name: Palkia
flavor_text: Its total control over the boundaries of space enable it to transport itself to faraway places or even other dimensions.

name: Ho-Oh
flavor_text: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world's skies continuously on its magnificent seven-colored wings.

name: Raikou
flavor_text: A Pokémon that races across the land while barking a cry that sounds like crashing thunder.

name: Houndoom
flavor_text: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

name: Rayquaza
flavor_text: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.

name: Jirachi
flavor_text: Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.

name: Suicune
flavor_text: This Pokémon races across the land. It is said that north winds will somehow blow whenever it appears.

name: Kyogre
flavor_text: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with Groudon.

name: Leafeon
flavor_text: When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of sunshine, you'll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.

name: Lucario
flavor_text: It's said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras. Even foes it could not otherwise see.

name: Lugia
flavor_text: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

name: Magmortar
flavor_text: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit out of its arms. Its breath also sears and sizzles.

name: Ninetales
flavor_text: Its nine beautiful tails are filled with a wondrous energy that could keep it alive for 1,000 years.

name: Pachirisu
flavor_text: It's one of the kinds of Pokémon with electric cheek pouches. It shoots charges from its tail.

name: Palkia
flavor_text: Its total control over the boundaries of space enable it to transport itself to faraway places or even other dimensions.

name: Rayquaza
flavor_text: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.

name: Smeargle
flavor_text: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.

name: Umbreon
flavor_text: When agitated, this Pokémon protects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.

name: Ampharos
flavor_text: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

name: Cleffa
flavor_text: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

name: Feraligatr
flavor_text: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

name: Granbull
flavor_text: Because its fangs are too heavy, it always keeps its head tilted down. However, its bite is powerful.

name: Meganium
flavor_text: Meganium's breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.

name: Mismagius
flavor_text: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.

name: Mr. Mime
flavor_text: Its fingertips emit a peculiar force field that hardens air to create an actual wall.

name: Pidgeot
flavor_text: It spreads its beautiful wings wide to frighten its enemies. It can fly at Mach 2 speed.

name: Skarmory
flavor_text: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.

name: Slowking
flavor_text: It has incredible intellect and intuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.

name: Snorlax
flavor_text: Its stomach's digestive juices can dissolve any kind of poison. It can even eat things off the ground.

name: Tangrowth
flavor_text: Its vines grow so profusely that, in the warm season, you can't even see its eyes.

name: Typhlosion
flavor_text: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.

name: Tyrogue
flavor_text: Even though it is small, it can't be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.

name: Ursaring
flavor_text: With its ability to distinguish any aroma, it unfailing finds all food buried deep underground.

name: Weezing
flavor_text: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

name: Zangoose
flavor_text: Its fur would all stand on end if it smelled a Seviper nearby. Its sharp claws tear up its foes.

name: Bayleef
flavor_text: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.

name: Croconaw
flavor_text: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

name: Donphan
flavor_text: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its tackle is strong enough to knock down a house.

name: Flaaffy
flavor_text: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.

name: Flareon
flavor_text: It stores some of the air it inhales in its internal flame pouch, which heats it to over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Jolteon
flavor_text: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

name: Magby
flavor_text: It is found in volcanic craters. Its body temperature is over 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit, so don't underestimate it.

name: Mime Jr.
flavor_text: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy's movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!

name: Pidgeotto
flavor_text: It renders its prey immobile using well-developed claws, then carries the prey more than 60 miles to its nest.

name: Quilava
flavor_text: This Pokémon is fully covered by nonflammable fur. It can withstand any kind of fire attack.

name: Riolu
flavor_text: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.

name: Seviper
flavor_text: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any Zangoose. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.

name: Vaporeon
flavor_text: When Vaporeon's fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.

name: Chikorita
flavor_text: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up sunrays.

name: Clefairy
flavor_text: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.

name: Cyndaquil
flavor_text: It is timid, and always curls itself up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.

name: Eevee
flavor_text: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

name: Hitmonchan
flavor_text: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

name: Hitmonlee
flavor_text: If it starts kicking repeatedly, both legs will stretch even longer to strike a fleeing foe.

name: Houndour
flavor_text: To corner prey, they check each other's location using barks that only they can understand.

name: Koffing
flavor_text: Its thin, filmy body is filled with gases that cause constant sniffles, coughs and teary eyes.

name: Magikarp
flavor_text: For no reason, it jumps and splashes about, making it easy for predators like Pidgeotto to catch it mid-jump.

name: Magmar
flavor_text: It dislikes cold places, so it blows scorching flames to make the environment suitable for itself.

name: Mareep
flavor_text: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.

name: Mawile
flavor_text: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

name: Misdreavus
flavor_text: It loves to bite and yank people's hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.

name: Phanpy
flavor_text: As a sign of affection, it bumps with its snout. However, it is so strong, it may send you flying.

name: Pidgey
flavor_text: Common in grassy areas and forests, it is very docile and will chase off enemies by flapping up sand.

name: Pineco
flavor_text: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

name: Relicanth
flavor_text: Discovered by chance during deep-sea explorations, it has not changed since ancient times.

name: Slowpoke
flavor_text: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.

name: Snubbull
flavor_text: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

name: Tangela
flavor_text: It tangles any moving thing with its vines. Their subtle shaking is ticklish if you get ensnared.

name: Teddiursa
flavor_text: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they are soaked with honey.

name: Totodile
flavor_text: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

name: Vulpix
flavor_text: If it is attacked by an enemy that is stronger than itself, it feigns injury to fool the enemy and escapes.

flavor_text: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it.

name: Zekrom
flavor_text: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

name: Pikachu
flavor_text: This is an extremely rare Pikachu card. You're very lucky to have found it!

name: Snivy
flavor_text: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

name: Maractus
flavor_text: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.

name: Tepig
flavor_text: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

name: Oshawott
flavor_text: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

name: Alomomola
flavor_text: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.

name: Blitzle
flavor_text: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.

name: Munna
flavor_text: It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When it eats a pleasant dream, it expels pink-colored mist.

name: Sandile
flavor_text: It moves along below the sand's surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.

name: Zorua
flavor_text: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

name: Klink
flavor_text: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

name: Pidove
flavor_text: These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

name: Audino
flavor_text: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

name: Pansage
flavor_text: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.

name: Simisage
flavor_text: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

name: Sewaddle
flavor_text: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

name: Sewaddle
flavor_text: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

name: Swadloon
flavor_text: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.

name: Swadloon
flavor_text: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

name: Leavanny
flavor_text: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

name: Leavanny
flavor_text: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.

name: Cottonee
flavor_text: They go wherever the wind takes them. On rainy days, their bodies are heavier, so they take shelter beneath big trees.

name: Cottonee
flavor_text: When attacked, it escapes by shooting cotton from its body. The cotton serves as a decoy to distract the attacker.

name: Whimsicott
flavor_text: Like the wind, it can slip through any gap, no matter how small. It leaves balls of white fluff behind.

name: Whimsicott
flavor_text: Riding whirlwinds, they appear. These Pokémon sneak through gaps into houses and cause all sorts of mischief.

name: Petilil
flavor_text: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.

name: Lilligant
flavor_text: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokémon is popular with celebrities.

name: Deerling
flavor_text: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

name: Sawsbuck
flavor_text: The plants growing on its horns change according to the season. The leaders of the herd possess magnificent horns.

name: Virizion
flavor_text: This Pokémon fought humans in order to protect its friends. Legends about it continue to be passed down.

name: Pansear
flavor_text: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600º F.

name: Simisear
flavor_text: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

name: Darumaka
flavor_text: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.

name: Darmanitan
flavor_text: Its internal fire burns at 2,500º F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

name: Panpour
flavor_text: It does not thrive in dry environments. It keeps itself damp by shooting water stored in its head tuft from its tail.

name: Simipour
flavor_text: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.

name: Basculin
flavor_text: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they'll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.

name: Basculin
flavor_text: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other's school.

name: Ducklett
flavor_text: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

name: Swanna
flavor_text: It administers sharp, powerful pecks with its bill. It whips its long neck to deliver forceful repeated strikes.

name: Cubchoo
flavor_text: When it is not feeling well, its mucus gets watery and the power of its Ice-type moves decreases.

name: Cubchoo
flavor_text: Its nose is always running. It sniffs the snot back up because the mucus provides the raw material for its moves.

name: Beartic
flavor_text: It can make its breath freeze at will. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.

name: Beartic
flavor_text: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Cold northern areas are its habitat.

name: Emolga
flavor_text: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its membranes and released while it is gliding.

name: Joltik
flavor_text: Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.

name: Galvantula
flavor_text: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

name: Thundurus
flavor_text: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

name: Woobat
flavor_text: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

name: Swoobat
flavor_text: Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.

name: Venipede
flavor_text: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.

name: Whirlipede
flavor_text: It is usually motionless, but when attacked, it rotates at high speed and then crashes into its opponent.

name: Scolipede
flavor_text: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails.

name: Sigilyph
flavor_text: The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.

name: Sigilyph
flavor_text: They never vary the route they fly, because their memories of guarding an ancient city remain steadfast.

name: Gothita
flavor_text: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

name: Gothita
flavor_text: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, they are looking at something that only Gothita can see.

name: Gothorita
flavor_text: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

name: Gothorita
flavor_text: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

name: Gothitelle
flavor_text: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

name: Gothitelle
flavor_text: They can predict the future from the placement and movement of the stars. They can see Trainers' life spans.

name: Roggenrola
flavor_text: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.

name: Roggenrola
flavor_text: They were discovered a hundred years ago in an earthquake fissure. Inside each one is an energy core.

name: Boldore
flavor_text: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.

name: Boldore
flavor_text: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.

name: Gigalith
flavor_text: The solar energy absorbed by its body's orange crystals is magnified internally and fired from its mouth.

name: Drilbur
flavor_text: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

name: Drilbur
flavor_text: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

name: Excadrill
flavor_text: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

name: Excadrill
flavor_text: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels.

name: Throh
flavor_text: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

name: Sawk
flavor_text: Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.

name: Sandile
flavor_text: They live buried in the sands of the desert. The sun-warmed sands prevent their body temperature from dropping.

name: Krokorok
flavor_text: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.

name: Krookodile
flavor_text: They never allow prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

name: Terrakion
flavor_text: This Pokémon came to the defense of Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

name: Purrloin
flavor_text: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

name: Liepard
flavor_text: These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur.

name: Zorua
flavor_text: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

name: Zoroark
flavor_text: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

name: Vullaby
flavor_text: They tend to guard their posteriors with suitable bones they have found. They pursue weak Pokémon.

name: Mandibuzz
flavor_text: Watching from the sky, they swoop to strike weakened Pokémon on the ground. They decorate themselves with bones.

name: Ferroseed
flavor_text: They stick their spikes into cave walls and absorb the minerals they find in the rock.

name: Ferroseed
flavor_text: When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes, which gives it a chance to escape by rolling away.

name: Ferrothorn
flavor_text: They attach themselves to cave ceilings, firing steel spikes at targets passing beneath them.

name: Ferrothorn
flavor_text: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.

name: Klink
flavor_text: Interlocking two bodies and spinning around generates the energy they need to live.

name: Klang
flavor_text: Spinning minigears are rotated at high speed and repeatedly fired away. It is dangerous if the gears don't return.

name: Klinklang
flavor_text: The gear with the red core is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge.

name: Cobalion
flavor_text: This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.

name: Patrat
flavor_text: Extremely cautious, they take shifts to maintain a constant watch of their nest. They feel insecure without a lookout.

name: Watchog
flavor_text: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.

name: Pidove
flavor_text: Each follows its Trainer's orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.

name: Tranquill
flavor_text: Many people believe that, deep in the forest where Tranquill live, there is a peaceful place where there is no war.

name: Unfezant
flavor_text: Males have plumage on their heads. They will never let themselves fell close to anyone other than their Trainers.

name: Audino
flavor_text: Its auditory sense is astounding. It has a radar-like ability to understand its surrounding through slight sounds.

name: Minccino
flavor_text: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They are always sweeping and dusting, using their tails as brooms.

name: Cinccino
flavor_text: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Their fur repels dust and prevents static electricity from building up.

name: Rufflet
flavor_text: They will challenge anything, even strong opponents, without fear. Their frequent fights help them become stronger.

name: Rufflet
flavor_text: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.

name: Braviary
flavor_text: The more scars they have, the more respect these brave soldiers of the sky get from their peers.

name: Tornadus
flavor_text: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

name: Tornadus
flavor_text: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

name: Sewaddle
flavor_text: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

name: Swadloon
flavor_text: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

name: Leavanny
flavor_text: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using cutters on its arms and sticky silk.

name: Petilil
flavor_text: Since they prefer moist, nutrient-rich soil, the areas where Petilil live are known to be good for growing plants.

name: Lilligant
flavor_text: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.

name: Dwebble
flavor_text: The Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.

name: Crustle
flavor_text: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle.

name: Karrablast
flavor_text: When they feel threatened, they spit acidic liquid to drive attackers away. This Pokémon targets Shelmet.

name: Foongus
flavor_text: For some reason, this Pokémon resembles a Poké Ball. They release poison spores to repel those who try to catch them.

name: Amoonguss
flavor_text: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

name: Shelmet
flavor_text: It evolves when bathed in an electric-like energy along with Karrablast. The reason is still unknown.

name: Accelgor
flavor_text: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.

name: Virizion
flavor_text: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Using whirlwind-like movements, it confounds and swiftly cuts opponents.

name: Victini
flavor_text: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

name: Victini
flavor_text: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

name: Pansear
flavor_text: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600° F.

name: Simisear
flavor_text: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

name: Heatmor
flavor_text: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.

name: Larvesta
flavor_text: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. When it evolves, its entire body is engulfed in flames.

name: Larvesta
flavor_text: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.

name: Volcarona
flavor_text: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.

name: Tympole
flavor_text: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.

name: Palpitoad
flavor_text: It lives in water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to capture prey.

name: Seismitoad
flavor_text: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.

name: Tirtouga
rules: Put this card onto your Bench only with the effect of Cover Fossil
flavor_text: Restored from a fossil, this Pokémon can dive to depths beyond half a mile.

name: Carracosta
flavor_text: They can live both in the ocean and on land. A slap from one of them is enough to open a hole in the bottom of a tanker.

name: Vanillite
flavor_text: This Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. It sleeps buried in snow.

name: Vanillish
flavor_text: It conceals itself from enemy eyes by creating many small ice particles and hiding among them.

name: Vanilluxe
flavor_text: If both heads get angry simultaneously, this Pokémon expels a blizzard, burying everything in snow.

name: Frillish
flavor_text: With its thin, veil-like arms wrapped around the body of its opponent, it sinks to the ocean floor.

name: Jellicent
flavor_text: The fate of ships and crew that wander into Jellicent's habitats: all sunken, all lost, all vanished.

name: Cryogonal
flavor_text: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

name: Cryogonal
flavor_text: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

name: Kyurem
flavor_text: It generates powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

name: Blitzle
flavor_text: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

name: Zebstrika
flavor_text: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

name: Emolga
flavor_text: They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.

name: Tynamo
flavor_text: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

name: Tynamo
flavor_text: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

name: Eelektrik
flavor_text: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.

name: Eelektross
flavor_text: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

name: Stunfisk
flavor_text: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

name: Victini
flavor_text: It creates an unlimited supply of energy inside its body, which it shares with those who touch it.

name: Yamask
flavor_text: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

name: Yamask
flavor_text: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves in past ages. Each retains memories of its former life.

name: Cofagrigus
flavor_text: It has been said that they swallow those who get too close and turn them into mummies. They like to eat gold nuggets.

name: Cofagrigus
flavor_text: They pretend to be elaborate coffins to teach lessons to grave robbers. Their bodies are covered in pure gold.

name: Trubbish
flavor_text: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokémon.

name: Garbodor
flavor_text: They absorb garbage and make it part of their bodies. They shoot poisonous liquid from their right-hand fingertips.

name: Solosis
flavor_text: They drive away attackers by unleashing psychic power. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

name: Duosion
flavor_text: Since they have two divided brains, at times they suddenly try to take two different actions at once.

name: Reuniclus
flavor_text: When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains, increasing their psychic power.

name: Reuniclus
flavor_text: These remarkably intelligent Pokémon fight by controlling arms that can grip with rock-crushing power.

name: Elgyem
flavor_text: This Pokémon had never been seen until it appeared from far in the desert 50 years ago.

name: Elgyem
flavor_text: It uses its strong psychic power to squeeze its opponent's brain, causing unendurable headaches.

name: Beheeyem
flavor_text: It uses psychic power to control an opponent's brain and tamper with its memories.

name: Litwick
flavor_text: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel it burns.

name: Litwick
flavor_text: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leaches off the life force of any who follow it.

name: Lampent
flavor_text: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen.

name: Chandelure
flavor_text: It absorbs a spirit, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

name: Gigalith
flavor_text: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.

name: Timburr
flavor_text: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.

name: Gurdurr
flavor_text: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

name: Conkeldurr
flavor_text: It it thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

name: Conkeldurr
flavor_text: They use concrete pillars as walking canes. They know moves that enable them to swing the pillars freely in battle.

name: Archen
rules: Put this card onto your Bench only with the effect of Plume Fossil
flavor_text: Said to be an ancestor of bird Pokémon, they were unable to fly and moved about by hopping from one branch to another.

name: Archeops
flavor_text: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.

name: Stunfisk
flavor_text: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a volt of electricity.

name: Mienfoo
flavor_text: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attack. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

name: Mienshao
flavor_text: It wield the fur on its arms like a whip. Its arms attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

name: Golett
flavor_text: These Pokémon are thought to have been created by the science of an ancient and mysterious civilization.

name: Golurk
flavor_text: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.

name: Terrakion
flavor_text: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.

name: Landorus
flavor_text: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."

name: Pawniard
flavor_text: They fight at Bisharp's command. They cling to their prey and inflict damage by sinking their blades into it.

name: Bisharp
flavor_text: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.

name: Deino
flavor_text: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.

name: Zweilous
flavor_text: Since their two heads do not get along and compete with each other for food, they always eat too much.

name: Hydreigon
flavor_text: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

name: Escavalier
flavor_text: These Pokémon evolve by wearing the shell covering of a Shelmet. The steel armor protects their whole body.

name: Pawniard
flavor_text: Blades comprise this Pokémon's entire body. If battling dulls the blades, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

name: Bisharp
flavor_text: It leads a group of Pawniard. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.

name: Durant
flavor_text: They attack in groups, covering themselves in steel armor to protect themselves against Heatmor.

name: Cobalion
flavor_text: It has a body and heart of steel. Its glare is sufficient to make even an unruly Pokémon obey it.

name: Audino
flavor_text: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

name: Axew
flavor_text: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

name: Fraxure
flavor_text: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they've been fighting.

name: Haxorus
flavor_text: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.

name: Druddigon
flavor_text: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.

name: Pansage

name: Dwebble
flavor_text: The Pokémon can easily melt holes in hard rocks with a liquid secreted from its mouth.

name: Pignite
flavor_text: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

name: Dewott
flavor_text: Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops.

name: Emolga
flavor_text: The energy made in its cheeks' electric pouches is stored inside its membranes and released while it is gliding.

name: Woobat
flavor_text: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

name: Drilbur
flavor_text: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

name: Purrloin
flavor_text: They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them. Their deceptively cute act is perfect.

name: Scraggy
flavor_text: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

name: Klang
flavor_text: Spinning minigears are rotated at high speed and repeatedly fired away. It is dangerous if the gears don't return.

name: Axew
flavor_text: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

name: Hoppip
flavor_text: It drifts on winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

name: Skiploom
flavor_text: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.

name: Jumpluff
flavor_text: Blown by the seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.

name: Yanma
flavor_text: It can hover in one spot by flapping its wings at high speed. It flits about to guard its territory.

name: Yanmega
flavor_text: Its jaw power is incredible. It is adept at biting apart foes while flying by at high speed.

name: Wurmple
flavor_text: Often targeted by bird Pokémon, it desperately resists by releasing poison from its tail spikes.

name: Silcoon
flavor_text: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.

name: Beautifly
flavor_text: Despite its looks, it is aggressive. It jabs with its long, thin mouth if disturbed while collecting pollen.

name: Cascoon
flavor_text: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.

name: Nincada
flavor_text: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.

name: Ninjask
flavor_text: Because it moves so quickly, it sometimes becomes unseeable. It congregates around tree sap.

name: Roselia
flavor_text: The more healthy the Roselia, the more pleasant its flowers' aroma. Its scent deeply relaxes people.

name: Roselia

name: Roserade
flavor_text: Each of its hands contains different toxins, but both hands can jab with near-fatal power.

name: Roserade

name: Maractus
flavor_text: Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.

name: Foongus
flavor_text: For some reason, this Pokémon resembles a Poké Ball. They release poison spores to repel those who try to catch them.

name: Vulpix
flavor_text: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.

name: Ninetales
flavor_text: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. It can live for a thousand years.

name: Magmar
flavor_text: When it breathes deeply, heat waves form around its body, making it hard to see clearly.

name: Magmortar
flavor_text: When launching 3,600 degrees F fireballs, its body takes on a whitish hue from the intense heat.

name: Ho-Oh-EX

name: Magikarp
flavor_text: A Magikarp living for many years can leap a mountain using Splash. The move remains useless, though.

name: Gyarados
flavor_text: Once it begins to rampage, a Gyarados will burn everything down, even in a harsh storm.

name: Wailmer
flavor_text: On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. It spouts water from its nose.

name: Wailord
flavor_text: The biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.

name: Feebas
flavor_text: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.

name: Milotic
flavor_text: Its lovely scales are described as rainbow colored. They change color depending on the viewing angle.

name: Spheal
flavor_text: It rolls across ice floes to reach shore because its body is poorly shaped for swimming.

name: Sealeo
flavor_text: It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so, it learns textures and odors.

name: Walrein
flavor_text: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.

name: Buizel
flavor_text: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through the water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

name: Floatzel
flavor_text: It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is known to rescue people and carry off prey.

name: Tympole
flavor_text: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk.

name: Palpitoad
flavor_text: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, the can make wave in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

name: Seismitoad
flavor_text: They shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps. They use vibration to hurt their opponents.

name: Alomomola
flavor_text: The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.

name: Mareep
flavor_text: Its fluffy coat swells to double when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

name: Flaaffy
flavor_text: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

name: Ampharos
flavor_text: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail's light.

name: Electrike
flavor_text: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

name: Electrike
flavor_text: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

name: Manectric
flavor_text: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

name: Manectric

name: Emolga
flavor_text: They live on treetops and glide using the inside of a cape-like membrane while discharging electricity.

name: Mew-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Dustox
flavor_text: Toxic powder is scattered with each flap. At night, it is known to strip leaves off trees lining boulevards.

name: Shedinja
flavor_text: A discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one's spirit.

name: Drifloon
flavor_text: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a "Signpost for Wandering Spirits."

name: Drifloon

name: Drifblim
flavor_text: At dusk, swarms of them are carried aloft on winds. When noticed, they suddenly vanish.

name: Sigilyph
flavor_text: The guardians of an ancient city, they use their psychic power to attack enemies that invade their territory.

name: Trubbish
flavor_text: Inhaling the gas they belch will make you sleep for a week. They prefer unsanitary places.

name: Garbodor
flavor_text: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.

name: Gothita
flavor_text: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, they are looking at something that only Gothita can see.

name: Gothorita
flavor_text: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

name: Gothitelle
flavor_text: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

name: Golett
flavor_text: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

name: Golurk
flavor_text: It flies around the sky at Mach speeds. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

name: Cubone
flavor_text: When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.

name: Marowak
flavor_text: From its birth, this savage Pokémon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.

name: Nosepass
flavor_text: When endangered, it may protect itself by raising its magnetism and drawing iron objects to its body.

name: Baltoy
flavor_text: It move by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.

name: Claydol
flavor_text: An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.

name: Roggenrola
flavor_text: They were discovered a hundred years ago in an earthquake fissure. Inside each one is an energy core.

name: Boldore
flavor_text: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.

name: Gigalith
flavor_text: The solar energy absorbed by its body's orange crystals is magnified internally are fired from its mouth.

name: Throh
flavor_text: When they encounter foes bigger than themselves, they try to throw them. They always travel in packs of five.

name: Sawk
flavor_text: Tying their belts gets them pumped and makes their punches more destructive. Disturbing their training angers them.

name: Stunfisk
flavor_text: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.

name: Terrakion-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Murkrow
flavor_text: If spotted, it will lure an unwary person into chasing it, then lose the pursuer on mountain trails.

name: Honchkrow
flavor_text: If one utters a deep cry, many Murkrow gather quickly. For this, it is called "Summoner of Night."

name: Houndour
flavor_text: It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a variety of cries for communicating with others.

name: Houndoom
flavor_text: The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.

name: Stunky
flavor_text: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.

name: Skuntank
flavor_text: It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly fluid from the tip of its tail. Attacks from above confound it.

name: Aron
flavor_text: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.

name: Lairon
flavor_text: For food, it digs up iron ore. It smashes it steely body against others to fight over territory.

name: Aggron
flavor_text: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

name: Registeel-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Probopass
flavor_text: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.

name: Durant
flavor_text: Durant dig nests in mountains. They build their complicated, interconnected tunnels into mazes.

name: Altaria
flavor_text: If it bonds with a person, it will gently envelop the friend with its soft wings, then hum.

name: Rayquaza-EX

name: Zweilous
flavor_text: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

name: Zweilous
flavor_text: Since their two heads do not get along and compete with each other for food, they always eat too much.

name: Hydreigon
flavor_text: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. Anything that moves seems like a foe to it, triggering its attack.

name: Hydreigon
flavor_text: The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

name: Aipom
flavor_text: It lives high among the treetops. It can us its tail as freely and cleverly as its hands.

name: Ambipom
flavor_text: Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and doing things, Ambipom rarely uses its hands.

name: Slakoth
flavor_text: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.

name: Vigoroth
flavor_text: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still for even a moment.

name: Slaking
flavor_text: The world's laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.

name: Swablu
flavor_text: It can't relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes of dirt with its wings.

name: Swablu

name: Bidoof
flavor_text: A comparison revealed that Bidoof's front teeth grow at the same rate as Rattata's.

name: Bibarel
flavor_text: A river dammed by Bibarel will never overflow its banks, which is appreciated by the people nearby.

name: Audino
flavor_text: Its auditory sense is astounding. It has radarlike ability to understand its surroundings through slight sounds.

name: Minccino
flavor_text: They great one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.

name: Bouffalant
flavor_text: They charge wildly and headbutt everything. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a trail.

name: Rufflet
flavor_text: They crush berries with their talons. They bravely stand up to any opponent, no matter how strong it is.

name: Braviary
flavor_text: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

name: Dragonite
flavor_text: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides crews of shipwrecks to shore.

name: Bagon
flavor_text: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.

name: Shelgon
flavor_text: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant it evolves.

name: Salamence
flavor_text: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.

name: Latias
flavor_text: Its body is covered in a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.

name: Latios
flavor_text: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.

name: Rayquaza
flavor_text: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

name: Axew
flavor_text: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

name: Axew
flavor_text: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly.

name: Fraxure
flavor_text: Since a broken tusk will not grow back, they diligently sharpen their tusks on river rocks after they've been fighting.

name: Fraxure
flavor_text: Their tusks can shatter rocks. Territory battles between Fraxure can be intensely violent.

name: Haxorus
flavor_text: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.

name: Druddigon
flavor_text: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.

name: Kyurem
flavor_text: It can produce ultracold air. Its body is frozen.

name: Oddish
flavor_text: It often plants its root feet in the ground during the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.

name: Gloom
flavor_text: The honey it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious, it can curl noses more than a mile away.

name: Vileplume
flavor_text: Its petals are the largest in the world. As it walks, it scatters extremely allergenic pollen.

name: Bellossom
flavor_text: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.

name: Tangela
flavor_text: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

name: Tangrowth
flavor_text: Even if one of its arms is eaten, it's fine. The Pokémon regenerates quickly and will go right back to normal.

name: Scyther
flavor_text: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.

name: Heracross
flavor_text: No matter how heavy its opponents, it flings them far away with its prized horn.

name: Celebi-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Shaymin
flavor_text: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.

name: Snivy
flavor_text: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

name: Servine
flavor_text: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.

name: Serperior
flavor_text: It can stop its opponents' movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.

name: Cottonee
flavor_text: Perhaps because they feel more at ease in a group, they stick to others they find. They end up looking like a cloud.

name: Whimsicott
flavor_text: They appear along with whirlwinds. They pull pranks, such as moving furniture and leaving balls of cotton in homes.

name: Petilil
flavor_text: The leaves on its head grow right back even if they fall out. These bitter leaves refresh those who eat them.

name: Lilligant
flavor_text: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect, but taking care of it is very difficult.

name: Charmander
flavor_text: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If healthy, its tail burns intensely.

name: Charmeleon
flavor_text: In the rocky mountains where Charmeleon live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.

name: Charizard
flavor_text: It is said that Charizard's fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.

name: Numel
flavor_text: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees F. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

name: Camerupt
flavor_text: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years–or whenever it becomes really angry.

name: Victini
flavor_text: It creates an unlimited supply of energy inside its body, which it shares with those who touch it.

name: Tepig
flavor_text: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

name: Pignite
flavor_text: Whatever it eats becomes fuel for the flame in its stomach. When it is angered, the intensity of the flame increases.

name: Emboar
flavor_text: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

name: Darumaka
flavor_text: When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs into its body and its internal fire goes down to 1,100 F.

name: Darmanitan
flavor_text: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it hardens into a stone-like form. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind.

name: Squirtle
flavor_text: It shelters itself in its shell then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

name: Wartortle
flavor_text: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.

name: Blastoise
flavor_text: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

name: Psyduck
flavor_text: Overwhelmed by enigmatic abilities, it suffers a constant headache. It sometimes uses mysterious powers.

name: Psyduck
flavor_text: When headaches stimulate its brain cells, which are usually inactive, it can use a mysterious power.

name: Golduck
flavor_text: It is seen swimming dynamically and elegantly using its well-developed limbs and flippers.

name: Golduck
flavor_text: When its forehead shines mysteriously, Golduck can use the full extent of its power.

name: Marill
flavor_text: The oil-filled tail functions as a buoy, so it's fine even in rivers with strong currents.

name: Azumarill
flavor_text: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of things in water and tell what they are.

name: Delibird
flavor_text: It carries food all day long. When someone is lost in the mountains, it shares that food.

name: Oshawott
flavor_text: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

name: Dewott
flavor_text: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.

name: Samurott
flavor_text: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

name: Ducklett
flavor_text: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

name: Swanna
flavor_text: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.

name: Frillish
flavor_text: If its veil-like arms stun and wrap a foe, that foe will be dragged miles below the surface, never to return.

name: Jellicent
flavor_text: Its body is mostly seawater. It's said there's a castle of ships Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.

name: Cryogonal
flavor_text: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.

name: Keldeo
flavor_text: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.

name: Keldeo
flavor_text: By blasting water from its hooves, it can glide across water. It excels at using leg moves while battling.

name: Keldeo-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Pikachu
flavor_text: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

name: Voltorb
flavor_text: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on contact.

name: Electrode
flavor_text: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

name: Electabuzz
flavor_text: Research is progressing on storing lightning in Electabuzz so this energy can be used at any time.

name: Electivire
flavor_text: The instant it presses the tips of its tails onto an opponent, it sends over 20,000 volts of electricity into the foe.

name: Chinchou
flavor_text: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.

name: Blitzle
flavor_text: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

name: Zebstrika
flavor_text: When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

name: Wobbuffet
flavor_text: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. It is said to be proof the tail hides a secret.

name: Spoink
flavor_text: Using its tail like a spring, it keeps its heart beating by bouncing constantly. If it stops, it dies.

name: Grumpig
flavor_text: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does a strange dance to control foes' minds.

name: Duskull
flavor_text: It loves the crying of children. It startles bad kids by passing through walls and making them cry.

name: Dusclops
flavor_text: It seeks drifting will-o'-the-wisps and sucks them into its empty body. What happens inside is a mystery.

name: Dusknoir
flavor_text: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

name: Croagunk
flavor_text: It rarely fights fairly, but that is strictly to ensure survival. It is popular as a mascot.

name: Croagunk
flavor_text: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

name: Toxicroak
flavor_text: The croaking that Toxicroak produces before a battle is for churning the poison it has stored in its poison sac.

name: Cresselia-EX

name: Munna

name: Musharna

name: Woobat
flavor_text: The heart-shaped mark left on a body after a Woobat has been attached to it is said to bring good fortune.

name: Swoobat
flavor_text: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.

name: Venipede
flavor_text: Using the feelers on its head and tail, it picks up vibrations in the air to determine its prey's location and state.

name: Whirlipede
flavor_text: Storing energy for evolution, it sits. But, when predators approach, it moves to stab them with poison spikes.

name: Scolipede
flavor_text: It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving. Then it finishes it off with deadly poison.

name: Gothita
flavor_text: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

name: Gothorita
flavor_text: They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading people astray are told in every corner.

name: Meloetta

name: Sandshrew

name: Sandslash
flavor_text: The spikes on its body are made up of its hardened hide. It rolls up and attacks foes with its spikes.

name: Gligar

name: Gliscor

name: Makuhita

name: Trapinch

name: Dwebble

name: Crustle
