name: Mienfoo
flavor_text: In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp claws, they cut enemies.

name: Mienfoo
flavor_text: It takes pride in the speed at which it can use moves. What it loses in power, it makes up for in quantity.

name: Mienshao
flavor_text: Using the long fur on its arms like whips, it launches into combo attacks that, once started, no one can stop.

name: Scizor

name: Patrat

name: Watchog

name: Stoutland

name: Tranquill

name: Unfezant

name: Kakuna

name: Exeggutor
flavor_text: It is called "The Walking Jungle." If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an Exeggcute.

name: Treecko
flavor_text: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.

name: Grovyle

name: Sceptile
flavor_text: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.

name: Cacnea
flavor_text: By storing water in its body, this desert dweller can survive for 30 days without water.

name: Cacturne
flavor_text: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day's desert heat.

name: Leafeon
flavor_text: With cells similar to those of plants, it performs photosynthesis inside its body and creates pure air.

name: Flareon
flavor_text: Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac, heated, and exhaled as fire that reaches over 3,000 degrees F.

name: Heatran-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Litwick
flavor_text: Its flame is usually out, but it starts shining when it absorbs life force from people or Pokémon.

name: Lampent
flavor_text: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

name: Chandelure
flavor_text: The spirits burned up in its ominous flame lose their way and wander this world forever.

name: Reshiram
flavor_text: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with fire. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.

name: Horsea
flavor_text: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

name: Seadra
flavor_text: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional-medicine ingredients.

name: Vaporeon
flavor_text: Its cell composition is similar to water molecules. As a result, it can't be seen when it melts away into water.

name: Wooper
flavor_text: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.

name: Quagsire
flavor_text: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn't care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.

name: Glaceon
flavor_text: It lowers its body heat to freeze its fur. The hairs then become like needles it can fire.

name: Tympole
flavor_text: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans and warns others of danger.

name: Palpitoad
flavor_text: It lives in the water and on land. It uses its long, sticky tongue to immobilize its opponents.

name: Seismitoad
flavor_text: By putting power into its bumps, it creates vibrations and increases the power of its punches.

name: Vanillite
flavor_text: Theoretically, this Pokémon formed from icicles bathed in energy from the morning sun. Their breath is -58° F.

name: Vanillish
flavor_text: They cool down the surrounding air and create ice particles, which they use to freeze their foes.

name: Vanilluxe
flavor_text: Swallowing large amounts of water, they make snow clouds inside their bodies and, when angry, cause violent blizzards.

name: Cryogonal
flavor_text: They are composed of ice crystals. They capture prey with chains of ice, freezing the prey at -148° F.

name: Kyurem
flavor_text: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

name: Voltorb
flavor_text: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.

name: Electrode
flavor_text: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

name: Jolteon
flavor_text: By storing electricity in its body, it can shoot its bristlelike fur like a barrage of missiles.

name: Chinchou
flavor_text: It discharges positive and negative electricity from its antenna tips to shock its foes.

name: Lanturn
flavor_text: Lanturn's light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed "The Deep-Sea Star."

name: Pachirisu
flavor_text: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

name: Thundurus-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Zekrom
flavor_text: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with lightning. It assists those who want to build an ideal world.

name: Nidoran ♀
flavor_text: While it does not prefer to fight, even one drop of the poison it secretes from its barbs can be fatal.

name: Nidorina
flavor_text: When it senses danger, it raises all the barbs on its body. These barbs grow slower than Nidorino's.

name: Nidoqueen
flavor_text: Its entire body is armored with hard scales. It will protect the young in its burrow with its life.

name: Nidoran ♂
flavor_text: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.

name: Nidorino
flavor_text: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes poison upon impact.

name: Grimer
flavor_text: Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gather in polluted places and increase the bacteria in their bodies.

name: Muk
flavor_text: It's so stinky! Muk's body contains toxic elements, and any plant will wilt when it passes by.

name: Mr. Mime
flavor_text: It shapes an invisible wall in midair by minutely vibrating its fingertips to stop molecules in the air.

name: Espeon
flavor_text: Its fur is so sensitive, it can feel minute shifts in the air and predict the weather…and its foes' thoughts.

name: Sableye
flavor_text: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

name: Beldum
flavor_text: Its cells are all magnetic, and it communicates with others by using magnetic pulses.

name: Metang
flavor_text: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its two brains are linked, amplifying its psychic power.

name: Metagross
flavor_text: With four linked brains, it's more intelligent than a supercomputer, and it uses calculations to analyze foes.

name: Deoxys-EX

name: Nidoking

name: Mankey
flavor_text: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.

name: Primeape
flavor_text: It grows angry if you see its eyes and gets angrier if you run. If you beat it, it gets even madder.

name: Onix
flavor_text: Opening its large mouth, it ingests massive amounts of soil and creates long tunnels.

flavor_text: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.

name: Hariyama
flavor_text: It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon. It can knock a truck flying with its arm thrusts.

name: Umbreon

name: Sneasel
flavor_text: A smart and sneaky Pokémon, it makes its opponents flinch by suddenly showing the claws hidden in its paws.

name: Weavile
flavor_text: They communicate by clawing signs in boulders and work together to surround enemies.

name: Absol
flavor_text: It appears from deep in the mountains to warn people about upcoming disasters it has sensed with its horn.

name: Sandile
flavor_text: They live hidden under hot desert sands in order to keep their body temperature from dropping.

name: Krokorok

name: Dragonite

name: Tropius
flavor_text: It flies by flapping its broad leaves and gives the sweet, delicious fruit around its neck to children.

name: Karrablast
flavor_text: For some reason they evolve when they receive electrical energy while they are attacking Shelmet.

name: Shelmet
flavor_text: When it and Karrablast are together, and both receive electrical stimulation, they both evolve.

name: Accelgor
flavor_text: When its body dries out, it weakens. So it wraps a membrane around itself for protection while it spits poison.

name: Virizion-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Genesect

name: Genesect-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Larvesta
flavor_text: Said to have been born from the sun, it spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.

name: Volcarona
flavor_text: Thought to be an embodiment of the sun, it appeared during a bitterly cold winter and saved Pokémon from freezing.

name: Squirtle
flavor_text: It shelters itself in its shell then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

name: Wartortle
flavor_text: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.

name: Blastoise
flavor_text: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

name: Lapras
flavor_text: Able to understand human speech and very intelligent, it loves to swim in the sea with people on its back.

name: Remoraid
flavor_text: The water they shoot from their mouths can hit moving prey from more than 300 feet away.

name: Octillery
flavor_text: It has a tendency to want to be in holes. It prefers rock crags or pots and sprays ink from them before attacking.

name: Suicune
flavor_text: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.

name: Snorunt
flavor_text: It is said that several Snorunt gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.

name: Glalie
flavor_text: It prevents prey from escaping by instantaneously freezing moisture in the air.

name: Froslass
flavor_text: It freezes prey by blowing its -58 degrees F breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.

name: Relicanth
flavor_text: A rare Pokémon discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.

name: Snover
flavor_text: Seemingly curious about people, they gather around footsteps they find on snowy mountains.

name: Abomasnow
flavor_text: They appear when the snow flowers bloom. When the petals fall, they retreat to places unknown again.

name: Tirtouga

name: Carracosta
flavor_text: It could knock out a foe with a slap from one of its developed front appendages and chew it up, shell or bones and all.

name: Ducklett
flavor_text: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

name: Kyurem-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Tynamo
flavor_text: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

name: Eelektrik
flavor_text: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

name: Eelektross
flavor_text: It latches on to prey with its sucker mouth, sinking in its fangs and shocking the prey with powerful electricity.

name: Drifloon
flavor_text: These Pokémon are called the "Signpost for Wandering Spirits." Children holding them sometimes vanish.

name: Drifblim
flavor_text: They carry people and Pokémon, but the wind can catch them, so there can't be a fixed destination.

name: Uxie

name: Mesprit
flavor_text: When Mesprit flew, people learned the joy and sadness of living. It was the birth of emotions.

name: Azelf
flavor_text: When Azelf flew, people gained the determination to do things. It was the birth of willpower.

name: Munna
flavor_text: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.

name: Musharna
flavor_text: The dream mist coming from its forehead changes into many different colors depending on the dream that was eaten.

name: Sigilyph
flavor_text: The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly the same route while keeping watch for invaders.

name: Solosis
flavor_text: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they are fine in any environment, no matter how severe.

name: Duosion
flavor_text: When their two divided brains think the same thoughts, their psychic power is maximized.

name: Reuniclus
flavor_text: They use psychic power to control their arms, which are made of a special liquid. They can crush boulders psychically.

name: Golett
flavor_text: Ancient science fashioned this Pokémon from clay. It's been active for thousands of years.

name: Golurk
flavor_text: Golurk were created to protect people and Pokémon. They run on a mysterious energy.

name: Machop

name: Machoke

name: Machamp

name: Sawk
flavor_text: Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.

name: Litleo

name: Pyroar
flavor_text: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.

name: Qwilfish
flavor_text: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

name: Feebas
flavor_text: It eats anything, so it can even live in polluted streams and lakes. No one pays any attention to it.

name: Milotic
flavor_text: Milotic is breathtakingly beautiful. Those that see it are said to forget their combative spirits.

name: Spheal
flavor_text: They can't swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they're happy they clap fins.

name: Sealeo
flavor_text: It has a very sensitive nose. It touches new things with its nose to examine them.

name: Walrein
flavor_text: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.

name: Luvdisc
flavor_text: It lives in warm seas. It is said that a couple finding this Pokémon will be blessed with eternal love.

name: Buizel
flavor_text: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.

name: Floatzel
flavor_text: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

name: Bergmite
flavor_text: It blocks opponents' attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice.

name: Avalugg
flavor_text: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

name: Shinx
flavor_text: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

name: Luxio
flavor_text: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.

name: Luxray
flavor_text: When its eyes gleam gold, it can spot hiding prey–even those taking shelter behind a wall.

name: Magnezone-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Helioptile
flavor_text: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

name: Heliolisk
flavor_text: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

name: Duskull
flavor_text: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.

name: Dusclops
flavor_text: Anyone who dares peer into its body to see its spectral ball of fire will have their spirit stolen away.

name: Dusknoir
flavor_text: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

name: Toxicroak-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Espurr
flavor_text: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.

name: Meowstic
flavor_text: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

name: Skrelp
flavor_text: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, they spray liquid poison on prey that approaches unawares and then finish it off.

name: Geodude
flavor_text: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.

name: Graveler
flavor_text: With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn't mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.

name: Golem
flavor_text: It tumbles down mountains, leaving grooves from peak to base. Stay clear of these grooves.

name: Binacle
flavor_text: Two Binacle live together on one rock. When they fight, one of them will move to a different rock.

name: Barbaracle
flavor_text: When they evolve, two Binacle multiply into seven. They fight with the power of seven Binacle.

name: Sneasel
flavor_text: It feeds on eggs stolen from nests. Its sharply hooked claws rip vulnerable spots on prey.

name: Sneasel

name: Weavile
flavor_text: It lives in snowy regions. It carves patterns in trees with its claws as a signal to others.

name: Stunky
flavor_text: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.

name: Stunky

name: Skuntank
flavor_text: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.

name: Sandile
flavor_text: It moves along below the sand's surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.

name: Krokorok
flavor_text: They live in groups of a few individuals. Protective membranes shield their eyes from sandstorms.

name: Scraggy
flavor_text: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling it skin up to its neck.

name: Scrafty
flavor_text: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.

name: Forretress
flavor_text: It is encased in a steel shell. Its peering eyes are all that can be seen of its mysterious innards.

name: Durant
flavor_text: Individuals each play different roles in driving Heatmor, their natural predator, away from their colony.

name: Flabébé
flavor_text: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.

name: Floette

name: Florges
flavor_text: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.

name: Spritzee
flavor_text: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.

name: Carbink
flavor_text: Born from temperatures and pressures deep underground, it fires beams from the stone in its head.

name: Druddigon
flavor_text: It races through narrow caves, using its sharp claws to catch prey. The skin on its face is harder than a rock.

name: Dragalge
flavor_text: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker, and they spit it indiscriminately at anything that enters their territory.

name: Goomy
flavor_text: The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn't dry out.

name: Sliggoo
flavor_text: It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can't see anything.

name: Goodra
flavor_text: This very friendly Dragon-type Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.

name: Pidgey
flavor_text: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

name: Pidgeotto
flavor_text: The claws on its feet are well developed. It can carry prey such as an Exeggcute to its nest over 60 miles away.

name: Pidgeot
flavor_text: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as Magikarp.

name: Sentret

name: Furret
flavor_text: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.

name: Miltank
flavor_text: If it is around babies, the milk it produces contains much more nutrition than usual.

name: Buneary
flavor_text: Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.

name: Lopunny

flavor_text: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

name: Chespin
flavor_text: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

name: Fennekin
flavor_text: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Froakie
flavor_text: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

name: Pikachu
flavor_text: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

name: Inkay
flavor_text: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

name: Honedge
flavor_text: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.

name: Snubbull
flavor_text: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.

name: Swirlix
flavor_text: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.

name: Bunnelby
flavor_text: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

name: Fletchling
flavor_text: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

name: Furfrou
flavor_text: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

name: Bellsprout
flavor_text: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.

name: Weepinbell
flavor_text: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.

name: Victreebel
flavor_text: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

name: Shroomish
flavor_text: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

name: Leafeon
flavor_text: When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of sunshine, you'll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.

name: Shelmet
flavor_text: When it and Karrablast are together, and both receive electrical stimulation, they both evolve.

name: Accelgor
flavor_text: Having removed its heavy shell, it becomes very light and can fight with ninja-like movements.

name: Magmar
flavor_text: Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather's body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Magmortar
flavor_text: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

name: Torchic
flavor_text: It has a flame sac inside its belly that perpetually burns. It feels warm if it is hugged.

name: Combusken
flavor_text: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.

name: Blaziken
flavor_text: It can clear a 30-story building in a leap. Its fiery punches scorch its foes.

name: Poliwag
flavor_text: Its slick black skin is thin and damp. A part of its internal organs can be seen through the skin as a spiral pattern.

name: Poliwhirl
flavor_text: It can live in or out of water. When out of water, it constantly sweats to keep its body slimy.

name: Poliwrath
flavor_text: With its extremely tough muscles, it can keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.

name: Politoed
flavor_text: Whenever three or more of these get together, they sing in a loud voice that sounds like bellowing.

name: Glaceon
flavor_text: By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust flurry.

name: Seismitoad-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Cubchoo
flavor_text: Its nose is always running. It sniffs the snot back up because the mucus provides the raw material for its moves.

name: Beartic
flavor_text: They love the cold seas of the north. They create pathways across the ocean waters by freezing their own breath.

name: Clauncher
flavor_text: They knock down flying prey by firing compressed water from their massive claws like shooting a pistol.

name: Clawitzer
flavor_text: Their enormous claws launch cannonballs of water powerful enough to pierce tanker hulls.

name: Amaura
rules: Put this card onto your Bench only with the effect of Sail Fossil
flavor_text: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years.

name: Aurorus
flavor_text: The diamond-shaped crystals on its body expel air as cold as -240 degrees Fahrenheit, surrounding its enemies and encasing them in ice.

name: Pikachu
flavor_text: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

name: Raichu
flavor_text: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.

name: Electabuzz
flavor_text: Electricity runs across the surface of its body. In darkness, its body glows a whitish blue.

name: Electivire
flavor_text: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.

name: Plusle
flavor_text: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

name: Minun
flavor_text: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

name: Thundurus
flavor_text: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

name: Dedenne
flavor_text: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

name: Drowzee
flavor_text: Puts enemies to sleep, then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating only bad dreams.

name: Hypno
flavor_text: It carries a pendulum-like device. There once was an incident in which it took away a child it hypnotized.

name: Jynx
flavor_text: It wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

name: Skorupi
flavor_text: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

name: Gothita
flavor_text: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.

name: Gothorita
flavor_text: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.

name: Gothitelle
flavor_text: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

name: Golett
flavor_text: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.

name: Golurk
flavor_text: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.

name: Machop
flavor_text: It hefts a Graveler repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.

name: Machoke
flavor_text: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

name: Machamp
flavor_text: Its four ruggedly developed arms can launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just two seconds.

name: Hitmonlee
flavor_text: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

name: Hitmonchan
flavor_text: The arm-twisting punches it throws pulverize even concrete. It rests after three minutes of fighting.

name: Hitmontop
flavor_text: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by 10.

name: Breloom
flavor_text: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

name: Makuhita
flavor_text: It toughens up by slamming into thick trees over and over. It gains a sturdy body and dauntless spirit.

name: Hariyama
flavor_text: It stomps on the ground to build power. It can send a 10-ton truck flying with a straight-arm punch.

name: Trapinch
flavor_text: It lives in arid deserts. It makes a sloping pit trap in sand where it patiently awaits prey.

name: Mienfoo
flavor_text: It takes pride in the speed at which it can use moves. What it loses in power, it makes up for in quantity.

name: Mienshao
flavor_text: It wields the fur on its arm like a whip. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

name: Landorus
flavor_text: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."

name: Pancham
flavor_text: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.

name: Tyrantrum
flavor_text: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.

name: Hawlucha
flavor_text: Although its body is small, its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.

name: Hawlucha-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Drapion
flavor_text: It takes great pride in its strength. Even though it can tear foes apart, it finishes them off with powerful poison.

name: Scraggy
flavor_text: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling it skin up to its neck.

name: Scrafty
flavor_text: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.

name: Pangoro
flavor_text: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won't put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.

name: Clefairy
flavor_text: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

name: Clefairy
flavor_text: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

name: Clefable
flavor_text: Its hearing is so acute it can hear a pin drop over half a mile away. It lives on quiet mountains.

name: Sylveon
flavor_text: It sends a soothing aura from its ribbonlike feelers to calm fights.

name: Klefki
flavor_text: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.

name: Dragonite-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Vibrava
flavor_text: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.

name: Flygon
flavor_text: It hides itself by kicking up desert sand with its wings. Red covers shield its eyes from sand.

name: Noivern
flavor_text: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.

name: Lickitung
flavor_text: Its long tongue, slathered with a gooey saliva, sticks to anything, so it is very useful.

name: Lickilicky
flavor_text: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

name: Eevee
flavor_text: A rare Pokémon that adapts to harsh environments by taking on different evolutionary forms.

name: Slakoth
flavor_text: The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.

name: Vigoroth
flavor_text: Its heartbeat is fast and its blood so agitated that it can't sit still for one second.

name: Slaking
flavor_text: The world's laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there's no food left within its reach.

name: Patrat
flavor_text: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

name: Watchog
flavor_text: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.

name: Tornadus
flavor_text: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

name: Noibat
flavor_text: They live in pitch black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.

name: Yanma
flavor_text: Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its head. It won't miss prey—even those behind it.

name: Yanmega
flavor_text: It prefers to battle by biting apart foes' heads instantly while flying by at high speed.

name: Sewaddle
flavor_text: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.

name: Swadloon
flavor_text: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

name: Leavanny
flavor_text: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.

name: Karrablast
flavor_text: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

name: Fletchinder
flavor_text: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.

name: Talonflame
flavor_text: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.

name: Litleo
flavor_text: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.

name: Pyroar
flavor_text: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.

name: Krabby
flavor_text: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

name: Kingler
flavor_text: The large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.

name: Totodile
flavor_text: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

name: Croconaw
flavor_text: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

name: Feraligatr
flavor_text: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

name: Finneon
flavor_text: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.

name: Lumineon
flavor_text: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.

name: Frillish
flavor_text: They paralyze prey with poison, then drag them down to their lairs, five miles below the surface.

name: Jellicent
flavor_text: Its body is mostly seawater. It's said there's a castle of ships Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.

name: Alomomola
flavor_text: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.

name: Pachirisu
flavor_text: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

name: Joltik
flavor_text: Since it can't generate its own electricity, it sticks onto large-bodied Pokémon and absorbs static electricity.

name: Galvantula
flavor_text: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

name: Helioptile
flavor_text: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

name: Helioptile

name: Heliolisk
flavor_text: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

name: Zubat
flavor_text: Even though it has no eyes, it can sense obstacles using ultrasonic waves it emits from it mouth.

name: Golbat
flavor_text: Once it bites, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.

name: Crobat
flavor_text: It flies so silently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.

name: Wobbuffet
flavor_text: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to build up its counterstrike.

name: Gulpin
flavor_text: It has a small heart and brain. Its stomach compromises most of its body, with enzymes to dissolve anything.

name: Swalot
flavor_text: It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids from its follicles to douse foes.

name: Munna
flavor_text: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.

name: Musharna
flavor_text: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

name: Litwick
flavor_text: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life force of any who follow it.

name: Lampent
flavor_text: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.

name: Chandelure
flavor_text: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

name: Pumpkaboo
flavor_text: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

name: Gourgeist
flavor_text: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.

name: Gligar
flavor_text: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.

name: Gliscor
flavor_text: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

name: Roggenrola
flavor_text: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.

name: Boldore
flavor_text: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.

name: Gigalith
flavor_text: The solar rays it absorbs are processed in its energy core and fired as a ball of light.

name: Murkrow
flavor_text: It hides any shiny object it finds in a secret location. Murkrow and Meowth loot one another's stashes.

name: Honchkrow
flavor_text: If one utters a deep cry, many Murkrow gather quickly. For this, it is called "Summoner of Night."

name: Poochyena
flavor_text: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

name: Mightyena
flavor_text: It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.

name: Spiritomb
flavor_text: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

name: Purrloin
flavor_text: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

name: Liepard
flavor_text: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.

name: Malamar-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Skarmory
flavor_text: After nesting in bramble bushes, the wings of its chicks grow hard from scratches by thorns.

name: Bronzor
flavor_text: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor's back contained a mysterious power.

name: Bronzong
flavor_text: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.

name: Dialga-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Heatran
flavor_text: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

name: Escavalier
flavor_text: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.

name: Aegislash-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Aegislash-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

flavor_text: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them.

name: Florges-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Swirlix
flavor_text: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and as sticky as cotton candy.

name: Slurpuff
flavor_text: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

name: Dedenne
flavor_text: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

name: Diancie
flavor_text: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

name: Deino
flavor_text: They cannot see, so they tackle and bite to learn about their surroundings. Their bodies are covered in wounds.

name: Zweilous
flavor_text: The two heads do not get along. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.

name: Hydreigon
flavor_text: Their heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

name: Goomy
flavor_text: The weakest Dragon-type Pokémon, it lives in damp, shady places, so its body doesn't dry out.

name: Sliggoo
flavor_text: It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can't see anything.

name: Goodra
flavor_text: This very friendly Dragon-type Pokémon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.

name: Spearow
flavor_text: Very protective of its territory, it flaps its short wings busily to dart around at high speed.

name: Fearow
flavor_text: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land or rest.

name: Chansey
flavor_text: It is said to deliver happiness. Being compassionate, it shares its egg with injured people.

name: Blissey
flavor_text: The eggs it lays are filled with happiness. Eating even one bite will bring a smile to anyone.

name: Girafarig
flavor_text: While it sleeps, the head of its tail keeps watch. The tail doesn't need to sleep.

name: Whismur
flavor_text: It usually murmurs but starts crying loudly if it senses danger. It stops when its ear covers are shut.

name: Loudred
flavor_text: It shouts loudly by inhaling air, and then using its well-developed stomach muscles to exhale.

name: Exploud
flavor_text: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.

name: Regigigas
flavor_text: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.

name: Bunnelby
flavor_text: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

name: Diggersby
flavor_text: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.

name: Fletchling
flavor_text: These friendly Pokémon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

name: Furfrou
flavor_text: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

name: Shroomish

name: Breloom
flavor_text: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.

name: Volbeat
flavor_text: It lives around clean ponds. At night, its rear lights up. It converses with others by flashing its light.

name: Illumise

flavor_text: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

name: Slugma

name: Magcargo

name: Feebas
flavor_text: It is the shabbiest Pokémon of all. It forms in schools and lives at the bottom of rivers.

name: Milotic
flavor_text: It is the world's most beautiful Pokémon. There are many works of art featuring Milotic.

name: Spheal
flavor_text: Its body is covered in fluffy fur. The fur keeps it from feeling cold while it is rolling on ice.

flavor_text: They can't swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they're happy, they clap fins.

name: Sealeo

name: Beheeyem
flavor_text: It uses psychic power to control an opponent's brain and tamper with its memories.

flavor_text: Disliking water, it lives in deep burrows in arid areas. It can roll itself instantly into a ball.

name: Sandslash
flavor_text: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.

name: Cubone

name: Mamoswine
flavor_text: Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.

name: Hippopotas
flavor_text: It enshrouds itself with sand to protect itself from germs. It does not enjoy getting wet.

name: Gallade
flavor_text: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.

name: Meloetta
flavor_text: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.

flavor_text: It does its level best to glare and pull a scary face, but it can't help grinning if anyone pats its head.

name: Hawlucha

name: Cacturne

name: Bronzor

flavor_text: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

flavor_text: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

flavor_text: Although it has a large body, it is quite skilled at climbing trees. It eats and sleeps in the treetops.

flavor_text: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.

name: Swablu
flavor_text: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

flavor_text: Its vines grow so profusely that, in the warm season, you can't even see its eyes.

name: Hoppip
flavor_text: It drifts on winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

name: Skiploom
flavor_text: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.

name: Jumpluff
flavor_text: Even in the fiercest wind, it can control its fluff to make its way to any place in the world it wants.

name: Yanma
flavor_text: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

name: Yanmega
flavor_text: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

name: Yanmega BREAK
rules: BREAK Evolution Rule: Yanmega BREAK retains the attacks, Abilities, Weakness, Resistance, and Retreat Cost of its previous Evolution.

name: Seedot
flavor_text: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon.

name: Nuzleaf
flavor_text: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

name: Shiftry
flavor_text: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.

name: Foongus
flavor_text: It lures Pokémon with its pattern that looks just like a Poké Ball then releases poison spores.

name: Amoonguss
flavor_text: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion.

name: Larvesta
flavor_text: The base of volcanoes is where they make their homes. They shoot fire from their five horns to repel attacking enemies.

name: Volcarona
flavor_text: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.

name: Ponyta
flavor_text: Its legs grow strong while it chases after its parent. It runs in fields and mountains all day.

name: Rapidash
flavor_text: It gallops at nearly 150 mph. With its mane blazing ferociously, it races as if it were an arrow.

name: Chimchar
flavor_text: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.

name: Monferno
flavor_text: It uses ceilings and walls to launch aerial attacks. Its fiery tail is but one weapon.

name: Infernape
flavor_text: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.

name: Talonflame BREAK
rules: BREAK Evolution Rule: Talonflame BREAK retains the attacks, Abilities, Weakness, Resistance, and Retreat Cost of its previous Evolution.

name: Litleo
flavor_text: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to fight.

name: Pyroar
flavor_text: With fiery breath of more than 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, they viciously threaten any challenger. The females protect the pride's cubs.

name: Pyroar BREAK
rules: BREAK Evolution Rule: Pyroar BREAK retains the attacks, Abilities, Weakness, Resistance, and Retreat Cost of its previous Evolution.

name: Volcanion
flavor_text: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

name: Volcanion-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Mantine
flavor_text: While elegantly swimming in the sea, it ignores Remoraid that cling to its fins seeking food scraps.

name: Shellos
flavor_text: Its shape and coloration vary, depending on its habitat.

name: Gastrodon
flavor_text: It apparently had a huge shell for protection in ancient times. It lives in shallow tidal pools.

name: Oshawott
flavor_text: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

name: Dewott
flavor_text: As a result of strict training, each Dewott learns different forms for using the scalchops.

name: Samurott
flavor_text: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

name: Clauncher
flavor_text: Through controlled expulsions of internal gas, it can expel water like a pistol shot. At close distances, it can shatter rock.

name: Clawitzer
flavor_text: By expelling water from the nozzle in the back of its claw, it can move at a speed of 60 knots.

name: Clawitzer BREAK
rules: BREAK Evolution Rule: Clawitzer BREAK retains the attacks, Abilities, Weakness, Resistance, and Retreat Cost of its previous Evolution.

name: Bergmite
flavor_text: Using air of -150 degrees Fahrenheit, they freeze opponents solid. They live in herds above the snow line on mountains.

name: Avalugg
flavor_text: The way several Bergmite huddle on its back make it look like an aircraft carrier made of ice.

name: Mareep
flavor_text: It stores lots of air in its soft fur, allowing it to stay cool in summer and warm in winter.

name: Flaaffy
flavor_text: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. It fires hair that zaps on impact.

name: Ampharos
flavor_text: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

name: Joltik
flavor_text: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

name: Galvantula
flavor_text: When attacked, they create an electric barrier by spitting out many electrically charged threads.

name: Nidoran ♂
flavor_text: Its large ears are flapped like wings when it is listening to distant sounds. It extends toxic barbs when angered.

name: Nidorino
flavor_text: An aggressive Pokémon that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

name: Nidoking
flavor_text: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.

name: Drifloon
flavor_text: These Pokémon are called the "Signpost for Wandering Spirits." Children holding them sometimes vanish.

name: Drifblim
flavor_text: It's drowsy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.

name: Litwick
flavor_text: Litwick shines a light that absorbs the life energy of people and Pokémon, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

name: Lampent
flavor_text: It arrives near the moment of death and steals spirit from the body.

name: Chandelure
flavor_text: The spirits burned up in its ominous flame lose their way and wander this world forever.

name: Hoopa
flavor_text: It is said to be able to seize anything it desires with its six rings and six huge arms. With its power sealed, it is transformed into a much smaller form.

name: Mankey
flavor_text: It lives in treetop colonies. If one becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.

name: Primeape
flavor_text: It is always outrageously furious. If it gives chase, it will tenaciously track the target no matter how far.

name: Nosepass
flavor_text: Its magnetic nose consistently faces north. Travelers check Nosepass to get their bearings.

name: Probopass
flavor_text: It freely controls three small units called Mini-Noses using magnetic force.

name: Anorith
rules: Put this card onto your Bench only with the effect of Claw Fossil Anorith
flavor_text: A Pokémon ancestor that was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with claws.

name: Armaldo
flavor_text: Protected by a hard shell, its body is very sturdy. It skewers prey with its claws to feed.

name: Croagunk
flavor_text: Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a poison jab.

name: Toxicroak
flavor_text: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

name: Sneasel
flavor_text: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

name: Weavile
flavor_text: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

name: Spiritomb
flavor_text: It was bound to a fissure in an Odd Keystone as punishment for misdeeds 500 years ago.

name: Pawniard
flavor_text: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey.

name: Bisharp
flavor_text: Bisharp pursues prey in the company of a large group of Pawniard. Then Bisharp finishes off the prey.

name: Yveltal
flavor_text: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

name: Yveltal BREAK
rules: BREAK Evolution Rule: Yveltal BREAK retains the attacks, Abilities, Weakness, Resistance, and Retreat Cost of its previous Evolution.

flavor_text: It was generated from a fossil dug out of a layer of clay that was older than anyone knows. It has a sturdy face.

name: Bastiodon
flavor_text: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.

name: Klink
flavor_text: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

name: Klang
flavor_text: A minigear and big gear comprise its body. If the minigear it launches at a foe doesn't return, it will die.

name: Klinklang
flavor_text: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.

name: Cobalion
flavor_text: It has a body and heart of steel. It worked with its allies to punish people when they hurt Pokémon.

name: Magearna-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Marill
flavor_text: The tip of its tail is filled with oil that is lighter than water, so it acts as a float.

name: Azumarill
flavor_text: The bubble-like pattern on its stomach helps it camouflage itself when it's in the water.

name: Gardevoir-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

rules: Mega Evolution rule: When 1 of your Pokémon becomes a Mega Evolution Pokémon, your turn ends. | Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Klefki
flavor_text: It never lets go of a key that it likes, so people give it the keys to vaults and safes as a way to prevent crime.

name: Xerneas
flavor_text: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.

name: Xerneas BREAK
rules: BREAK Evolution Rule: Xerneas BREAK retains the attacks, Abilities, Weakness, Resistance, and Retreat Cost of its previous Evolution.

name: Druddigon
flavor_text: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move.

name: Deino
flavor_text: Lacking sight, it's unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves.

name: Zweilous
flavor_text: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves to another area. Its two heads do not get along.

name: Hydreigon
flavor_text: It responds to movement by attacking. This scary, three-headed Pokémon devours everything in its path!

name: Hydreigon BREAK
rules: BREAK Evolution Rule: Hydreigon BREAK retains the attacks, Abilities, Weakness, Resistance, and Retreat Cost of its previous Evolution.

name: Meowth
flavor_text: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

name: Persian
flavor_text: Its lithe muscles allow it to walk without making a sound. It attacks in an instant.

name: Aipom
flavor_text: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.

name: Ambipom
flavor_text: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.

name: Rufflet
flavor_text: They will challenge anything, even strong opponents, without fear. Their frequent fights help them become stronger.

name: Braviary
flavor_text: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

name: Fletchling
flavor_text: Despite the beauty of its lilting voice, it's merciless to intruders that enter its territory.

name: Fletchinder
flavor_text: The hotter the flame sac on its belly, the faster it can fly, but it takes some time to get the fire going.

name: Talonflame
flavor_text: When attacking prey, it can reach speeds of up to 310 mph. It finishes its prey off with a colossal kick.

name: Hawlucha
flavor_text: With its wings, it controls its position in the air. It likes to attack from above, a maneuver that is difficult to defend against.

name: Vulpix
flavor_text: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

name: Torchic
flavor_text: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Fennekin
flavor_text: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Magikarp
flavor_text: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

name: Totodile
flavor_text: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

name: Pikachu
flavor_text: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.

name: Scraggy
flavor_text: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling it skin up to its neck.

name: Jigglypuff
flavor_text: It captivates foes with its huge, round eyes, then lulls them to sleep by singing a soothing melody.

name: Togepi
flavor_text: A proverb claims that happiness will come to anyone who can make a sleeping Togepi stand up.

name: Dedenne
flavor_text: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

name: Meowth
flavor_text: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

name: Eevee
flavor_text: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

name: Venusaur-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Caterpie
flavor_text: It is covered with a green skin. When it grows, it sheds the skin, covers itself with silk, and becomes a cocoon.

name: Metapod
flavor_text: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can't withstand a harsh attack.

name: Weedle
flavor_text: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

name: Kakuna
flavor_text: This Pokémon is in a temporary stage while making its body. It is almost completely unable to move on its own.

name: Beedrill
flavor_text: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

name: Tangela
flavor_text: Blue plant vines cloak the Pokémon's identity in a tangled mass. It entangles anything that gets close.

name: Charmander
flavor_text: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

name: Charmeleon
flavor_text: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

name: Charizard
flavor_text: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.

name: Vulpix

name: Ninetales
flavor_text: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.

name: Ninetales BREAK
rules: BREAK Evolution Rule: Ninetales BREAK retains the attacks, Abilities, Weakness, Resistance, and Retreat Cost of its previous Evolution.

name: Growlithe
flavor_text: Very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

name: Arcanine
flavor_text: A Pokémon that is described in Chinese legends. It is said to race at an unbelievable speed.

name: Ponyta
flavor_text: Its body is light, and its legs are incredibly powerful. It can clear Ayers Rock in one leap.

name: Magmar
flavor_text: Found near the mouth of a volcano. This fire-breather's body temperature is nearly 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Blastoise-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

rules: Mega Evolution rule: When 1 of your Pokémon becomes a Mega Evolution Pokémon, your turn ends. | Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Poliwag
flavor_text: Its slick black skin is thin and damp. A part of its internal organs can be seen through the skin as a spiral pattern.

name: Poliwhirl
flavor_text: Its two legs are well developed. Even though it can live on the ground, it prefers living in water.

name: Poliwrath
flavor_text: An adept swimmer, it knows the front crawl, butterfly, and more. It is faster than the best human swimmers.

name: Slowbro-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: M Slowbro-EX
rules: Mega Evolution rule: When 1 of your Pokémon becomes a Mega Evolution Pokémon, your turn ends. | Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Seel
flavor_text: Covered with light blue fur, its hide is thick and tough. It is active in bitter cold of -40 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Dewgong
flavor_text: Its body is covered with a pure white fur. The colder the weather, the more active it becomes.

name: Staryu
flavor_text: It appears in large numbers by seashores. At night, its central core flashes with a red light.

name: Starmie
flavor_text: This Pokémon has a geometric body. Because of its body, the locals suspect that it is an alien creature.

name: Starmie BREAK
rules: BREAK Evolution Rule: Starmie BREAK retains the attacks, Abilities, Weakness, Resistance, and Retreat Cost of its previous Evolution.

name: Magikarp
flavor_text: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic Pokémon in the world.

name: Gyarados
flavor_text: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The Hyper Beam it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.

name: Pikachu
flavor_text: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.

name: Raichu
flavor_text: Its electric charges can reach even 100,000 volts. Careless contact can cause even an Indian elephant to faint.

name: Magnemite
flavor_text: It moves while constantly hovering. It discharges Thunder Wave and so on from the units at its sides.

name: Magneton
flavor_text: A linked cluster formed of several Magnemite. It discharges powerful magnetic waves at high voltage.

name: Voltorb
flavor_text: A life-form whose identity is unknown. It is said to Screech or suddenly Self-Destruct.

name: Electrode
flavor_text: It explodes in response to even minor stimuli. It is feared, with the nickname of "The Bomb Ball."

name: Electabuzz
flavor_text: It loves to feed on strong electricity. It occasionally appears around large power plants and so on.

name: Zapdos
flavor_text: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. While it is flying, it makes crackling and snapping sounds.

name: Nidoran ♂
flavor_text: Its large ears are flapped like wings when it is listening to distant sounds. It extends toxic barbs when angered.

name: Nidorino
flavor_text: It is easily angered. By swinging its well-developed horn wildly, it can even punch through diamond.

name: Nidoking
flavor_text: It is recognized by its rock-hard hide and its extended horn. Be careful with the horn as it contains venom.

name: Nidoking BREAK
rules: BREAK Evolution Rule: Nidoking BREAK retains the attacks, Abilities, Weakness, Resistance, and Retreat Cost of its previous Evolution.

name: Gastly
flavor_text: A being that exists as a thin gas. It can topple an Indian elephant by enveloping the prey in two seconds.

name: Haunter
flavor_text: If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, Haunter is there.

name: Drowzee
flavor_text: A descendant of the legendary animal baku, which is said to eat dreams. It is skilled at hypnotism.

name: Koffing
flavor_text: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

name: Mewtwo
flavor_text: A Pokémon whose genetic code was repeatedly recombined for research. It turned vicious as a result.

name: Mewtwo-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Mew
flavor_text: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.

name: Sandshrew
flavor_text: It burrows and lives underground. If threatened, it curls itself up into a ball for protection.

name: Diglett
flavor_text: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.

name: Dugtrio
flavor_text: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.

name: Machop
flavor_text: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it's the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

name: Machoke
flavor_text: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps people by doing work such as the moving of heavy goods.

name: Machamp
flavor_text: Its four ruggedly developed arms can launch a flurry of 1,000 punches in just two seconds.

name: Machamp BREAK
rules: BREAK Evolution Rule: Machamp BREAK retains the attacks, Abilities, Weakness, Resistance, and Retreat Cost of its previous Evolution.

name: Onix
flavor_text: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.

name: Hitmonchan
flavor_text: The spirit of a pro boxer has infused this Pokémon. It throws punches that are faster than a bullet train.

name: Clefairy
flavor_text: Its adorable appearance makes it popular as a pet. However, it is rare and difficult to find.

name: Pidgeot-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Rattata
flavor_text: Its fangs are long and very sharp. They grow continuously, so it gnaws on hard things to whittle them down.

name: Raticate
flavor_text: Its rear feet have three toes each. They are webbed, enabling it to swim across rivers.

name: Farfetch'd
flavor_text: It always walks about with a plant stalk clamped in its beak. The stalk is used for building its nest.

name: Doduo
flavor_text: A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.

name: Chansey
flavor_text: It lays several eggs a day. The eggs are apparently rich in nutrients and extremely delicious.

name: Porygon
flavor_text: Using the most advanced technologies, scientists finally succeeded in making the first artificial Pokémon.

name: Flying Pikachu
flavor_text: By learning how to fly, Pikachu overcame its weakness to Fighting Pokémon.

name: Surfing Pikachu
flavor_text: One summer, a group of Pikachu was found riding the waves at the local beach.
