name: Skarmory
flavor_text: Its body is draped in steel armor. It looks heavy, but it can fly at speeds of up to 185 miles an hour!

name: Aron
flavor_text: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.

name: Lairon
flavor_text: It habitually shows off its strength with the sparks it creates by ramming its steel body into boulders.

name: Aggron
flavor_text: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

name: Escavalier
flavor_text: They use shells they've stolen from Shelmet to arm and protect themselves. They're very popular Pokémon in the Galar region.

name: Klink
flavor_text: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.

name: Klang
flavor_text: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon's rotation speed increases sharply.

name: Klinklang
flavor_text: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.

name: Galarian Stunfisk V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Meltan
flavor_text: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.

name: Melmetal
flavor_text: At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and fall apart. The small shards left behind will eventually be reborn as Meltan.

name: Cufant
flavor_text: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

name: Copperajah
flavor_text: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.

name: Kangaskhan
flavor_text: You shouldn't get close to the child when it's playing outside its mother's pouch. Its mother is always nearby watching over it.

name: Tauros
flavor_text: They live in groups. The one with the longest, thickest, and most-scarred horns is the boss of the herd.

name: Sentret
flavor_text: It stands on its tail so it can see a long way. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly to warn its kind.

name: Furret
flavor_text: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.

name: Dunsparce
flavor_text: When it sees a person, it digs a hole with its tail to make its escape. If you happen to find one, consider yourself lucky.

name: Teddiursa
flavor_text: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.

name: Ursaring
flavor_text: Although it has a large body, it is quite skilled at climbing trees. It eats and sleeps in the treetops.

name: Lugia
flavor_text: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

name: Skitty
flavor_text: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.

name: Delcatty
flavor_text: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

name: Salamence V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Salamence VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

name: Starly
flavor_text: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

name: Staravia
flavor_text: It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.

name: Staraptor
flavor_text: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

name: Ducklett
flavor_text: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

name: Swanna
flavor_text: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

name: Bunnelby
flavor_text: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.

name: Fletchling
flavor_text: Its body is always warm. Trainers who live in cold areas apparently sleep with it in their bed.

name: Skwovet
flavor_text: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

name: Greedent
flavor_text: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

name: Rookidee
flavor_text: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

name: Corvisquire
flavor_text: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

name: Corviknight
flavor_text: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

name: Rose

name: Rillaboom
flavor_text: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

name: Coalossal
flavor_text: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Big Parasol
rules: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached. | As long as the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot, prevent all effects of attacks from your opponent's Pokémon done to all of your Pokémon. (Existing effects are not removed. Damage is not an effect.) | You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Turbo Patch

name: Capture Energy
rules: As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides Colorless Energy. | When you attach this card from your hand to a Pokémon, search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

name: Pikachu on the Ball
flavor_text: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

name: Eevee on the Ball
flavor_text: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

name: Grookey on the Ball
flavor_text: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

name: Scorbunny on the Ball
flavor_text: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

name: Sobble on the Ball
flavor_text: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

name: Venusaur V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Weedle
flavor_text: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

name: Kakuna
flavor_text: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

name: Beedrill
flavor_text: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

name: Eldegoss V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Vulpix
flavor_text: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

name: Victini
flavor_text: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

name: Incineroar V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Sizzlipede
flavor_text: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

name: Centiskorch
flavor_text: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

name: Carvanha
flavor_text: With its sturdy jaws and fangs, it can easily chomp wooden boats to splinters. It fights with Basculin over food.

name: Sharpedo
flavor_text: It drinks in seawater and jets it from its rear to propel itself. It's very sensitive to the scent of blood.

name: Wailord V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Drednaw V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Gardevoir VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

name: Hatenna
flavor_text: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

name: Hattrem
flavor_text: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

name: Hatterene
flavor_text: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

name: Galarian Cursola V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Alcremie V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Machop
flavor_text: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it's the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

name: Machoke
flavor_text: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

name: Machamp
flavor_text: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

name: Lucario V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Zygarde
flavor_text: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.

name: Rockruff
flavor_text: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that's proof of its love for you. However, the rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!

name: Lycanroc
flavor_text: The rocks in its mane are sharper than a knife. Fragments that break off are treasured as good luck charms.

name: Rolycoly
flavor_text: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

name: Grapploct V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Ekans
flavor_text: The eggs of bird Pokémon are its favorite food. It swallows eggs whole, so sometimes an egg gets stuck, and Ekans faints.

name: Arbok
flavor_text: After stunning its opponents with the pattern on its stomach, it quickly wraps them up in its body and waits for them to stop moving.

name: Galarian Zigzagoon
flavor_text: Its restlessness has it constantly running around. If it sees another Pokémon, it will purposely run into them in order to start a fight.

name: Galarian Linoone
flavor_text: It uses its long tongue to taunt opponents. Once the opposition is enraged, this Pokémon hurls itself at the opponent, tackling them forcefully.

name: Galarian Obstagoon
flavor_text: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.

name: Absol
flavor_text: The elderly call it the disaster Pokémon and detest it, but interest in its power to predict disasters is on the rise.

name: Purrloin
flavor_text: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.

name: Liepard
flavor_text: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

name: Scraggy
flavor_text: If it locks eyes with you, watch out! Nothing and no one is safe from the reckless headbutts of this troublesome Pokémon.

name: Scrafty
flavor_text: As halfhearted as this Pokémon's kicks may seem, they pack enough power to shatter Conkeldurr's concrete pillars.

name: Trubbish
flavor_text: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

name: Inkay
flavor_text: It spins while making its luminescent spots flash. These spots allow it to communicate with others by using different patterns of light.

name: Malamar
flavor_text: Gazing at its luminescent spots will quickly induce a hypnotic state, putting the observer under Malamar's control.

name: Nickit
flavor_text: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

name: Duraludon V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Swablu
flavor_text: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

name: Altaria
flavor_text: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

rules: Discard up to 2 cards from your hand, and draw 2 cards for each card you discarded in this way. | You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

rules: Heal 60 damage from 1 of your Pokémon, and it recovers from all Special Conditions. | You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Potion

name: Professor's Research (Professor Magnolia)
rules: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards. | You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Rotom Bike

name: Rotom Phone

name: Weedle
flavor_text: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.

name: Kakuna
flavor_text: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

name: Beedrill
flavor_text: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.

name: Exeggcute
flavor_text: Six of them form a single Pokémon. Should one of the six be lost, the next morning there will once more be six.

name: Exeggutor
flavor_text: Each of its three heads has its own thoughts. When they want to go in different directions, Exeggutor becomes unable to move.

name: Yanma
flavor_text: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

name: Yanmega
flavor_text: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

name: Pineco
flavor_text: It sticks tree bark to itself with its saliva, making itself thicker and larger. Elderly Pineco are ridiculously huge.

name: Celebi
flavor_text: This Pokémon has the ability to move through time. Records describing it as a forest deity can be found from many different eras.

name: Seedot
flavor_text: If it remains still, it looks just like a real nut. It delights in surprising foraging Pokémon.

name: Nuzleaf
flavor_text: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

name: Shiftry
flavor_text: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe's mind and take preemptive action.

name: Nincada
flavor_text: Because it lived almost entirely underground, it is nearly blind. It uses its antennae instead.

name: Ninjask
flavor_text: Its cry leaves a lasting headache if heard for too long. It moves so quickly that it is almost invisible.

name: Shaymin
flavor_text: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.

name: Genesect
flavor_text: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.

name: Skiddo
flavor_text: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.

name: Gogoat
flavor_text: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.

name: Dhelmise
flavor_text: After a piece of seaweed merged with debris from a sunken ship, it was reborn as this ghost Pokémon.

name: Orbeetle V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Orbeetle VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

name: Zarude V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Charmander
flavor_text: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

name: Charmeleon
flavor_text: It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it whips its fiery tail around and slashes away with sharp claws.

name: Charizard
flavor_text: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

name: Flareon
flavor_text: Once it has stored up enough heat, this Pokémon's body temperature can reach up to 1,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Slugma
flavor_text: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn't keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

name: Magcargo
flavor_text: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.

name: Talonflame V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Vaporeon
flavor_text: When Vaporeon's fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.

name: Wailmer
flavor_text: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.

name: Wailord
flavor_text: It can sometimes knock out opponents with the shock created by breaching and crashing its big body onto the water.

name: Oshawott
flavor_text: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

name: Dewott
flavor_text: As a result of strict training, each Dewott learns different forms for using the scalchops.

name: Samurott
flavor_text: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

name: Galarian Darmanitan V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Galarian Darmanitan VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

name: Chewtle
flavor_text: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.

name: Drednaw
flavor_text: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.

name: Cramorant
flavor_text: Cramorant's gluttony led it to try to swallow an Arrokuda whole, which in turn led to Cramorant getting an Arrokuda stuck in its throat.

name: Arrokuda
flavor_text: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.

name: Barraskewda
flavor_text: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

name: Pikachu V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Pikachu VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

name: Voltorb
flavor_text: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.

name: Electrode
flavor_text: It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.

name: Jolteon
flavor_text: If it is angered or startled, the fur all over its body bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.

name: Zapdos
flavor_text: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

name: Ampharos V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Raikou
flavor_text: This rough Pokémon stores energy inside its body, then sweeps across the land, shooting off electricity.

name: Electrike
flavor_text: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

name: Manectric
flavor_text: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.

name: Blitzle
flavor_text: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.

name: Zebstrika
flavor_text: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

name: Joltik
flavor_text: Joltik can be found clinging to other Pokémon. It's soaking up static electricity because it can't produce a charge on its own.

name: Galvantula
flavor_text: It launches electrified fur from its abdomen as its means of attack. Opponents hit by the fur could be in for three full days and nights of paralysis.

name: Tynamo
flavor_text: One alone can emit only trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

name: Eelektrik
flavor_text: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

name: Eelektross
flavor_text: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

name: Zekrom
flavor_text: When the interior part of its tail spins like a motor, Zekrom can generate many bolts of lightning to blast its surroundings.

name: Zeraora
flavor_text: It runs as fast as lightning strikes, shredding its opponents with its high-voltage claws.

name: Pincurchin
flavor_text: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

name: Clefairy
flavor_text: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.

name: Clefable
flavor_text: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

name: Girafarig
flavor_text: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent by biting.

name: Shedinja
flavor_text: A most peculiar Pokémon that somehow appears in a Poké Ball when a Nincada evolves.

name: Shuppet
flavor_text: There's a proverb that says, "Shun the house where Shuppet gather in the growing dusk."

name: Banette
flavor_text: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

name: Duskull
flavor_text: If it finds bad children who won't listen to their parents, it will spirit them away—or so it's said.

name: Dusclops
flavor_text: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.

name: Dusknoir
flavor_text: At the bidding of transmissions from the spirit world, it steals people and Pokémon away. No one knows whether it has a will of its own.

name: Chimecho
flavor_text: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.

name: Woobat
flavor_text: While inside a cave, if you look up and see lots of heart-shaped marks lining the walls, it's evidence that Woobat live there.

name: Swoobat
flavor_text: Emitting powerful sound waves tires it out. Afterward, it won't be able to fly for a little while.

name: Cottonee
flavor_text: It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself. If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds, it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.

name: Whimsicott
flavor_text: It scatters cotton all over the place as a prank. If it gets wet, it'll become too heavy to move and have no choice but to answer for its mischief.

name: Dedenne
flavor_text: Its upper whiskers are sensors that survey its surroundings. Its lower whiskers are organs that shoot electricity.

name: Xerneas
flavor_text: When the horns on its head shine in seven different colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

name: Diancie
flavor_text: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

name: Milcery
flavor_text: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

name: Alcremie
flavor_text: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

name: Zacian
flavor_text: Now armed with a weapon it used in ancient times, this Pokémon needs only a single strike to fell even Gigantamax Pokémon.

name: Wooper
flavor_text: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

name: Quagsire
flavor_text: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn't care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.

name: Shuckle
flavor_text: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

name: Phanpy
flavor_text: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

name: Donphan
flavor_text: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take long to grow.

name: Hitmontop
flavor_text: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

name: Regirock
flavor_text: The same rocks that form its body have been found in ground layers around the world.

name: Riolu
flavor_text: It's exceedingly energetic, with enough stamina to keep running all through the night. Taking it for walks can be a challenging experience.

name: Drilbur
flavor_text: It brings its claws together and whirls around at high speed before rushing toward its prey.

name: Terrakion
flavor_text: It has phenomenal power. It will mercilessly crush anyone or anything that bullies small Pokémon.

name: Zygarde
flavor_text: Born when all of Zygarde's cells have been gathered together, it uses force to neutralize those who harm the ecosystem.

name: Rockruff
flavor_text: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that's proof of its love for you. However, the rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!

name: Lycanroc
flavor_text: They live alone without forming packs. They will only listen to orders from Trainers who can draw out their true power.

name: Mudbray
flavor_text: Loads weighing up to 50 times as much as its own body weight pose no issue for this Pokémon. It's skilled at making use of mud.

name: Mudsdale
flavor_text: Mud that hardens around a Mudsdale's legs sets harder than stone. It's so hard that it allows this Pokémon to scrap a truck with a single kick.

name: Coalossal V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Coalossal VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

name: Clobbopus
flavor_text: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

name: Grapploct
flavor_text: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

name: Zamazenta
flavor_text: Its ability to deflect any attack led to it being known as the Fighting Master's Shield. It was feared and respected by all.

name: Poochyena
flavor_text: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

name: Mightyena
flavor_text: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

name: Sableye
flavor_text: This Pokémon is feared. When its gemstone eyes begin to glow with a sinister shine, it's believed that Sableye will steal people's spirits away.

name: Drapion V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Sandile
flavor_text: Sandile's still not good at hunting, so it mostly eats things that have collapsed in the desert. It's called "the cleaner of the desert."

name: Krokorok
flavor_text: It buries some of its prey in the sand to use as emergency meals when its hunts are unsuccessful.

name: Krookodile
flavor_text: It conceals itself in sandstorms that Flygon whip up and waits patiently for prey to appear.

name: Trubbish
flavor_text: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.

name: Garbodor
flavor_text: This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poison inside its body. The main component of the poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.

name: Galarian Meowth
flavor_text: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

name: Galarian Perrserker
flavor_text: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

name: Forretress
flavor_text: In the moment that it gulps down its prey, the inside of its shell is exposed, but to this day, no one has ever seen that sight.

name: Steelix V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Beldum
flavor_text: If you anger it, it will do more than rampage. It will also burst out strong magnetism, causing nearby machines to break.

name: Metang
flavor_text: It flies at high speeds around the skies. When it finds its prey, Metang takes a firm grip with its sharp claws and never lets go.

name: Metagross
flavor_text: It analyzes its opponents with more accuracy than a supercomputer, which enables it to calmly back them into a corner.

name: Jirachi
flavor_text: Once every 1,000 years, the singing of a pure voice will rouse this Pokémon from its near-perpetual slumber. It wakes for only seven days.

name: Lucario
flavor_text: It controls waves known as auras, which are powerful enough to pulverize huge rocks. It uses these waves to take down its prey.

name: Dialga
flavor_text: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

name: Excadrill
flavor_text: It's not uncommon for tunnels that appear to have formed naturally to actually be a result of Excadrill's rampant digging.

name: Ferroseed
flavor_text: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn't very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.

name: Ferrothorn
flavor_text: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

name: Galarian Stunfisk
flavor_text: Living in mud with a high iron content has given it a strong steel body.

name: Aegislash V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Aegislash VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

name: Magearna
flavor_text: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.

name: Duraludon
flavor_text: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

name: Eevee
flavor_text: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

name: Snorlax
flavor_text: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

name: Lugia
flavor_text: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

name: Taillow
flavor_text: It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to other lands in search of warmth, flying over 180 miles a day.

name: Swellow
flavor_text: It dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. It catches its prey with sharp claws.

name: Whismur
flavor_text: If it senses danger, it scares the foe by crying out with the volume of a jet-plane engine.

name: Loudred
flavor_text: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.

name: Exploud
flavor_text: Its roar in battle shakes the ground like a tremor—or like an earthquake has struck.

name: Rayquaza
flavor_text: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.

name: Chatot
flavor_text: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Tornadus
flavor_text: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.

name: Pikipek
flavor_text: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!

name: Trumbeak
flavor_text: From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.

name: Toucannon
flavor_text: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.

name: Bulbasaur
flavor_text: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.

name: Chikorita
flavor_text: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

name: Treecko
flavor_text: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.

name: Turtwig
flavor_text: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

name: Snivy
flavor_text: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

name: Chespin
flavor_text: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.

name: Rowlet
flavor_text: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.

name: Grookey
flavor_text: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

name: Charmander
flavor_text: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

name: Cyndaquil
flavor_text: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

name: Torchic
flavor_text: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Chimchar
flavor_text: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.

name: Tepig
flavor_text: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

name: Fennekin
flavor_text: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Litten
flavor_text: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

name: Scorbunny
flavor_text: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

name: Squirtle
flavor_text: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

name: Totodile
flavor_text: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.

name: Mudkip
flavor_text: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.

name: Piplup
flavor_text: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

name: Oshawott
flavor_text: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.

name: Froakie
flavor_text: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.

name: Popplio
flavor_text: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

name: Sobble
flavor_text: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

name: Pikachu
flavor_text: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

name: Yanma
flavor_text: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

name: Yanmega
flavor_text: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

name: Celebi
flavor_text: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.

name: Cacnea
flavor_text: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

name: Tropius
flavor_text: Bunches of delicious fruit grow around its neck. In warm areas, many ranches raise Tropius.

name: Rowlet
flavor_text: At a distance, it launches its sharp feathers while flying about. If the enemy gets too close, Rowlet switches tactics and delivers vicious kicks.

name: Dartrix
flavor_text: It throws one knifelike feather after another at its enemies, and each one precisely strikes a weak point. These feathers are known as blade quills.

name: Decidueye
flavor_text: As if wielding a bow, it launches the arrow quills hidden among the feathers of its wings. Decidueye's shots never miss.

name: Rillaboom
flavor_text: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

name: Gossifleur
flavor_text: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

name: Eldegoss
flavor_text: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

name: Zarude
flavor_text: Once the vines on Zarude's body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.

name: Reshiram
flavor_text: When Reshiram's tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world's weather.

name: Kyogre
flavor_text: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

name: Buizel
flavor_text: It inflates the flotation sac around its neck and pokes its head out of the water to see what is going on.

name: Floatzel
flavor_text: Its flotation sac developed as a result of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double as a rubber raft.

name: Manaphy
flavor_text: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

name: Volcanion
flavor_text: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.

name: Chewtle
flavor_text: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

name: Drednaw
flavor_text: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

name: Cramorant
flavor_text: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.

name: Snom
flavor_text: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.

name: Frosmoth
flavor_text: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

name: Shinx
flavor_text: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

name: Luxio
flavor_text: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

name: Luxray
flavor_text: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

name: Rotom
flavor_text: One boy's invention led to the development of many different machines that take advantage of Rotom's unique capabilities.

name: Morpeko
flavor_text: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

name: Galarian Weezing

name: Spinarak

name: Thievul

name: Cufant
flavor_text: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

flavor_text: At a distance, it launches its sharp feathers while flying about. If the enemy gets too close, Rowlet switches tactics and delivers vicious kicks.

name: Dartrix
flavor_text: It throws one knifelike feather after another at its enemies, and each one precisely strikes a weak point. These feathers are known as blade quills.

name: Decidueye
flavor_text: As if wielding a bow, it launches the arrow quills hidden among the feathers of its wings. Decidueye's shots never miss.

name: Grookey
flavor_text: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

name: Thwackey
flavor_text: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

name: Rillaboom
flavor_text: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

name: Blipbug
flavor_text: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.

name: Dottler
flavor_text: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.

name: Orbeetle
flavor_text: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what's around it—and what's around it can include things over six miles away.

name: Gossifleur
flavor_text: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

name: Eldegoss
flavor_text: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.

name: Applin
flavor_text: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.

name: Flapple
flavor_text: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

name: Appletun
flavor_text: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.

name: Scorbunny
flavor_text: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it's raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.

name: Raboot
flavor_text: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.

name: Cinderace
flavor_text: It's skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.

name: Sizzlipede
flavor_text: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

name: Centiskorch
flavor_text: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

name: Galarian Mr. Mime
flavor_text: Its talent is tap-dancing. It can also manipulate temperatures to create a floor of ice, which this Pokémon can kick up to use as a barrier.

name: Galarian Mr. Rime
flavor_text: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

name: Suicune
flavor_text: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

name: Galarian Darumaka
flavor_text: It lived in snowy areas for so long that its fire sac cooled off and atrophied. It now has an organ that generates cold instead.

name: Galarian Darmanitan
flavor_text: On days when blizzards blow through, it comes down to where people live. It stashes food in the snowball on its head, taking it home for later.

name: Sobble
flavor_text: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

name: Drizzile
flavor_text: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.

name: Inteleon
flavor_text: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

name: Chewtle
flavor_text: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.

name: Drednaw
flavor_text: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.

name: Cramorant
flavor_text: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

name: Arrokuda
flavor_text: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.

name: Barraskewda
flavor_text: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

name: Snom
flavor_text: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.

name: Frosmoth
flavor_text: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

name: Eiscue
flavor_text: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.

name: Dracovish
flavor_text: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.

name: Arctovish
flavor_text: Though it's able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

name: Rotom
flavor_text: One boy's invention led to the development of many different machines that take advantage of Rotom's unique capabilities.

name: Yamper
flavor_text: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.

name: Boltund
flavor_text: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

name: Toxel
flavor_text: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

name: Toxtricity
flavor_text: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

name: Pincurchin
flavor_text: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

name: Morpeko
flavor_text: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

name: Dracozolt
flavor_text: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.

name: Arctozolt
flavor_text: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

name: Galarian Ponyta
flavor_text: This Pokémon will look into your eyes and read the contents of your heart. If it finds evil there, it promptly hides away.

name: Galarian Rapidash
flavor_text: Brave and prideful, this Pokémon dashes airily through the forest, its steps aided by the psychic power stored in the fur on its fetlocks.

name: Galarian Corsola
flavor_text: Watch your step when wandering areas oceans once covered. What looks like a stone could be this Pokémon, and it will curse you if you kick it.

name: Galarian Cursola
flavor_text: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.

name: Dedenne
flavor_text: Its upper whiskers are sensors that survey its surroundings. Its lower whiskers are organs that shoot electricity.

name: Sinistea
flavor_text: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

name: Polteageist
flavor_text: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

name: Hatenna
flavor_text: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

name: Hattrem
flavor_text: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

name: Hatterene
flavor_text: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

name: Milcery
flavor_text: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

name: Alcremie
flavor_text: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

name: Indeedee
flavor_text: These intelligent Pokémon touch horns with each other to share information between them.

name: Dreepy
flavor_text: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

name: Drakloak
flavor_text: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

name: Dragapult
flavor_text: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

name: Galarian Farfetch'd
flavor_text: The Farfetch'd of the Galar region are brave warriors, and they wield thick, tough leeks in battle.

name: Galarian Sirfetch'd
flavor_text: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.

name: Galarian Yamask
flavor_text: A clay slab with cursed engravings took possession of a Yamask. The slab is said to be absorbing the Yamask's dark power.

name: Galarian Runerigus
flavor_text: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.

name: Rolycoly
flavor_text: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

name: Carkol
flavor_text: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.

name: Coalossal
flavor_text: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Silicobra
flavor_text: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.

name: Sandaconda
flavor_text: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.

name: Clobbopus
flavor_text: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

name: Grapploct
flavor_text: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

name: Falinks
flavor_text: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass's orders are absolute.

name: Stonjourner
flavor_text: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

name: Koffing
flavor_text: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.

name: Galarian Weezing
flavor_text: This Pokémon consumes particles that contaminate the air. Instead of leaving droppings, it expels clean air.

name: Galarian Zigzagoon
flavor_text: Thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon, it moves in zigzags and wreaks havoc upon its surroundings.

name: Galarian Linoone
flavor_text: This very aggressive Pokémon will recklessly challenge opponents stronger than itself.

name: Galarian Obstagoon
flavor_text: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

name: Nickit
flavor_text: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

name: Thievul
flavor_text: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

name: Impidimp
flavor_text: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

name: Morgrem
flavor_text: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

name: Grimmsnarl
flavor_text: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

name: Galarian Meowth
flavor_text: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

name: Galarian Perrserker
flavor_text: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

name: Galarian Stunfisk
flavor_text: Living in mud with a high iron content has given it a strong steel body.

name: Corviknight
flavor_text: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

name: Cufant
flavor_text: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

name: Copperajah
flavor_text: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.

name: Duraludon
flavor_text: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

name: Minccino
flavor_text: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.

name: Cinccino
flavor_text: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

name: Ducklett
flavor_text: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

name: Swanna
flavor_text: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

name: Bunnelby
flavor_text: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.

name: Oranguru
flavor_text: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.

name: Skwovet
flavor_text: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

name: Greedent
flavor_text: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

name: Rookidee
flavor_text: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

name: Corvisquire
flavor_text: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

name: Wooloo
flavor_text: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won't be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.

name: Dubwool
flavor_text: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.

name: Bellsprout
flavor_text: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.

name: Weepinbell
flavor_text: It spits out Poison Powder to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of Acid.

name: Victreebel
flavor_text: Once ingested into this Pokémon's body, even the hardest object will melt into nothing.

name: Cacnea
flavor_text: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

name: Cacturne
flavor_text: Packs of them follow travelers through the desert until the travelers can no longer move.

name: Kricketune V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Cherubi
flavor_text: The deeper a Cherubi's red, the more nutrients it has stockpiled in its body. And the sweeter and tastier its small ball!

name: Cherrim
flavor_text: The faint scent that emanates from its full blossom entices bug Pokémon to it.

name: Carnivine
flavor_text: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

name: Durant
flavor_text: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.

name: Scatterbug
flavor_text: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

name: Spewpa
flavor_text: The beaks of birds can't begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

name: Vivillon
flavor_text: The patterns on this Pokémon's wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

name: Fomantis
flavor_text: It loves the sunshine. When it basks in the sunlight regularly, it grows up with vivid coloration.

name: Lurantis
flavor_text: As it slashes into its enemies, it looks like it's dancing. Its elegant appearance has led some to call it the most glamorous Grass Pokémon.

name: Tapu Bulu
flavor_text: Although it's called a guardian deity, it's violent enough to crush anyone it sees as an enemy.

name: Blipbug
flavor_text: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.

name: Flapple V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Flapple VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

name: Entei
flavor_text: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

name: Victini V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Victini VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

name: Tepig
flavor_text: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.

name: Pignite
flavor_text: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

name: Emboar
flavor_text: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

name: Heatmor
flavor_text: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

name: Salandit
flavor_text: This sneaky Pokémon will slink behind its prey and immobilize it with poisonous gas before the prey even realizes Salandit is there.

name: Salazzle
flavor_text: The winner of competitions between Salazzle is decided by which one has the most male Salandit with it.

name: Sizzlipede
flavor_text: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they're well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

name: Centiskorch
flavor_text: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

name: Horsea
flavor_text: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

name: Seadra
flavor_text: It is capable of swimming backwards by rapidly flapping its winglike pectoral fins and stout tail.

name: Kingdra
flavor_text: It stores energy by sleeping at underwater depths at which no other life forms can survive.

name: Galarian Mr. Mime
flavor_text: It can radiate chilliness from the bottoms of its feet. It'll spend the whole day tap-dancing on a frozen floor.

name: Galarian Mr. Rime
flavor_text: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.

name: Remoraid
flavor_text: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a Mantine's underside to scavenge for leftovers.

name: Octillery
flavor_text: It traps enemies with its suction-cupped tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

name: Corphish
flavor_text: It was originally a Pokémon from afar that escaped to the wild. It can adapt to the dirtiest river.

name: Crawdaunt
flavor_text: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. It will crash itself into any foe that approaches its nest.

name: Empoleon V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Frillish
flavor_text: Legend has it that the residents of a sunken ancient city changed into these Pokémon.

name: Jellicent
flavor_text: Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky, schools of Jellicent gather near the surface of the sea, waiting for their prey to appear.

name: Bruxish
flavor_text: Its skin is thick enough to fend off Mareanie's spikes. With its robust teeth, Bruxish crunches up the spikes and eats them.

name: Electabuzz
flavor_text: While it's often blamed for power outages, the truth is the cause of outages is more often an error on the part of the electric company.

name: Electivire
flavor_text: A single Electivire can provide enough electricity for all the buildings in a big city for a year.

name: Shinx
flavor_text: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

name: Luxio
flavor_text: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

name: Luxray
flavor_text: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

name: Pachirisu
flavor_text: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

name: Tapu Koko V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Tapu Koko VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

name: Yamper
flavor_text: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

name: Boltund
flavor_text: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.

name: Galarian Slowpoke
flavor_text: Because Galarian Slowpoke eat the seeds of a plant that grows only in Galar, their tails have developed a spicy flavor.

name: Spoink
flavor_text: It bounces around on its tail to keep its heart pumping. It carries a pearl from Clamperl on its head.

name: Grumpig
flavor_text: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.

name: Baltoy
flavor_text: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

name: Claydol
flavor_text: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

name: Chimecho
flavor_text: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.

name: Espurr
flavor_text: There's enough psychic power in Espurr to send a wrestler flying, but because this power can't be controlled, Espurr finds it troublesome.

name: Meowstic
flavor_text: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It's when they're protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

name: Mimikyu V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Necrozma V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Dottler
flavor_text: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.

name: Orbeetle
flavor_text: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what's around it—and what's around it can include things over six miles away.

name: Mankey
flavor_text: If one gets angry, all the others around it will get angry, so silence is a rare visitor in a troop of Mankey.

name: Primeape
flavor_text: The blood vessels in its brain are sturdier than those of other Pokémon, so it can stay healthy despite its constant raging.

name: Onix
flavor_text: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

name: Cubone
flavor_text: It wears its mother's skull on its head, so no one knows what its bare face looks like. However, it's clear that it's always crying.

name: Marowak
flavor_text: They thump their bones rhythmically to communicate among themselves. There are nearly 50 different rhythmic patterns.

name: Gligar
flavor_text: It flies straight at its target's face then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

name: Gliscor
flavor_text: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey… Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

name: Timburr
flavor_text: Timburr that have started carrying logs that are about three times their size are nearly ready to evolve.

name: Gurdurr
flavor_text: Gurdurr excels at demolition—construction is not its forte. In any case, there's skill in the way this Pokémon wields its metal beam.

name: Conkeldurr
flavor_text: When going all out, this Pokémon throws aside its concrete pillars and leaps at opponents to pummel them with its fists.

name: Mienfoo
flavor_text: They seclude themselves in the mountains and devote themselves to training. The form of their kicks and chops differs from pack to pack.

name: Mienshao
flavor_text: When Mienshao lets out a bizarre wail, you're in danger. A flurry of kicks and chops too fast to see is about to be unleashed!

name: Rolycoly
flavor_text: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.

name: Carkol
flavor_text: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph. The temperature of the flames it breathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Coalossal
flavor_text: While it's engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.

name: Silicobra
flavor_text: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.

name: Sandaconda
flavor_text: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.

name: Falinks
flavor_text: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

name: Stonjourner
flavor_text: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.

rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

name: Zubat
flavor_text: Their skin is so thin that they'll be burned if sunlight hits them. When it gets cold out, they gather together to warm one another's bodies.

name: Golbat
flavor_text: They can suck down over 10 ounces of blood in one go. They have been known to drink so much blood that they can no longer fly.

name: Crobat
flavor_text: It feeds on the blood of living people and Pokémon. If it can't drink any blood for even a short while, it becomes weak and unable to fly.

name: Galarian Slowbro
flavor_text: If this Pokémon squeezes the tongue of the Shellder biting it, the Shellder will launch a toxic liquid from the tip of its shell.

name: Murkrow
flavor_text: It searches for shiny things for its boss. Murkrow's presence is said to be unlucky, so many people detest it.

name: Honchkrow
flavor_text: Its goons take care of most of the fighting for it. The only time it dirties its own hands is in delivering a final blow to finish off an opponent.

name: Houndour
flavor_text: They make repeated eerie howls before dawn to call attention to their pack.

name: Houndoom
flavor_text: Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.

name: Tyranitar V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Morpeko
flavor_text: Hunger hormones affect its temperament. Until its hunger is appeased, it gets up to all manner of evil deeds.

name: Steelix
flavor_text: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.

name: Mawile
flavor_text: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

name: Bronzor
flavor_text: Polishing Bronzor to a shine makes its surface reflect the truth, according to common lore. Be that as it may, Bronzor hates being polished.

name: Bronzong
flavor_text: Many scientists suspect that this Pokémon originated outside the Galar region, based on the patterns on its body.

name: Pawniard
flavor_text: A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve a Bisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently, dreaming of one day taking the lead.

name: Bisharp
flavor_text: Violent conflicts erupt between Bisharp and Fraxure over places where sharpening stones can be found.

name: Honedge
flavor_text: The blue eye on the sword's handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people's lives away.

name: Doublade
flavor_text: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

name: Aegislash
flavor_text: Once upon a time, a king with an Aegislash reigned over the land. His Pokémon eventually drained him of life, and his kingdom fell with him.

name: Aegislash
flavor_text: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

name: Corviknight V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Corviknight VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

name: Spearow
flavor_text: Due to its short wings, it can't fly long distances. It wanders about restlessly and pecks at bug Pokémon.

name: Fearow
flavor_text: Carrying food through Fearow's territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!

name: Lickitung
flavor_text: It licks filth clean with its tongue. Whatever it licks always stinks afterward, so whether it's really clean is…questionable.

name: Lickilicky
flavor_text: It uses its tongue much more skillfully than its hands or its feet. It can deftly pick up a single small bean with its tongue.

name: Glameow
flavor_text: When it's happy, Glameow demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.

name: Purugly
flavor_text: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.

name: Stoutland V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Bouffalant
flavor_text: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.

name: Drampa
flavor_text: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it's angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

name: Indeedee
flavor_text: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.

name: Bruno
rules: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 4 cards. If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, draw 7 cards instead. | You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Camping Gear
rules: Search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. Your turn ends. | You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Cheryl
rules: Heal all damage from each of your Evolution Pokémon. If you do, discard all Energy from the Pokémon that were healed in this way. | You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Energy Recycler
rules: Shuffle up to 5 basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck. | You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Escape Rope
rules: Each player switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon. Your opponent switches first. (If a player does not have a Benched Pokémon, they don't switch Pokémon.) | You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Exp. Share
rules: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached. | When your Active Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, you may move a Basic Energy from that Pokémon to the Pokémon this card is attached to. | You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Fan of Waves
rules: Put a Special Energy attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon on the bottom of their deck. | You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Korrina's Focus
rules: Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. | You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Level Ball
rules: Search your deck for a Pokémon with 90 HP or less, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. | You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Phoebe
rules: During this turn, damage from your Pokémon VMAX's attacks isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon. | You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

rules: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached. | The Rapid Strike Pokémon this card is attached to can use the attack on this card. name: Rapid Strike Style Mustard
rules: You can play this card only when it is the last card in your hand. | Put a Rapid Strike Pokémon from your discard pile onto your Bench. If you do, draw 5 cards. | You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Single Strike Scroll of Scorn
rules: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached. | The Single Strike Pokémon this card is attached to can use the attack on this card. (You still need the necessary Energy to use this attack.) | You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Single Strike Style Mustard
rules: You can play this card only when it is the last card in your hand. | Search your deck for a Single Strike Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. If you searched your deck in this way, draw 5 cards. | You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Sordward & Shielbert
rules: Choose a Trainer card from your discard pile. Then, ask your opponent if you may put it into your hand. If yes, put that card into your hand. If no, draw 3 cards. | You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

name: Tool Jammer
rules: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached. | As long as the Pokémon this card is attached to is in the Active Spot, Pokémon Tools attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon have no effect, except for Tool Jammer. | You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Tower of Darkness
rules: Once during each player's turn, that player may draw 2 cards. In order to use this effect, that player must discard a Single Strike card from their hand. | This Stadium stays in play when you play it. Discard it if another Stadium comes into play. If a Stadium with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

name: Tower of Waters
rules: The Retreat Cost of each Rapid Strike Pokémon in play (both yours and your opponent's) is ColorlessColorless less. | This Stadium stays in play when you play it. Discard it if another Stadium comes into play. If a Stadium with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

name: Urn of Vitality
rules: Shuffle up to 2 Single Strike Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck. | You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

name: Rapid Strike Energy
rules: This card can only be attached to a Rapid Strike Pokémon. If this card is attached to anything other than a Rapid Strike Pokémon, discard this card. | As long as this card is attached to a Pokémon, it provides 2 in any combination of Water Energy and Fighting Energy.

rules: This card can only be attached to a Single Strike Pokémon.
