name: Gible
flavor_text: Gible prefers to stay in narrow holes in the sides of caves heated by geothermal energy. This way, Gible can stay warm even during a blizzard.

name: Gabite
flavor_text: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from a protrusion on either side of its head to probe pitch-dark caves.

name: Garchomp
flavor_text: Garchomp makes its home in volcanic mountains. It flies through the sky as fast as a jet airplane, hunting down as much prey as it can.

name: Axew
flavor_text: These Pokémon nest in the ground and use their tusks to crush hard berries. Crushing berries is also how they test each other's strength.

name: Fraxure
flavor_text: After battle, this Pokémon carefully sharpens its tusks on river rocks. It needs to take care of its tusks—if one breaks, it will never grow back.

name: Haxorus
flavor_text: Its resilient tusks are its pride and joy. It licks up dirt to take in the minerals it needs to keep its tusks in top condition.

name: Druddigon
flavor_text: Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.

name: Dracovish V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Farfetch'd
flavor_text: The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wings serves as a sword to cut down opponents. In a dire situation, the stalk can also serve as food.

name: Castform
flavor_text: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform's disposition!

name: Starly
flavor_text: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.

name: Staravia
flavor_text: It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.

name: Staraptor
flavor_text: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

name: Bidoof
flavor_text: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

name: Bibarel
flavor_text: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

name: Cinccino
flavor_text: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.

name: Tornadus
flavor_text: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.

name: Hawlucha
flavor_text: It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agile maneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashy finishing move.

name: Octillery
flavor_text: It traps enemies with its suction-cupped tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

name: Jolteon
flavor_text: If it is angered or startled, the fur all over its body bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.

name: Zekrom
flavor_text: When the interior part of its tail spins like a motor, Zekrom can generate many bolts of lightning to blast its surroundings.

name: Dusknoir
flavor_text: At the bidding of transmissions from the spirit world, it steals people and Pokémon away. No one knows whether it has a will of its own.

name: Dedenne
flavor_text: Since Dedenne can't generate as much electricity on its own, it steals electricity from outlets or other electric Pokémon.

name: Alcremie
flavor_text: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.

name: Ariados
flavor_text: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

name: Houndoom
flavor_text: Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.

name: Eevee
flavor_text: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

name: Oranguru
flavor_text: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.

name: Hisuian Voltorb
flavor_text: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.

name: Hisuian Electrode
flavor_text: The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.

name: Scyther
flavor_text: The large, wickedly sharp scythes on its forearms are truly fearsome weapons. Prey's attempts to flee are unfailingly thwarted by this Pokémon's nimble motions.

name: Scyther
flavor_text: The large, wickedly sharp scythes on its forearms are truly fearsome weapons. Prey's attempts to flee are unfailingly thwarted by this Pokémon's nimble motions.

name: Yanma
flavor_text: Its frail wings are so thin that one can see clear through them. However, during flight these wings exhibit the power to churn air with force enough to launch a house skyward.

name: Yanmega
flavor_text: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

name: Heracross
flavor_text: This Pokémon has an unparalleled horn. Heracross itself demonstrates tremendous power—it's capable of throwing several people trained in the traditional arts of war at once.

name: Kricketot
flavor_text: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.

name: Kricketune
flavor_text: It uses its cutlass-like arms to produce sound, the melody of which varies from individual to individual. It is a worthwhile endeavor to seek out one's favorite tunes.

name: Combee
flavor_text: The members of the trio spend all their time together. Each one has a slightly different taste in nectar.

name: Vespiquen
flavor_text: It skillfully commands its grubs in battles with its enemies. The grubs are willing to risk their lives to defend Vespiquen.

name: Leafeon
flavor_text: Cells similar to those of plants have been found in its fur. Its hard tail can fell a large tree with one stroke, and the tail's sharpness exceeds even that of a sword crafted by a master.

name: Shaymin
flavor_text: When the turning of seasons brings the cruel winter to its end and the joyous people give thanks to the heavens, Shaymin appears and covers the withered land with flowers.

name: Petilil
flavor_text: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.

name: Hisuian Lilligant
flavor_text: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

name: Hisuian Lilligant V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

rules: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Rowlet
flavor_text: Flies noiselessly on delicate wings. It has mastered the art of deftly launching dagger-sharp feathers from those same wings.

name: Dartrix
flavor_text: Regularly basks in sunlight to gather power—presumably due to the frigid climate. Nonetheless, the edges of the blade quills set into its wings are keen as ever.

name: Ponyta
flavor_text: These Pokémon live in herds out in the grassland. Newborn foals lack their fiery manes, which will develop about an hour after birth.

name: Rapidash
flavor_text: This Pokémon can be seen galloping through fields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery mane fluttering in the wind.

name: Cyndaquil
flavor_text: Hails from the Johto region. Though usually curled into a ball due to its timid disposition, it harbors tremendous firepower.

name: Quilava
flavor_text: This creature's fur is most mysterious—it is wholly impervious to the burning touch of flame. Should Quilava turn its back to you, take heed! Such a posture indicates a forthcoming attack.

name: Heatran V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

name: Radiant Heatran
rules: Radiant Pokémon Rule: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck.
flavor_text: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.

name: Psyduck
flavor_text: Suffers perpetual headaches. If the agony grows too great, Psyduck's latent power erupts, contrary to Psyduck's intent. Ergo, I am exploring ways to ease the pain.

name: Golduck
flavor_text: This Pokémon lives in gently flowing rivers. It paddles through the water with its long limbs, putting its graceful swimming skills on display.

name: Starmie V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Swinub
flavor_text: Swinub excels at sniffing out mushrooms buried beneath grass or snow. Since ancient times, the people of Hisui have often relied upon this skill.

name: Piloswine
flavor_text: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.

name: Mamoswine
flavor_text: This Pokémon can be spotted in wall paintings from as far back as 10,000 years ago. For a while, it was thought to have gone extinct.

name: Mantine
flavor_text: This calm and gentle Pokémon swims gracefully through the sea. After building speed, it can leap out of the water. It is often misidentified as a bird Pokémon due to this behavior.

name: Barboach
flavor_text: Makes its home in swamps with murky water. The poor visibility hides this Pokémon from predators, and the slime on its body makes grasping it difficult.

name: Whiscash
flavor_text: It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anything—if it is alive, Whiscash will eat it.

name: Regice
flavor_text: With cold air that can reach temperatures as low as −328 degrees Fahrenheit, Regice instantly freezes any creature that approaches it.

name: Glaceon
flavor_text: Glaceon is able to lower its body temperature very quickly. It freezes the atmosphere, creating diamond dust that glitters like gems while it flutters and dances around.

name: Origin Forme Palkia V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Oshawott
flavor_text: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name "scalchop.".

name: Dewott
flavor_text: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.

name: Hisuian Basculin
flavor_text: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

name: Hisuian Basculegion
flavor_text: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

name: Keldeo
flavor_text: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.

name: Radiant Greninja
rules: Radiant Pokémon Rule: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck.
flavor_text: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

name: Bergmite
flavor_text: Lives on mountains blanketed in perennial snow. It freezes water vapor in the air to make the ice helmet that it dons for defense.

name: Hisuian Avalugg
flavor_text: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.

name: Galarian Mr. Rime V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Luxray V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Regieleki
flavor_text: This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy. It's said that removing the rings on Regieleki's body will unleash the Pokémon's latent power.

name: Hisuian Typhlosion
flavor_text: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.

name: Hisuian Typhlosion V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Hisuian Typhlosion VSTAR
rules: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Togepi
flavor_text: This ovate creature is frequently mistaken for a moving egg when encountered out in the fields or in the mountains. Its guileless smile soothes the soul.

name: Togetic
flavor_text: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

name: Togekiss
flavor_text: These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they've hardly been seen at all.

name: Misdreavus
flavor_text: It conceals itself in darkness, sending chills up travelers' spines with its childlike weeping. As it observes the frightened travelers with glee, the red orbs upon its chest let off an eerie light.

name: Mismagius
flavor_text: Its muttered curses can cause awful headaches or terrifying visions that torment others.

name: Ralts
flavor_text: Tends to prefer people with a chipper disposition to those who are gloomy, but it has shown no discrimination with regard to age or gender. Needs more research.

name: Kirlia
flavor_text: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

name: Gallade
flavor_text: True to its honorable-warrior image, it uses the blades on its elbows only in defense of something or someone.

name: Drifloon
flavor_text: Said to lure away young children and carry them off to the afterlife. Some whisper that Drifloon are formed of reincarnated human souls, but these rumors are as yet unconfirmed.

name: Drifblim
flavor_text: Some say this Pokémon is a collection of souls burdened with regrets, silently drifting through the dusk.

name: Uxie
flavor_text: It is said that its emergence gave humans the intelligence to improve their quality of life.

name: Mesprit
flavor_text: It sleeps at the bottom of a lake. Its spirit is said to leave its body to fly on the lake's surface.

name: Azelf
flavor_text: It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf all came from the same egg.

name: Diancie
flavor_text: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

name: Wyrdeer
flavor_text: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

name: Hisuian Growlithe
flavor_text: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

name: Hisuian Arcanine
flavor_text: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

name: Sudowoodo
flavor_text: Though it pretends to be a tree, it fails to fool even children. To the touch, its body feels more like rock than tree bark. Sudowoodo's extreme aversion to water merits special note.

name: Regirock
flavor_text: Every bit of Regirock's body is made of stone. As parts of its body erode, this Pokémon sticks rocks to itself to repair what's been lost.

name: Cranidos
flavor_text: Its hard skull is its distinguishing feature. It snapped trees by headbutting them, and then it fed on their ripe berries.

name: Rampardos
flavor_text: This ancient Pokémon used headbutts skillfully. Its brain was really small, so some theories suggest that its stupidity led to its extinction.

name: Lucario V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Hippopotas
flavor_text: Though large and languid, Hippopotas is difficult to detect due to its tendency to burrow into and lurk beneath the soil. When agitated or excited, it expels sand from its nostrils.

name: Hippowdon
flavor_text: Stones can get stuck in the ports on their bodies. Dwebble help dislodge such stones, so Hippowdon look after these Pokémon.

name: Radiant Hawlucha
rules: Radiant Pokémon Rule: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck.
flavor_text: It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agile maneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashy finishing move.

name: Hisuian Decidueye
flavor_text: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.

name: Hisuian Qwilfish
flavor_text: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.

name: Hisuian Qwilfish

name: Hisuian Overqwil
flavor_text: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname "sea fiend." It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

name: Hisuian Overqwil
flavor_text: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname "sea fiend." It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

name: Hisuian Sneasel
flavor_text: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.

name: Hisuian Sneasler
flavor_text: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.

name: Hisuian Sneasler V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Poochyena
flavor_text: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

name: Mightyena
flavor_text: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

name: Absol
flavor_text: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.

name: Darkrai V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

rules: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Hisuian Samurott
flavor_text: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

name: Hisuian Samurott V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Hisuian Samurott VSTAR
rules: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Nickit
flavor_text: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

name: Thievul
flavor_text: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

name: Magnemite
flavor_text: A bizarre Pokémon with but a single eye embedded in an iron sphere. I suspect this creature levitates due to the magnetism it emits from its arms, which resemble horseshoe-shaped magnets.

name: Magneton
flavor_text: This Pokémon is three Magnemite that have linked together. Magneton sends out powerful radio waves to study its surroundings.

name: Magnezone
flavor_text: Some say that Magnezone receives signals from space via the antenna on its head and that it's being controlled by some mysterious being.

name: Registeel
flavor_text: Registeel's body is made of a strange material that is flexible enough to stretch and shrink but also more durable than any metal.

name: Shieldon
flavor_text: Although its fossils can be found in layers of primeval rock, nothing but its face has ever been discovered.

name: Bastiodon
flavor_text: This Pokémon is from roughly 100 million years ago. Its terrifyingly tough face is harder than steel.

name: Bronzor
flavor_text: Floats using a mysterious energy. The pattern engraved upon its back is held as sacred and can sometimes be found in imagery from ancient cemeteries and other such timeworn places.

name: Bronzong
flavor_text: Some believe it to be a deity that summons rain clouds. When angered, it lets out a warning cry that rings out like the tolling of a bell.

name: Origin Forme Dialga V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

rules: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Pawniard
flavor_text: It uses river stones to maintain the cutting edges of the blades covering its body. These sharpened blades allow it to bring down opponents.

name: Bisharp
flavor_text: It's accompanied by a large retinue of Pawniard. Bisharp keeps a keen eye on its minions, ensuring none of them even think of double-crossing it.

name: Garchomp V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Regidrago
flavor_text: An academic theory proposes that Regidrago's arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon. The theory remains unproven.

name: Eevee
flavor_text: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

name: Hoothoot
flavor_text: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

name: Noctowl
flavor_text: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.

name: Teddiursa
flavor_text: It licks its paws because of the sweet honey that has soaked into them. It is cunning, stealing into the nests of Combee and taking for itself the honey that the Combee have amassed.

name: Ursaring
flavor_text: When the cold season arrives in Hisui, this Pokémon will wander fields and mountains alike in search of its favorite berries. Ursaring's hunger during this time makes it a ferocious danger.

name: Ursaluna
flavor_text: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

name: Stantler
flavor_text: Its strangely shaped antlers have the power to bewitch those who see them. Medicine made by grinding up the black orbs from fallen antlers is an effective treatment for insomnia.

name: Miltank
flavor_text: Miltank produces highly nutritious milk, so it's been supporting the lives of people and other Pokémon since ancient times.

name: Glameow
flavor_text: Bewitches humans with its helical tail and piercing gaze. Its hidden claws are quite sharp as well, making this Pokémon an exceedingly tricky opponent if antagonized.

name: Purugly
flavor_text: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.

name: Chatot
flavor_text: A versatile performer skilled in the imitation of human speech. It is said that older, more experienced Chatot can even understand the meaning of the words they mimic.

name: Regigigas
flavor_text: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

name: Rufflet
flavor_text: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.

name: Hisuian Braviary
flavor_text: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.

flavor_text: The Pokémon is known to bring blizzards. A shake of its massive body is enough to cause whiteout conditions.

name: Flapple
flavor_text: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

name: Kingdra
flavor_text: It stores energy by sleeping at underwater depths at which no other life forms can survive.

name: Frosmoth
flavor_text: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

name: Gardevoir
flavor_text: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.

name: Wyrdeer
flavor_text: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

name: Falinks
flavor_text: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

name: Kleavor
flavor_text: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

name: Mightyena
flavor_text: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.

name: Galarian Obstagoon
flavor_text: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

name: Bronzong
flavor_text: Many scientists suspect that this Pokémon originated outside the Galar region, based on the patterns on its body.

name: Hoothoot
flavor_text: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

flavor_text: Its plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

name: Alolan Exeggutor V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Spinarak
flavor_text: Although the poison from its fangs isn't that strong, it's potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

name: Ariados
flavor_text: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

name: Charmander
flavor_text: It has a preference for hot things. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

name: Charmeleon
flavor_text: It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it whips its fiery tail around and slashes away with sharp claws.

name: Charizard
flavor_text: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

name: Radiant Charizard
rules: Radiant Pokémon Rule: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck.
flavor_text: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

name: Moltres
flavor_text: It's one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.

name: Numel
flavor_text: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.

name: Camerupt
flavor_text: If angered, the humps on its back erupt in a shower of molten lava. It lives in the craters of volcanoes.

name: Squirtle
flavor_text: When it retracts its long neck into its shell, it squirts out water with vigorous force.

name: Wartortle
flavor_text: It is recognized as a symbol of longevity. If its shell has algae on it, that Wartortle is very old.

name: Blastoise
flavor_text: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

name: Radiant Blastoise
rules: Radiant Pokémon Rule: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck.
flavor_text: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.

name: Slowpoke
flavor_text: Slow-witted and oblivious, this Pokémon won't feel any pain if its tail gets eaten. It won't notice when its tail grows back, either.

name: Slowbro
flavor_text: Slowpoke became Slowbro when a Shellder bit on to its tail. Sweet flavors seeping from the tail make the Shellder feel as if its life is a dream.

name: Magikarp
flavor_text: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic Pokémon in the world.

name: Gyarados
flavor_text: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The Hyper Beam it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.

name: Lapras
flavor_text: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

name: Articuno
flavor_text: It's said that this Pokémon's beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.

name: Wimpod
flavor_text: It's nature's cleaner—it eats anything and everything, including garbage and rotten things. The ground near its nest is always clean.

name: Golisopod
flavor_text: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.

name: Pikachu
flavor_text: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

name: Pikachu
flavor_text: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

name: Zapdos
flavor_text: This Pokémon has complete control over electricity. There are tales of Zapdos nesting in the dark depths of pitch-black thunderclouds.

rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

rules: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Natu
flavor_text: It is extremely good at climbing tree trunks and likes to eat the new sprouts on the trees.

name: Xatu
flavor_text: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

name: Lunatone
flavor_text: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

name: Sylveon
flavor_text: By releasing enmity-erasing waves from its ribbonlike feelers, Sylveon stops any conflict.

name: Onix
flavor_text: As it digs through the ground, it absorbs many hard objects. This is what makes its body so solid.

name: Larvitar
flavor_text: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.

name: Pupitar
flavor_text: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.

name: Solrock
flavor_text: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

name: Conkeldurr V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Alolan Rattata
flavor_text: Night after night, they sneak into people's homes seeking food. A massive outbreak of them has become an issue of public concern.

name: Alolan Raticate
flavor_text: It commands a nest of Rattata. Different nests don't get along, whipping up severe fights over feeding grounds.

name: Tyranitar
flavor_text: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

name: Steelix
flavor_text: It is said that if an Onix lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.

name: Meltan
flavor_text: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

name: Melmetal
flavor_text: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

name: Chansey
flavor_text: The egg Chansey carries is not only delicious but also packed with nutrition. It's used as a high-class cooking ingredient.

name: Blissey
flavor_text: Whenever a Blissey finds a weakened Pokémon, it will share its egg and offer its care until the other Pokémon is all better.

name: Ditto
flavor_text: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.

name: Eevee
flavor_text: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.

name: Snorlax
flavor_text: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

name: Aipom
flavor_text: It searches for prey from the tops of trees. When it spots its favorite food, Bounsweet, Aipom gets excited and pounces.

name: Ambipom
flavor_text: It uses its tails for everything. If it wraps both of its tails around you and gives you a squeeze, that's proof it really likes you.

name: Slaking V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Bidoof
flavor_text: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

name: Bibarel
flavor_text: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

name: Pidove
flavor_text: Where people go, these Pokémon follow. If you're scattering food for them, be careful— several hundred of them can gather at once.

name: Tranquill
flavor_text: It can fly moderately quickly. No matter how far it travels, it can always find its way back to its master and its nest.

name: Unfezant
flavor_text: Unfezant are exceptional fliers. The females are known for their stamina, while the males outclass them in terms of speed.

name: Ledyba
flavor_text: These very cowardly Pokémon join together and use Reflect to protect their nest.

name: Rowlet
flavor_text: At a distance, it launches its sharp feathers while flying about. If the enemy gets too close, Rowlet switches tactics and delivers vicious kicks.

name: Gossifleur
flavor_text: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.

name: Growlithe
flavor_text: Extremely loyal, it will fearlessly bark at any opponent to protect its own Trainer from harm.

name: Victini
flavor_text: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

name: Lapras
flavor_text: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

name: Pikachu
flavor_text: When Pikachu meet, they'll touch their tails together and exchange electricity through them as a form of greeting.

name: Chinchou
flavor_text: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

name: Flaaffy
flavor_text: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

name: Tynamo
flavor_text: One alone can emit only trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

name: Cutiefly
flavor_text: An opponent's aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent's next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.

name: Bewear
flavor_text: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.

name: Pangoro
flavor_text: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.

name: Drampa
flavor_text: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it's angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

name: Smeargle
flavor_text: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

name: Oddish
flavor_text: If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move. It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.

name: Gloom
flavor_text: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.

name: Vileplume
flavor_text: It has the world's largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.

name: Paras
flavor_text: The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are controlling the bug. Even if the bug bugs the mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.

name: Parasect
flavor_text: The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroom on its back having become the main body. If the mushroom comes off, the bug stops moving.

name: Wurmple
flavor_text: It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.

name: Silcoon
flavor_text: It drinks dew that collects on its silk and waits for evolution. Its hard cocoon repels attacks.

name: Beautifly
flavor_text: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey's fluids.

name: Cascoon
flavor_text: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.

name: Dustox
flavor_text: Tends to be drawn to bonfires on dark nights. Difficult to chase away from settlements because of the way it scatters highly toxic scales.

name: Seedot
flavor_text: If it remains still, it looks just like a real nut. It delights in surprising foraging Pokémon.

name: Nuzleaf
flavor_text: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.

name: Shiftry
flavor_text: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe's mind and take preemptive action.

name: Roselia
flavor_text: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance. The stronger its aroma, the healthier the Roselia is.

name: Roserade
flavor_text: After captivating opponents with its sweet scent, it lashes them with its thorny whips.

name: Phantump
flavor_text: After a lost child perished in the forest, their spirit possessed a tree stump, causing the spirit's rebirth as this Pokémon.

name: Trevenant
flavor_text: People fear it due to a belief that it devours any who try to cut down trees in its forest, but to the Pokémon it shares its woods with, it's kind.

name: Blipbug
flavor_text: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn't.

name: Dottler
flavor_text: It barely moves, but it's still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.

name: Orbeetle
flavor_text: It's famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.

name: Slugma
flavor_text: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn't keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

name: Magcargo
flavor_text: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.

name: Torkoal
flavor_text: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.

name: Litwick
flavor_text: The flame on its head keeps its body slightly warm. This Pokémon takes lost children by the hand to guide them to the spirit world.

name: Lampent
flavor_text: This Pokémon appears just before someone passes away, so it's feared as an emissary of death.

name: Chandelure
flavor_text: This Pokémon haunts dilapidated mansions. It sways its arms to hypnotize opponents with the ominous dancing of its flames.

name: Delphox V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Litleo
flavor_text: This hot-blooded Pokémon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.

name: Pyroar
flavor_text: The temperature of its breath is over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, but Pyroar doesn't use it on its prey. This Pokémon prefers to eat raw meat.

name: Poliwag
flavor_text: For Poliwag, swimming is easier than walking. The swirl pattern on its belly is actually part of the Pokémon's innards showing through the skin.

name: Poliwhirl
flavor_text: Staring at the swirl on its belly causes drowsiness. This trait of Poliwhirl's has been used in place of lullabies to get children to go to sleep.

name: Politoed
flavor_text: At nightfall, these Pokémon appear on the shores of lakes. They announce their territorial claims by letting out cries that sound like shouting.

name: Seel
flavor_text: Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don't bother it at all, but it gets tired pretty easily in warm waters.

name: Dewgong
flavor_text: It sunbathes on the beach after meals. The rise in its body temperature helps its digestion.

name: Horsea
flavor_text: Horsea makes its home in oceans with gentle currents. If this Pokémon is under attack, it spits out pitch-black ink and escapes.

name: Seadra
flavor_text: It's the males that raise the offspring. While Seadra are raising young, the spines on their backs secrete thicker and stronger poison.

name: Kingdra
flavor_text: With the arrival of a storm at sea, this Pokémon will show itself on the surface. When a Kingdra and a Dragonite meet, a fierce battle ensues.

name: Luvdisc
flavor_text: Luvdisc makes its home in coral reefs in warm seas. It especially likes sleeping in the space between Corsola's branches.

name: Shellos
flavor_text: There's speculation that its appearance is determined by what it eats, but the truth remains elusive.

name: Finneon
flavor_text: It lures in prey with its shining tail fins. It stays near the surface during the day and moves to the depths when night falls.

name: Lumineon
flavor_text: They traverse the deep waters as if crawling over the seafloor. The fantastic lights of its fins shine like stars in the night sky.

name: Snover
flavor_text: One is likely to encounter this Pokémon while out in the snow. There are stories of Snover appearing in human settlements but doing no harm—rather, they bond with the children.

name: Abomasnow
flavor_text: If it sees any packs of Darumaka going after Snover, it chases them off, swinging its sizable arms like hammers.

name: Hisuian Basculin
flavor_text: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.

name: Hisuian Basculegion
flavor_text: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

name: Ducklett
flavor_text: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

name: Swanna
flavor_text: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

name: Kyurem V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Kyurem VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

name: Cramorant
flavor_text: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

name: Glastrier
flavor_text: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It's also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.

name: Pikachu
flavor_text: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

name: Raichu
flavor_text: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

name: Electrike
flavor_text: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.

name: Manectric
flavor_text: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.

name: Magnezone V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Magnezone VSTAR
rules: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Rotom V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Tynamo
flavor_text: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

name: Eelektrik
flavor_text: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.

name: Eelektross
flavor_text: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.

name: Clefairy
flavor_text: It can be found in quiet mountain areas on a full moon's night. Its dancing and its tiny, faintly glowing wings confer upon it a lovely fairylike quality.

name: Clefable
flavor_text: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.

name: Gastly
flavor_text: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.

name: Haunter
flavor_text: This frightful, malevolent spirit can glide through walls, appearing wherever it likes. According to rumor, victims of a Haunter's lick will wither to death day by day.

name: Gengar
flavor_text: On the night of a full moon, if shadows move on their own and laugh, it must be Gengar's doing.

name: Mr. Mime
flavor_text: The behavior of this clown-like Pokémon reminds one of pantomime. It creates invisible walls using a force emitted from its fingertips.

name: Jynx
flavor_text: Its strange cries sound like human language. There are some musicians who compose songs for Jynx to sing.

name: Radiant Gardevoir
rules: Radiant Pokémon Rule: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck.
flavor_text: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.

name: Sableye
flavor_text: This Pokémon is feared. When its gemstone eyes begin to glow with a sinister shine, it's believed that Sableye will steal people's spirits away.

name: Mawile
flavor_text: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.

name: Shuppet
flavor_text: There's a proverb that says, "Shun the house where Shuppet gather in the growing dusk."

name: Banette
flavor_text: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

name: Cresselia
flavor_text: Those who sleep holding Cresselia's feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

name: Hisuian Zorua
flavor_text: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

name: Hisuian Zoroark
flavor_text: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.

name: Inkay
flavor_text: It spins while making its luminescent spots flash. These spots allow it to communicate with others by using different patterns of light.

name: Malamar
flavor_text: Gazing at its luminescent spots will quickly induce a hypnotic state, putting the observer under Malamar's control.

name: Comfey
flavor_text: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them. For some reason, flowers won't wither once they're attached to a Comfey.

name: Mimikyu
flavor_text: It wears a rag fashioned into a Pikachu costume in an effort to look less scary. Unfortunately, the costume only makes it creepier.

name: Spectrier
flavor_text: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn't use its sense of sight. Spectrier's kicks are said to separate soul from body.

name: Enamorus V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Hisuian Growlithe
flavor_text: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.

name: Hisuian Arcanine
flavor_text: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

name: Poliwrath
flavor_text: Its body is solid muscle. When swimming through cold seas, Poliwrath uses its impressive arms to smash through drift ice and plow forward.

name: Machop
flavor_text: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it's the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.

name: Machoke
flavor_text: A sturdy creature boasting a robust physique and boundless stamina. Loves training above all else and voluntarily assists with tasks such as construction and clearing land.

name: Machamp
flavor_text: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.

name: Rhyhorn
flavor_text: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging tackles.

name: Rhydon
flavor_text: It begins walking on its hind legs after evolution. It can punch holes through boulders with its horn.

name: Rhyperior
flavor_text: It can load up to three projectiles per arm into the holes in its hands. What launches out of those holes could be either rocks or Roggenrola.

name: Aerodactyl V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Aerodactyl VSTAR
rules: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Sudowoodo
flavor_text: Though it pretends to be a tree, it fails to fool even children. To the touch, its body feels more like rock than tree bark. Sudowoodo's extreme aversion to water merits special note.

name: Gligar
flavor_text: It flies straight at its target's face, then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

name: Gliscor
flavor_text: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

name: Makuhita
flavor_text: There's a rumor of a traditional recipe for stew that Trainers can use to raise strong Makuhita.

name: Hariyama
flavor_text: Hariyama that are big and fat aren't necessarily strong. There are some small ones that move nimbly and use moves skillfully.

name: Meditite
flavor_text: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

name: Medicham
flavor_text: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.

name: Relicanth
flavor_text: Rock-hard scales and oil-filled swim bladders allow this Pokémon to survive the intense water pressure of the deep sea.

name: Gastrodon
flavor_text: Its search for food sometimes leads it onto land, where it leaves behind a sticky trail of slime as it passes through.

name: Mienfoo
flavor_text: In one minute, a well-trained Mienfoo can chop with its arms more than 100 times.

name: Mienshao
flavor_text: When Mienshao comes across a truly challenging opponent, it will lighten itself by biting off the fur on its arms.

name: Landorus
flavor_text: From the forces of lightning and wind, it creates energy to give nutrients to the soil and make the land abundant.

name: Binacle
flavor_text: After two Binacle find a suitably sized rock, they adhere themselves to it and live together. They cooperate to gather food during high tide.

name: Barbaracle
flavor_text: Seven Binacle come together to form one Barbaracle. The Binacle that serves as the head gives orders to those serving as the limbs.

name: Carbink
flavor_text: When beset by attackers, Carbink wipes them all out by firing high-energy beams from the gems embedded in its body.

name: Rockruff
flavor_text: This Pokémon can bond very strongly with its Trainer, but it also has a habit of biting. Raising a Rockruff for a long time can be challenging.

name: Falinks
flavor_text: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass's orders are absolute.

name: Stonjourner
flavor_text: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

name: Spinarak
flavor_text: Although the poison from its fangs isn't that strong, it's potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

name: Ariados
flavor_text: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

name: Murkrow
flavor_text: It searches for shiny things for its boss. Murkrow's presence is said to be unlucky, so many people detest it.

name: Honchkrow
flavor_text: Its goons take care of most of the fighting for it. The only time it dirties its own hands is in delivering a final blow to finish off an opponent.

name: Seviper
flavor_text: Constant polishing makes the edge of the blade on its tail extremely sharp. It's Zangoose's archrival.

name: Spiritomb
flavor_text: Exactly 108 spirits gathered to become this Pokémon. Apparently there are some ill-natured spirits in the mix.

name: Drapion V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Drapion VSTAR
rules: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Darkrai
flavor_text: On a moonless night, a strange incident occurred in which every one of a village's inhabitants suffered nightmares. The villagers attested that Darkrai appeared before them in these nightmares.

name: Inkay
flavor_text: It spins while making its luminescent spots flash. These spots allow it to communicate with others by using different patterns of light.

name: Hoopa
flavor_text: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

name: Radiant Hisuian Sneasler
rules: Radiant Pokémon Rule: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck.
flavor_text: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.

name: Radiant Steelix
rules: Radiant Pokémon Rule: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck.
flavor_text: It is said that if an Onix lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.

name: Bronzor
flavor_text: It appears in ancient ruins. The pattern on its body doesn't come from any culture in the Galar region, so it remains shrouded in mystery.

name: Bronzong
flavor_text: Some believe that its bell-like cry opens holes to another world. It has been revered as a deity since ancient times.

name: Galarian Stunfisk
flavor_text: Living in mud with a high iron content has given it a strong steel body.

name: Magearna
flavor_text: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.

name: Galarian Perrserker V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Goomy
flavor_text: Goomy hides away in the shade of trees, where it's nice and humid. If the slime coating its body dries out, the Pokémon instantly becomes lethargic.

name: Hisuian Sliggoo
flavor_text: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.

name: Hisuian Goodra
flavor_text: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

name: Hisuian Goodra V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Pidgeot V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Lickitung
flavor_text: If this Pokémon's sticky saliva gets on you and you don't clean it off, an intense itch will set in. The itch won't go away, either.

name: Lickilicky
flavor_text: Lickilicky's strange tongue can stretch to many times the length of its body. No one has figured out how Lickilicky's tongue can stretch so far.

name: Porygon
flavor_text: State-of-the-art technology was used to create Porygon. It was the first artificial Pokémon to be created via computer programming.

name: Porygon2
flavor_text: This is a Porygon that was updated with special data. Porygon2 develops itself by learning about many different subjects all on its own.

name: Porygon-Z
flavor_text: Porygon-Z had a program installed to allow it to move between dimensions, but the program also caused instability in Porygon-Z's behavior.

name: Snorlax
flavor_text: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

name: Aipom
flavor_text: This treetop dweller possesses a tail as dexterous as a hand. Ancient writings describe this Pokémon as a one-armed oddity.

name: Ambipom
flavor_text: It uses its tails for everything. If it wraps both of its tails around you and gives you a squeeze, that's proof it really likes you.

rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Hisuian Zoroark VSTAR
rules: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Bouffalant
flavor_text: These Pokémon can crush a car with no more than a headbutt. Bouffalant with more hair on their heads hold higher positions within the herd.

name: Komala
flavor_text: It remains asleep from birth to death as a result of the sedative properties of the leaves that form its diet.

name: Skwovet
flavor_text: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

name: Greedent
flavor_text: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

name: Parasect
flavor_text: Mushroom-lacking specimens of this Pokémon lie unmoving in the forest, lending credence to the hypothesis that the large mushroom is in control of Parasect's actions.

name: Roserade
flavor_text: After captivating opponents with its sweet scent, it lashes them with its thorny whips.

name: Charizard
flavor_text: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.

name: Chandelure
flavor_text: This Pokémon haunts dilapidated mansions. It sways its arms to hypnotize opponents with the ominous dancing of its flames.

name: Pikachu
flavor_text: Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity. This clever forest-dweller roasts tough berries with an electric shock before consuming them.

name: Gengar
flavor_text: Possesses potential victims' shadows in an effort to steal away the victims' lives. If your shadow begins to laugh, you must take hold of a protective charm posthaste!

name: Banette
flavor_text: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.

name: Hisuian Arcanine
flavor_text: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.

name: Spiritomb
flavor_text: It lays curses by thinking wicked thoughts. Writings tell that this Pokémon was born out of the assembly of five score and eight malevolent spirits.

name: Snorlax
flavor_text: This glutton appears in villages without warning and devours the entirety of their rice granaries—such occurrences have long been counted among the gravest of disasters.

name: Castform
flavor_text: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform's disposition!

name: Venonat
flavor_text: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats bugs. It is attracted by light at night.

name: Venomoth
flavor_text: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.

name: Spinarak
flavor_text: Although the poison from its fangs isn't that strong, it's potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

name: Ariados
flavor_text: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.

name: Sunkern
flavor_text: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from under the leaves of plants. It is said that it eats nothing else.

name: Sunflora
flavor_text: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.

name: Serperior V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Petilil
flavor_text: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.

name: Hisuian Lilligant
flavor_text: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.

name: Foongus
flavor_text: No one knows what the Poké Ball–like pattern on Foongus means or why Foongus has it.

name: Amoonguss
flavor_text: This Pokémon puffs poisonous spores at its foes. If the spores aren't washed off quickly, they'll grow into mushrooms wherever they land.

name: Durant
flavor_text: They lay their eggs deep inside their nests. When attacked by Heatmor, they retaliate using their massive mandibles.

name: Virizion
flavor_text: A legend tells of this Pokémon working together with Cobalion and Terrakion to protect the Pokémon of the Unova region.

name: Chesnaught V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Radiant Tsareena
rules: Radiant Pokémon Rule: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck.
flavor_text: This feared Pokémon has long, slender legs and a cruel heart. It shows no mercy as it stomps on its opponents.

name: Vulpix
flavor_text: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.

name: Ninetales
flavor_text: It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.

name: Growlithe
flavor_text: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

name: Arcanine
flavor_text: The sight of it running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night has captivated many people.

name: Ponyta
flavor_text: It can't run properly when it's newly born. As it races around with others of its kind, its legs grow stronger.

name: Rapidash
flavor_text: This Pokémon can be seen galloping through fields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery mane fluttering in the wind.

name: Victini
flavor_text: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.

name: Reshiram V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Fennekin
flavor_text: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.

name: Braixen
flavor_text: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

name: Delphox
flavor_text: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.

name: Fletchinder
flavor_text: Fletchinder launches embers into the den of its prey. When the prey comes leaping out, Fletchinder's sharp talons finish it off.

name: Talonflame
flavor_text: Talonflame mainly preys upon other bird Pokémon. To intimidate opponents, it sends embers spewing from gaps between its feathers.

name: Litten
flavor_text: Its coat regrows twice a year. When the time comes, Litten sets its own body on fire and burns away the old fur.

name: Torracat
flavor_text: When its mane is standing on end, you can tell it's feeling good. When it isn't feeling well, its fur will lie down flat.

name: Incineroar
flavor_text: When its fighting spirit is set alight, the flames around its waist become especially intense.
