name: Articuno
flavor_text: It's said that this Pokémon's beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.

name: Wailmer
flavor_text: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.

name: Wailord
flavor_text: It can sometimes knock out opponents with the shock created by breaching and crashing its big body onto the water.

name: Feebas
flavor_text: Although unattractive and unpopular, this Pokémon's marvelous vitality has made it a subject of research.

name: Milotic
flavor_text: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

name: Snorunt
flavor_text: It's said that if they are seen at midnight, they'll cause heavy snow. They eat snow and ice to survive.

name: Glalie
flavor_text: It has a body of ice that won't melt, even with fire. It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere.

name: Froslass
flavor_text: After a woman met her end on a snowy mountain, her regrets lingered on. From them, this Pokémon was born. Its favorite food is frozen souls.

name: Relicanth
flavor_text: Rock-hard scales and oil-filled swim bladders allow this Pokémon to survive the intense water pressure of the deep sea.

name: Phione
flavor_text: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.

name: Keldeo
flavor_text: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.

name: Dewpider
flavor_text: It forms a water bubble at the rear of its body and then covers its head with it. Meeting another Dewpider means comparing water-bubble sizes.

name: Araquanid
flavor_text: It launches water bubbles with its legs, drowning prey within the bubbles. This Pokémon can then take its time to savor its meal.

name: Pikachu
flavor_text: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

name: Raichu
flavor_text: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.

name: Chinchou
flavor_text: Its antennae, which evolved from a fin, have both positive and negative charges flowing through them.

name: Lanturn
flavor_text: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.

name: Rotom
flavor_text: One boy's invention led to the development of many different machines that take advantage of Rotom's unique capabilities.

name: Emolga
flavor_text: As Emolga flutters through the air, it crackles with electricity. This Pokémon is cute, but it can cause a lot of trouble.

name: Stunfisk
flavor_text: Thanks to bacteria that lived in the mud flats with it, this Pokémon developed the organs it uses to generate electricity.

name: Zeraora
flavor_text: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.

name: Regieleki V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Regieleki VMAX
rules: VMAX rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

name: Radiant Alakazam
rules: Radiant Pokémon Rule: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck.
flavor_text: It has an incredibly high level of intelligence. Some say that Alakazam remembers everything that ever happens to it, from birth till death.

name: Drowzee
flavor_text: It puts its prey to sleep and devours their dreams. It seems that bad dreams taste sour, so Drowzee doesn't particularly like eating them.

name: Hypno
flavor_text: There are some Hypno that assist doctors with patients who can't sleep at night in hospitals.

name: Jynx
flavor_text: In certain parts of Galar, Jynx was once feared and worshiped as the Queen of Ice.

name: Misdreavus
flavor_text: What makes it happy is imitating the voices of weeping people and scaring everyone. It doesn't deal well with folks who aren't easily frightened.

name: Mismagius
flavor_text: Its muttered curses can cause awful headaches or terrifying visions that torment others.

name: Unown V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Unown VSTAR
rules: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Ralts
flavor_text: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.

name: Kirlia
flavor_text: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.

name: Gardevoir
flavor_text: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.

name: Mawile V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Mawile VSTAR
rules: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Meditite
flavor_text: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.

name: Medicham
flavor_text: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.

name: Chimecho
flavor_text: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.

name: Sigilyph
flavor_text: Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians' emissaries.

name: Solosis
flavor_text: It communicates with others telepathically. Its body is encapsulated in liquid, but if it takes a heavy blow, the liquid will leak out.

name: Duosion
flavor_text: Its psychic power can supposedly cover a range of more than half a mile—but only if its two brains can agree with each other.

name: Reuniclus
flavor_text: While it could use its psychic abilities in battle, this Pokémon prefers to swing its powerful arms around to beat opponents into submission.

name: Elgyem
flavor_text: If this Pokémon stands near a TV, strange scenery will appear on the screen. That scenery is said to be from its home.

name: Beheeyem
flavor_text: Whenever a Beheeyem visits a farm, a Dubwool mysteriously disappears.

name: Espurr
flavor_text: Though Espurr's expression never changes, behind that blank stare is an intense struggle to contain its devastating psychic power.

name: Meowstic
flavor_text: Females are a bit more selfish and aggressive than males. If they don't get what they want, they will torment you with their psychic abilities.

name: Swirlix
flavor_text: It eats its own weight in sugar every day. If it doesn't get enough sugar, it becomes incredibly grumpy.

name: Slurpuff
flavor_text: By taking in a person's scent, it can sniff out their mental and physical condition. It's hoped that this skill will have many medical applications.

name: Dedenne
flavor_text: A Dedenne's whiskers pick up electrical waves other Dedenne send out. These Pokémon share locations of food or electricity with one another.

name: Indeedee
flavor_text: These intelligent Pokémon touch horns with each other to share information between them.

name: Dreepy
flavor_text: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

name: Drakloak
flavor_text: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

name: Dragapult
flavor_text: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

name: Hisuian Arcanine V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Phanpy
flavor_text: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

name: Donphan
flavor_text: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take long to grow.

name: Baltoy
flavor_text: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.

name: Claydol
flavor_text: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.

name: Anorith
flavor_text: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. Anorith lived in the ocean about 100,000,000 years ago, hunting with its pair of claws.

name: Armaldo
flavor_text: After evolution, this Pokémon emerged onto land. Its lower body has become stronger, and blows from its tail are devastating.

name: Terrakion
flavor_text: It has phenomenal power. It will mercilessly crush anyone or anything that bullies small Pokémon.

name: Hawlucha
flavor_text: It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agile maneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashy finishing move.

name: Sandygast
flavor_text: Grudges of the dead have possessed a mound of sand and become a Pokémon. Sandygast is fond of the shovel on its head.

name: Palossand
flavor_text: Palossand is known as the Beach Nightmare. It pulls its prey down into the sand by controlling the sand itself, and then it sucks out their souls.

name: Stonjourner
flavor_text: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

name: Ursaluna V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Zubat
flavor_text: It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings. Even in tight caves, Zubat flies around with skill.

name: Golbat
flavor_text: It loves to drink other creatures' blood. It's said that if it finds others of its kind going hungry, it sometimes shares the blood it's gathered.

name: Crobat
flavor_text: Both of its legs have turned into wings. Without a sound, Crobat flies swiftly toward its prey and sinks its fangs into the nape of its target's neck.

name: Murkrow
flavor_text: It searches for shiny things for its boss. Murkrow's presence is said to be unlucky, so many people detest it.

name: Honchkrow
flavor_text: Its goons take care of most of the fighting for it. The only time it dirties its own hands is in delivering a final blow to finish off an opponent.

name: Skuntank V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Croagunk
flavor_text: It makes frightening noises with its poison-filled cheek sacs. When opponents flinch, Croagunk hits them with a poison jab.

name: Toxicroak
flavor_text: It bounces toward opponents and gouges them with poisonous claws. No more than a scratch is needed to knock out its adversaries.

name: Sandile
flavor_text: The desert gets cold at night, so when the sun sets, this Pokémon burrows deep into the sand and sleeps until sunrise.

name: Krokorok
flavor_text: Krokorok has specialized eyes that enable it to see in the dark. This ability lets Krokorok hunt in the dead of night without getting lost.

name: Krookodile
flavor_text: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sands. Krookodile's mighty jaws can bite through heavy plates of iron with almost no effort at all.

name: Mareanie
flavor_text: The first symptom of its sting is numbness. The next is an itching sensation so intense that it's impossible to resist the urge to claw at your skin.

name: Toxapex
flavor_text: To survive in the cold waters of Galar, this Pokémon forms a dome with its legs, enclosing its body so it can capture its own body heat.

name: Morpeko
flavor_text: Intense hunger drives it to extremes of violence, and the electricity in its cheek sacs has converted into a Dark-type energy.

name: Beldum
flavor_text: From its rear, Beldum emits a magnetic force that rapidly pulls opponents in. They get skewered on Beldum's sharp claws.

name: Metang
flavor_text: Two Beldum have become stuck together via their own magnetic forces. With two brains, the resulting Metang has doubled psychic powers.

name: Metagross
flavor_text: Because the magnetic powers of these Pokémon get stronger in freezing temperatures, Metagross living on snowy mountains are full of energy.

name: Radiant Jirachi
rules: Radiant Pokémon Rule: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck.
flavor_text: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.

name: Ferroseed
flavor_text: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn't very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.

name: Ferrothorn
flavor_text: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

name: Klink
flavor_text: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.

name: Klang
flavor_text: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon's rotation speed increases sharply.

name: Klinklang
flavor_text: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.

name: Cobalion
flavor_text: This Pokémon appears in a legend alongside Terrakion and Virizion, fighting against humans in defense of the Unova region's Pokémon.

name: Togedemaru
flavor_text: With the long hairs on its back, this Pokémon takes in electricity from other electric Pokémon. It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.

name: Magearna V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Dratini
flavor_text: Dratini dwells near bodies of rapidly flowing water, such as the plunge pools of waterfalls. As it grows, Dratini will shed its skin many times.

name: Dragonair
flavor_text: This Pokémon lives in pristine oceans and lakes. It can control the weather, and it uses this power to fly into the sky, riding on the wind.

name: Dragonite
flavor_text: It's a kindhearted Pokémon. If it spots a drowning person or Pokémon, Dragonite simply must help them.

name: Noibat
flavor_text: After nightfall, they emerge from the caves they nest in during the day. Using their ultrasonic waves, they go on the hunt for ripened fruit.

name: Noivern
flavor_text: Aggressive and cruel, this Pokémon will ruthlessly torment enemies that are helpless in the dark.

name: Zygarde
flavor_text: Born when around 10% of Zygarde's cells have been gathered from all over, this form is skilled in close-range combat.

name: Regidrago V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Regidrago VSTAR
rules: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Smeargle
flavor_text: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

name: Lugia V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Lugia VSTAR
rules: VSTAR rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Ho-Oh V
rules: V rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Spinda
flavor_text: Each Spinda's spot pattern is different. With its stumbling movements, it evades opponents' attacks brilliantly!

name: Swablu
flavor_text: Its cottony wings are full of air, making them light and fluffy to the touch. Swablu takes diligent care of its wings.

name: Altaria
flavor_text: As it flies in a calm and relaxed manner, Altaria performs a humming song that would enrapture any audience.

name: Buneary
flavor_text: If both of Buneary's ears are rolled up, something is wrong with its body or mind. It's a sure sign the Pokémon is in need of care.

name: Lopunny
flavor_text: Lopunny is constantly monitoring its surroundings. If danger approaches, this Pokémon responds with superdestructive kicks.

name: Archen
flavor_text: This Pokémon was successfully restored from a fossil. As research suggested, Archen is unable to fly. But it's very good at jumping.

name: Archeops
flavor_text: It needs a running start to take off. If Archeops wants to fly, it first needs to run nearly 25 mph, building speed over a course of about 2.5 miles.

name: Rufflet
flavor_text: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.

name: Hisuian Braviary
flavor_text: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.

name: Fletchling
flavor_text: Its melodious cries are actually warnings. Fletchling will mercilessly peck at anything that enters its territory.

flavor_text: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

name: Milotic
flavor_text: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.

name: Flaaffy
flavor_text: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.

name: Jynx
flavor_text: In certain parts of Galar, Jynx was once feared and worshiped as the Queen of Ice.

name: Gardevoir
flavor_text: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.

name: Malamar
flavor_text: It's said that Malamar's hypnotic powers played a role in certain history-changing events.

name: Rockruff
flavor_text: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that's proof of its love for you. However, the rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!

name: Passimian
flavor_text: Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. Through cooperation, the group survives.

name: Druddigon
flavor_text: Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.

name: Smeargle
flavor_text: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.

name: Heliolisk

flavor_text: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

flavor_text: Though it may look like it's just a bunch of eggs, it's a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.

name: Exeggutor
flavor_text: Each of Exeggutor's three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don't seem to be very interested in one another.

name: Mewtwo
flavor_text: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

flavor_text: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent by biting.

name: Lunatone
flavor_text: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

name: Dusclops
flavor_text: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.

name: Tapu Lele
flavor_text: Although called a guardian deity, Tapu Lele is devoid of guilt about its cruel disposition and can be described as nature incarnate.

name: Enamorus
flavor_text: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

name: Graveler
flavor_text: It travels by rolling down cliffs. If it falls into a river, it will explode with its last gasp.

name: Solrock
flavor_text: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

name: Baltoy
flavor_text: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

name: Riolu
flavor_text: It's exceedingly energetic, with enough stamina to keep running all through the night. Taking it for walks can be a challenging experience.

name: Pancham
flavor_text: It chooses a Pangoro as its master and then imitates its master's actions. This is how it learns to battle and hunt for prey.

name: Rockruff
flavor_text: This Pokémon can bond very strongly with its Trainer, but it also has a habit of biting. Raising a Rockruff for a long time can be challenging.

name: Lycanroc
flavor_text: This form of Lycanroc is reckless. It charges headlong at its opponents, attacking without any care about what injuries it might receive.

name: Koffing
flavor_text: It adores polluted air. Some claim that Koffing used to be more plentiful in the Galar region than they are now.

name: Absol
flavor_text: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.

name: Purrloin
flavor_text: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.

name: Liepard
flavor_text: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.

name: Krokorok
flavor_text: It buries some of its prey in the sand to use as emergency meals when its hunts are unsuccessful.

name: Pangoro
flavor_text: This Pokémon is quick to anger, and it has no problem using its prodigious strength to get its way. It lives for duels against Obstagoon.

name: Skrelp
flavor_text: It drifts in the ocean, blending in with floating seaweed. When other Pokémon come to feast on the seaweed, Skrelp feasts on them instead.

name: Dragalge
flavor_text: Dragalge uses a poisonous liquid capable of corroding metal to send tankers that enter its territory to the bottom of the sea.

name: Hoopa
flavor_text: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.

name: Galarian Meowth
flavor_text: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

name: Galarian Perrserker
flavor_text: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

name: Scizor
flavor_text: Bulky pincers account for one third of Scizor's body weight. A single swing of one of these pincers will crush a boulder completely.

name: Aron
flavor_text: It eats iron ore—and sometimes railroad tracks— to build up the steel armor that protects its body.

name: Lairon
flavor_text: Lairon live in mountains brimming with spring water and iron ore, so these Pokémon often came into conflict with humans in the past.

name: Aggron
flavor_text: Aggron has a horn sharp enough to perforate thick iron sheets. It brings down its opponents by ramming into them horn first.

name: Metang
flavor_text: Two Beldum have become stuck together via their own magnetic forces. With two brains, the resulting Metang has doubled psychic powers.

name: Pawniard
flavor_text: It uses river stones to maintain the cutting edges of the blades covering its body. These sharpened blades allow it to bring down opponents.

name: Bidoof

flavor_text: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You'll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.

name: Kricketune
flavor_text: It signals its emotions with its melodies. Scientists are studying these melodic patterns.

name: Magmortar

name: Oricorio

name: Lapras
flavor_text: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

name: Manaphy
flavor_text: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

name: Keldeo
flavor_text: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.

name: Electivire
flavor_text: The amount of electrical energy this Pokémon produces is proportional to the rate of its pulse. The voltage jumps while Electivire is battling.

name: Toxtricity
flavor_text: It has an electrical organ on its chest. While generating electricity, it fills its surroundings with what sounds like the strumming of a bass guitar.

name: Mew

name: Lunatone
flavor_text: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

name: Deoxys

name: Diancie
flavor_text: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

name: Comfey

name: Thievul

name: Magnezone
flavor_text: Some say that Magnezone receives signals from space via the antenna on its head and that it's being controlled by some mysterious being.

name: Altaria

name: Latias
flavor_text: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.

name: Hisuian Goodra
flavor_text: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy— it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

name: Ditto
flavor_text: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.

name: Dunsparce
flavor_text: When it sees a person, it digs a hole with its tail to make its escape. If you happen to find one, consider yourself lucky.

name: Miltank
flavor_text: Miltank produces highly nutritious milk, so it's been supporting the lives of people and other Pokémon since ancient times.

name: Bibarel

name: Riolu

name: Duskull

name: Bidoof
flavor_text: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

name: Pikachu
flavor_text: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.

flavor_text: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.

name: Paras
flavor_text: The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are controlling the bug. Even if the bug bugs the mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.

name: Poochyena
flavor_text: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.

name: Mareep
flavor_text: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You'll want to pet it because it's cute, but if you use your bare hand, you'll get a painful shock.

flavor_text: With its herculean powers, it can easily throw around an object that is 100 times its own weight.

name: Shroomish
flavor_text: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.

name: Breloom
flavor_text: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.

name: Cacnea
flavor_text: It prefers harsh environments, such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

name: Cacturne
flavor_text: Packs of them follow travelers through the desert until the travelers can no longer move.

name: Tropius
flavor_text: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.

name: Scatterbug
flavor_text: This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder to repel enemies. It will eat different plants depending on where it lives.

name: Spewpa
flavor_text: Spewpa doesn't live in a fixed location. It roams where it pleases across the fields and mountains, building up the energy it needs to evolve.

name: Vivillon
flavor_text: This Pokémon was born in a land where flowers bloom. It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its wings during battle.

name: Skiddo
flavor_text: Until recently, people living in the mountains would ride on the back of these Pokémon to traverse the mountain paths.

name: Gogoat
flavor_text: It can sense the feelings of others by touching them with its horns. This species has assisted people with their work since 5,000 years ago.

name: Sprigatito
flavor_text: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

name: Floragato
flavor_text: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

name: Meowscarada
flavor_text: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

name: Tarountula
flavor_text: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon's natural enemy.

name: Tarountula

flavor_text: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from its large ears to search for fruit to eat. It mistakes Applin for its food.

name: Noivern ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Girafarig
flavor_text: Though very small, the brain in its tail is still considered an important organ because it emits powerful psychic energy.

name: Farigiraf
flavor_text: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig's.

name: Dunsparce
flavor_text: It creates mazes in dark locations. When spotted, it flees into the ground by digging with its tail.

name: Dudunsparce
flavor_text: This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.

name: Wingull
flavor_text: It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a glider. It carries food tucked in its bill.

name: Pelipper
flavor_text: It is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon in its beak. It bobs on the waves to rest its wings.

name: Slakoth
flavor_text: It sleeps for 20 hours every day. Making drowsy those that see it is one of its abilities.

name: Vigoroth
flavor_text: Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.

name: Slaking
flavor_text: It is the world's most slothful Pokémon. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.

name: Fletchling
flavor_text: This Pokémon is normally calm, but once it enters battle, its hormonal balance changes and it becomes aggressive.

name: Rookidee
flavor_text: This Pokémon is brave and reckless. The white markings around a Rookidee's eyes intimidate fainthearted Pokémon.

name: Corvisquire
flavor_text: It's said that the reason behind Corvisquire's high level of intelligence is the large size of its brain relative to those of other bird Pokémon.

name: Tandemaus
flavor_text: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

name: Maushold
flavor_text: They build huge nests with many rooms that are used for different purposes, such as eating and sleeping.

flavor_text: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that the energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.

name: Heracross
flavor_text: It loves sweet nectar. To keep all the nectar to itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.

name: Tropius
flavor_text: It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows twice a year.

name: Sprigatito
flavor_text: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

name: Floragato
flavor_text: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

name: Bramblin
flavor_text: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

name: Fletchinder
flavor_text: Fletchinder scatters embers in tall grass where bug Pokémon might be hiding and then catches them as they come leaping out.

name: Pyroar
flavor_text: The females of a pride work together to bring down prey. It's thanks to them that their pride doesn't starve.

name: Fuecoco
flavor_text: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

name: Crocalor
flavor_text: The combination of Crocalor's fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon's head.

name: Magikarp
flavor_text: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

name: Marill
flavor_text: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry even when it plays in the water.

name: Eiscue
flavor_text: On hot days, these Pokémon press their ice cube heads together and pass the time cooling each other down.

name: Quaxly
flavor_text: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.

name: Quaxwell
flavor_text: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.

name: Frigibax
flavor_text: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

name: Arctibax
flavor_text: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

name: Baxcalibur
flavor_text: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.

name: Raichu
flavor_text: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

name: Mismagius
flavor_text: Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving power.

name: Gothorita
flavor_text: This Pokémon will hypnotize children to put them to sleep before carrying them away. Be wary of nights when the starlight is bright.

name: Sandygast
flavor_text: If it loses its shovel, it will stick something else— like a branch—in its head to make do until it finds another shovel.

name: Rabsca
flavor_text: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

name: Tinkatink
flavor_text: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

name: Tinkatuff
flavor_text: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.

name: Paldean Tauros
flavor_text: This kind of Tauros, known as the Combat Breed, is distinguished by its thick, powerful muscles and its fierce disposition.

name: Sudowoodo
flavor_text: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.

name: Nacli
flavor_text: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.

name: Paldean Wooper
flavor_text: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

name: Tyranitar
flavor_text: Extremely strong, it can change the landscape. It is so insolent that it doesn't care about others.

name: Grafaiai
flavor_text: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.

name: Orthworm
flavor_text: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.

name: Rookidee

name: Oddish
flavor_text: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

name: Gloom
flavor_text: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

name: Bellossom
flavor_text: Bellossom gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.

name: Scyther
flavor_text: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

name: Shuckle
flavor_text: The berries stored in its vaselike shell eventually become a thick, pulpy juice.

name: Surskit
flavor_text: They usually live on ponds, but after an evening shower, they may appear on puddles in towns.

name: Masquerain
flavor_text: It flaps its four wings to hover and fly freely in any direction—to and fro and sideways.

name: Combee
flavor_text: At night, Combee sleep in a group of about a hundred, packed closely together in a lump.

name: Foongus
flavor_text: There is a theory that the developer of the modern-day Poké Ball really liked Foongus, but this has not been confirmed.

name: Amoonguss
flavor_text: Be wary of the poisonous spores it releases. Mushrooms resembling Amoonguss's caps will grow out of anywhere the spores touch.

name: Phantump
flavor_text: With a voice like a human child's, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.

name: Trevenant
flavor_text: Small roots that extend from the tips of this Pokémon's feet can tie into the trees of the forest and give Trevenant control over them.

name: Rowlet
flavor_text: It feels relaxed in tight, dark places and has been known to use its Trainer's pocket or bag as a nest.

name: Dartrix
flavor_text: Supremely sensitive to the presence of others, it can detect opponents standing behind it, flinging its sharp feathers to take them out.

name: Decidueye ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Bounsweet
flavor_text: Its sweat is sweet, like syrup made from boiled-down fruit. Because of this, Bounsweet was highly valued in the past, when sweeteners were scarce.

name: Steenee
flavor_text: Steenee spreads a sweet scent that makes others feel invigorated. This same scent is popular for antiperspirants.

name: Tsareena
flavor_text: This Pokémon is proud and aggressive. However, it is said that a Tsareena will instantly become calm if someone touches the crown on its calyx.

name: Smoliv
flavor_text: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

name: Dolliv
flavor_text: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

name: Arboliva
flavor_text: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

name: Toedscruel ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Capsakid
flavor_text: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

name: Capsakid
flavor_text: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

name: Scovillain
flavor_text: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.

name: Charmander
flavor_text: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

name: Charmeleon
flavor_text: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

name: Vulpix
flavor_text: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.

name: Ninetales
flavor_text: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.

name: Entei
flavor_text: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

name: Numel
flavor_text: Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. When it grows cold, the magma hardens and slows it.

name: Camerupt
flavor_text: It lives in the crater of a volcano. It is well known that the humps on its back erupt every 10 years.

name: Victini ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Darumaka
flavor_text: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it's pushed or pulled.

name: Darmanitan
flavor_text: This Pokémon's power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Litwick
flavor_text: The younger the life this Pokémon absorbs, the brighter and eerier the flame on its head burns.

name: Lampent
flavor_text: It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp. Once it finds someone whose death is near, it will trail quietly after them.

name: Chandelure
flavor_text: In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead of lights, funerals were a constant occurrence—or so it's said.

name: Heatmor
flavor_text: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

name: Larvesta
flavor_text: This Pokémon was called the Larva That Stole the Sun. The fire Larvesta spouts from its horns can cut right through a sheet of iron.

name: Volcarona
flavor_text: Its burning body causes it to be unpopular in hot parts of the world, but in cold ones, Volcarona is revered as an embodiment of the sun.

name: Eiscue ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards. | Tera: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, prevent all damage done to this Pokémon by attacks (both yours and your opponent's).

name: Charcadet
flavor_text: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

name: Armarouge
flavor_text: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

name: Lapras
flavor_text: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

name: Carvanha
flavor_text: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

name: Sharpedo
flavor_text: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sea. Any ship entering the waters Sharpedo calls home will be attacked—no exceptions.

name: Buizel
flavor_text: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.

name: Floatzel
flavor_text: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

name: Tympole
flavor_text: It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can't hear its cries of warning.

name: Palpitoad
flavor_text: On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.

name: Seismitoad
flavor_text: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.

name: Cubchoo
flavor_text: Many of this species can be found along the shorelines of cold regions. If a Cubchoo lacks dangling snot, there's a chance it is sick.

name: Beartic
flavor_text: It is a ferocious, carnivorous Pokémon. Once it captures its prey, it will breathe cold air onto the prey to freeze and preserve it.

name: Cryogonal
flavor_text: Cryogonal appear during cold seasons. It is said that people and Pokémon who die on snowy mountains are reborn into these Pokémon.

name: Froakie
flavor_text: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

name: Frogadier
flavor_text: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 600 metres in a minute's time.

name: Wiglett
flavor_text: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

name: Wugtrio
flavor_text: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

name: Finizen
flavor_text: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

name: Finizen
flavor_text: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.

name: Palafin

flavor_text: It climbs trees by hooking on with its sharp claws. Sandslash shares the berries it gathers, dropping them down to Sandshrew waiting below the tree.

name: Nidoran ♀
flavor_text: It uses its hard incisor teeth to crush and eat berries. The tip of a female Nidoran's horn is a bit more rounded than the tip of a male's horn.

name: Nidorina
flavor_text: If the group is threatened, these Pokémon will band together to assault enemies with a chorus of ultrasonic waves.

name: Nidoqueen
flavor_text: It pacifies offspring by placing them in the gaps between the spines on its back. The spines will never secrete poison while young are present.

name: Nidoran ♂
flavor_text: Small but brave, this Pokémon will hold its ground and even risk its life in battle to protect the female it's friendly with.

name: Nidorino
flavor_text: It's nervous and quick to act aggressively. The potency of its poison increases along with the level of adrenaline present in its body.

name: Nidoking
flavor_text: Nidoking prides itself on its strength. It's forceful and spirited in battle, making use of its thick tail and diamond-crushing horn.

name: Clefairy
flavor_text: Its adorable behavior and cry make it highly popular. However, this cute Pokémon is rarely found.

name: Clefable
flavor_text: Their ears are sensitive enough to hear a pin drop from over a mile away, so they're usually found in quiet places.

name: Vulpix
flavor_text: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.

name: Ninetales ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Jigglypuff
flavor_text: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

name: Wigglytuff ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Zubat
flavor_text: Zubat live in caves, down where the sun's light won't reach. In the morning, they gather together to keep each other warm as they sleep.

name: Golbat
flavor_text: Its feet are tiny, but this Pokémon walks skillfully. It sneaks up on sleeping prey before sinking in its fangs and slurping up blood.

name: Oddish
flavor_text: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

name: Gloom
flavor_text: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

name: Vileplume
flavor_text: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

name: Paras
flavor_text: The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are controlling the bug. Even if the bug bugs the mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.

name: Parasect
flavor_text: The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroom on its back having become the main body. If the mushroom comes off, the bug stops moving.

name: Venonat
flavor_text: Poison oozes from all over its body. It catches small bug Pokémon at night that are attracted by light.

name: Venomoth
flavor_text: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.

name: Diglett
flavor_text: It lives about one yard underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.

name: Dugtrio
flavor_text: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.

name: Meowth
flavor_text: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.

name: Persian
flavor_text: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

name: Psyduck
flavor_text: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.

name: Golduck
flavor_text: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.

name: Mankey
flavor_text: It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.

name: Primeape
flavor_text: It becomes wildly furious if it even senses someone looking at it. It chases anyone that meets its glare.

name: Growlithe
flavor_text: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

name: Arcanine
flavor_text: An ancient picture scroll shows that people were captivated by its movement as it ran through prairies.

name: Poliwag
flavor_text: In rivers with fast-flowing water, this Pokémon will cling to a rock by using its thick lips, which act like a suction cup.

name: Poliwhirl
flavor_text: This Pokémon's sweat is a slimy mucus. When captured, Poliwhirl can slither from its enemies' grasp and escape.

name: Poliwrath
flavor_text: Poliwrath is skilled at both swimming and martial arts. It uses its well-trained arms to dish out powerful punches.

name: Abra
flavor_text: Abra can teleport in its sleep. Apparently the more deeply Abra sleeps, the farther its teleportations go.

name: Kadabra
flavor_text: This Pokémon's telekinesis is immensely powerful. To prepare for evolution, Kadabra stores up psychic energy in the star on its forehead.

name: Alakazam ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Machop
flavor_text: Always brimming with power, it passes time by lifting boulders. Doing so makes it even stronger.

name: Machoke
flavor_text: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps people by doing work such as the moving of heavy goods.

name: Machamp
flavor_text: With four arms that react more quickly than it can think, it can execute many punches at once.

name: Bellsprout
flavor_text: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.

name: Weepinbell
flavor_text: It spits out Poison Powder to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of Acid.

name: Victreebel
flavor_text: Once ingested into this Pokémon's body, even the hardest object will melt into nothing.

name: Tentacool
flavor_text: This Pokémon is mostly made of water. A Tentacool out in the ocean is very hard to spot, because its body blends in with the sea.

name: Tentacruel
flavor_text: Its 80 tentacles can stretch and shrink freely. Tentacruel ensnares prey in a net of spread-out tentacles, delivering venomous stings to its catch.

name: Geodude
flavor_text: It uses both hands to climb precipitous cliffs. People who see it in action have been known to take up bouldering.

name: Graveler
flavor_text: It travels by rolling down cliffs. If it falls into a river, it will explode with its last gasp.

name: Golem ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Ponyta
flavor_text: If you've been accepted by Ponyta, its burning mane is mysteriously no longer hot to the touch.

name: Rapidash
flavor_text: The fastest runner becomes the leader, and it decides the herd's pace and direction of travel.

name: Slowpoke
flavor_text: It is incredibly slow and dopey. It takes five seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

name: Slowbro
flavor_text: When a Slowpoke went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a Shellder. That made it evolve into Slowbro.

name: Magnemite
flavor_text: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.

name: Magneton
flavor_text: Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

name: Farfetch'd
flavor_text: They use a plant stalk as a weapon, but not all of them use it in the same way. Several distinct styles of stalk fighting have been observed.

name: Doduo
flavor_text: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

name: Dodrio
flavor_text: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.

name: Seel
flavor_text: Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don't bother it at all, but it gets tired pretty easily in warm waters.

name: Dewgong
flavor_text: It sunbathes on the beach after meals. The rise in its body temperature helps its digestion.

name: Grimer
flavor_text: Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gather in polluted places and increase the bacteria in their bodies.

name: Muk
flavor_text: It's thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

name: Shellder
flavor_text: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

name: Cloyster
flavor_text: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

name: Gastly
flavor_text: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.

name: Haunter
flavor_text: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

name: Gengar
flavor_text: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey's shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.

name: Onix
flavor_text: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

name: Drowzee
flavor_text: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children's are much tastier.

name: Hypno
flavor_text: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of psi moves, such as Hypnosis and Confusion.

name: Krabby
flavor_text: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

name: Kingler
flavor_text: Its oversized claw is very powerful, but when it's not in battle, the claw just gets in the way.

name: Voltorb
flavor_text: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

name: Electrode
flavor_text: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.

name: Exeggcute
flavor_text: These Pokémon get nervous when they're not in a group of six. The minute even one member of the group goes missing, Exeggcute become cowardly.

name: Exeggutor
flavor_text: When they work together, Exeggutor's three heads can put out powerful psychic energy. Cloudy days make this Pokémon sluggish.

name: Cubone
flavor_text: This Pokémon wears the skull of its deceased mother. Sometimes Cubone's dreams make it cry, but each tear Cubone sheds makes it stronger.

name: Marowak
flavor_text: When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak's temperament also turned vicious at the same time.

name: Hitmonlee
flavor_text: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

name: Hitmonchan
flavor_text: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

name: Lickitung
flavor_text: Bug Pokémon are Lickitung's main food source. This Pokémon paralyzes its prey with a lick from its long tongue, then swallows the prey whole.

name: Koffing
flavor_text: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.

name: Weezing
flavor_text: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small Koffing twins becoming conjoined as a Weezing.

name: Rhyhorn
flavor_text: It can remember only one thing at a time. Once it starts rushing, it forgets why it started.

name: Rhydon
flavor_text: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Chansey
flavor_text: This kindly Pokémon lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

name: Tangela
flavor_text: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon's true appearance remains a mystery.

name: Kangaskhan ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Horsea
flavor_text: They swim with dance-like motions and cause whirlpools to form. Horsea compete to see which of them can generate the biggest whirlpool.

name: Seadra
flavor_text: Seadra's mouth is slender, but its suction power is strong. In an instant, Seadra can suck in food that's larger than the opening of its mouth.

name: Goldeen
flavor_text: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.

name: Seaking
flavor_text: Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.

name: Staryu
flavor_text: Fish Pokémon nibble at it, but Staryu isn't bothered. Its body regenerates quickly, even if part of it is completely torn off.

name: Starmie
flavor_text: Starmie swims by spinning its body at high speed. As this Pokémon cruises through the ocean, it absorbs tiny plankton.

name: Mr. Mime
flavor_text: It's known for its top-notch pantomime skills. It protects itself from all sorts of attacks by emitting auras from its fingers to create walls.

name: Scyther
flavor_text: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

name: Jynx ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Electabuzz
flavor_text: With the coming of a storm, many of these Pokémon will gather under tall trees and sit there waiting for lightning to strike.

name: Magmar
flavor_text: These Pokémon's bodies are constantly burning. Magmar are feared as one of the causes behind fires.

name: Pinsir
flavor_text: This Pokémon clamps its pincers down on its prey and then either splits the prey in half or flings it away.

name: Tauros
flavor_text: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

name: Magikarp
flavor_text: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.

name: Gyarados
flavor_text: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

name: Lapras
flavor_text: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

name: Ditto
flavor_text: Its transformation ability is perfect. However, if made to laugh, it can't maintain its disguise.

name: Eevee
flavor_text: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

name: Vaporeon
flavor_text: It lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin, which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.

name: Jolteon
flavor_text: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

name: Flareon
flavor_text: Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac, heated, and exhaled as fire that reaches over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Porygon
flavor_text: In recent years, this species has been very helpful in cyberspace. These Pokémon will go around checking to make sure no suspicious data exists.

name: Omanyte
flavor_text: This Pokémon is a member of an ancient, extinct species. Omanyte paddles through water with its 10 tentacles, looking like it's just drifting along.

name: Omastar
flavor_text: Omastar's sharp fangs could crush rock, but the Pokémon can attack only the prey that come within reach of its tentacles.

name: Kabuto
flavor_text: While some say this species has gone extinct, Kabuto sightings are apparently fairly common in some places.

name: Kabutops
flavor_text: The cause behind the extinction of this species is unknown. Kabutops were aggressive Pokémon that inhabited warm seas.

name: Aerodactyl
flavor_text: Aerodactyl's sawlike fangs can shred skin to tatters—even the skin of Steel-type Pokémon.

name: Snorlax
flavor_text: This Pokémon's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.

name: Articuno
flavor_text: This Pokémon can control ice at will. Articuno is said to live in snowy mountains riddled with permafrost.

name: Zapdos ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Moltres
flavor_text: There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.

name: Dratini
flavor_text: It sheds many layers of skin as it grows larger. During this process, it is protected by a rapid waterfall.

name: Dragonair
flavor_text: They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly.

name: Dragonite
flavor_text: It is said that somewhere in the ocean lies an island where these gather. Only they live there.

name: Mewtwo
flavor_text: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

name: Charmander
flavor_text: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

name: Charmeleon
flavor_text: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

name: Squirtle
flavor_text: When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.

name: Wartortle
flavor_text: It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to maintain its balance while swimming.

name: Caterpie
flavor_text: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

flavor_text: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

name: Surskit
flavor_text: It secretes a thick, sweet-scented syrup from the tip of its head. It lives on weed-choked ponds.

name: Masquerain
flavor_text: The antennae have distinctive patterns that look like eyes. When it rains, they grow heavy, making flight impossible.

name: Pansage
flavor_text: It's good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It's kind enough to share them with friends.

name: Simisage
flavor_text: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

name: Dwebble
flavor_text: It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.

name: Crustle
flavor_text: Its thick claws are its greatest weapons. They're mighty enough to crack Rhyperior's carapace.

name: Bounsweet
flavor_text: Its sweat is sweet, like syrup made from boiled- down fruit. Because of this, Bounsweet was highly valued in the past, when sweeteners were scarce.

name: Steenee
flavor_text: Steenee spreads a sweet scent that makes others feel invigorated. This same scent is popular for antiperspirants.

name: Blipbug
flavor_text: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.

name: Dottler
flavor_text: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.

name: Orbeetle
flavor_text: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what's around it—and what's around it can include things over six miles away.

name: Nymble
flavor_text: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

name: Toedscool
flavor_text: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

name: Toedscool

name: Toedscruel
flavor_text: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.

name: Wo-Chien
flavor_text: It drains the life-force from vegetation, causing nearby forests to instantly wither and fields to turn barren.

name: Magby
flavor_text: This Pokémon makes its home near volcanoes. At the end of the day, Magby soaks in magma, resting and recovering from the day's fatigue.

name: Pansear
flavor_text: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: Simisear

flavor_text: This mysterious Pokémon has some similarities to a creature that an old book introduced as Slither Wing.

name: Garbodor
flavor_text: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.

name: Yveltal
flavor_text: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

name: Morpeko
flavor_text: Hunger hormones affect its temperament. Until its hunger is appeased, it gets up to all manner of evil deeds.

name: Brute Bonnet
flavor_text: It is possible that the creature listed as Brute Bonnet in a certain book could actually be this Pokémon.

name: Steelix
flavor_text: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.

name: Ferrothorn
flavor_text: Its spikes are harder than steel. This Pokémon crawls across rock walls by stabbing the spikes on its feelers into the stone.

name: Aegislash
flavor_text: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

name: Aipom
flavor_text: It searches for prey from the tops of trees. When it spots its favorite food, Bounsweet, Aipom gets excited and pounces.

name: Loudred
flavor_text: The force of this Pokémon's loud voice isn't just the sound—it's also the wave of air pressure that blows opponents away and damages them.

name: Swablu
flavor_text: It can't relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.

name: Porygon-Z
flavor_text: Some say an additional program made this Pokémon evolve, but even academics can't agree on whether Porygon-Z is really an evolution.

name: Cyclizar
flavor_text: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

name: Iron Jugulis

name: Charmeleon
flavor_text: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

name: Magmar
flavor_text: These Pokémon's bodies are constantly burning. Magmar are feared as one of the causes behind fires.

name: Magmortar
flavor_text: Living in the crater of a volcano has caused this Pokémon's body to resemble its environment— it has an organ similar to a magma chamber.

name: Numel
flavor_text: Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. When it grows cold, the magma hardens and slows it.

name: Camerupt
flavor_text: It lives in the crater of a volcano. It is well known that the humps on its back erupt every 10 years.

name: Heat Rotom
flavor_text: If the convection microwave oven is not working properly, then the Rotom inhabiting it will become lethargic.

name: Charcadet
flavor_text: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

name: Armarouge
flavor_text: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

name: Lapras
flavor_text: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

name: Frigibax
flavor_text: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

name: Pikachu
flavor_text: ﻿When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

name: Raichu
flavor_text: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.

name: Chinchou
flavor_text: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.

name: Lanturn
flavor_text: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.

name: Kilowattrel
flavor_text: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.

name: Exeggcute
flavor_text: These Pokémon get nervous when they're not in a group of six. The minute even one member of the group goes missing, Exeggcute become cowardly.

name: Exeggutor
flavor_text: When they work together, Exeggutor's three heads can put out powerful psychic energy. Cloudy days make this Pokémon sluggish.

name: Natu
flavor_text: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

name: Xatu
flavor_text: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun's movement all day.

name: Ralts
flavor_text: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people's emotions.

name: Kirlia
flavor_text: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.

name: Gardevoir ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Chimecho
flavor_text: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.

name: Mime Jr.
flavor_text: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy's movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!

name: Woobat
flavor_text: It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about, searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.

name: Swoobat
flavor_text: The auspicious shape of this Pokémon's nose apparently led some regions to consider Swoobat a symbol of good luck.

name: Cottonee
flavor_text: Weaving together the cotton of both Cottonee and Eldegoss produces exquisite cloth that's highly prized by many luxury brands.

name: Whimsicott
flavor_text: As long as this Pokémon bathes in sunlight, its cotton keeps growing. If too much cotton fluff builds up, Whimsicott tears it off and scatters it.

name: Dedenne
flavor_text: It's small and its electricity-generating organ is not fully developed, so it uses its tail to absorb electricity from people's homes and charge itself.

name: Mimikyu
flavor_text: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

name: Fidough
flavor_text: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough's breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon's vicinity.

name: Dachsbun
flavor_text: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon's body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

name: Ceruledge
flavor_text: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

name: Flittle
flavor_text: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

name: Greavard
flavor_text: This friendly Pokémon doesn't like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

name: Houndstone
flavor_text: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn't like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.

name: Gimmighoul
flavor_text: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.

name: Mankey
flavor_text: It is extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment, then thrashing away the next instant.

name: Primeape
flavor_text: Some researchers theorize that Primeape remains angry even when inside a Poké Ball.

name: Annihilape
flavor_text: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

name: Phanpy
flavor_text: This Pokémon lives and nests on a riverbank. After playing in the mud, it won't be able to settle down unless it washes its body.

name: Donphan
flavor_text: Donphan is covered in tough hide, so even being hit by a car won't faze this Pokémon. However, it is extremely susceptible to rain.

name: Barboach
flavor_text: Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey's location.

name: Clobbopus
flavor_text: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn't alarmed when that happens—it knows they'll grow back. It's about as smart as a three-year-old.

name: Grapploct
flavor_text: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.

name: Gengar
flavor_text: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey's shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.

name: Paldean Wooper

name: Maschiff

name: Mabosstiff

name: Varoom

name: Revavroom

name: Gloom
flavor_text: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.

name: Vileplume
flavor_text: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

name: Scyther
flavor_text: It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes, moving too fast for the human eye to track.

name: Hoppip
flavor_text: This Pokémon is blown across vast distances by the wind. It is unclear where the Hoppip of Paldea originally came from.

name: Skiploom
flavor_text: Skiploom enthusiasts can apparently tell where a Skiploom was born by the scent drifting from the flower on the Pokémon's head.

name: Jumpluff
flavor_text: Jumpluff travels on seasonal winds. Once its cotton spores run out, its journey ends, as does its life.

name: Pineco
flavor_text: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

name: Snover
flavor_text: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain's lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

name: Abomasnow
flavor_text: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.

name: Smoliv
flavor_text: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

name: Dolliv
flavor_text: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

name: Arboliva
flavor_text: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.

name: Toedscool

name: Capsakid
flavor_text: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

name: Scovillain
flavor_text: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.

name: Rellor
flavor_text: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.

name: Charmander
